declarations.name: EthTotal.memAppendElim
declarations.signature:
theorem memAppendElim {b : A} : ∀ (l₁ l₂ : List A), b ∈ l₁ ++ l₂ → b ∈ l₁ ∨ b ∈ l₂
  | [], _l₂, h => Or.inr h
  | x :: l₁, l₂, h =>
      memConsElim h
        (fun he => Or.inl (Eq.subst (motive := fun z => z ∈ x :: l₁) he.symm (List.Mem.head l₁)))
        (fun ht =>
          match memAppendElim l₁ l₂ ht with
          | Or.inl h₁ => Or.inl (List.Mem.tail x h₁)
          | Or.inr h₂ => Or.inr h₂)

declarations.name: EthTotal.memAppendLeft
declarations.signature:
theorem memAppendLeft {b : A} : ∀ (l₁ : List A) (l₂ : List A), b ∈ l₁ → b ∈ l₁ ++ l₂
  | [], _l₂, h => absurd h notMemNil
  | x :: l₁, l₂, h =>
      memConsElim h
        (fun he =>
          Eq.subst (motive := fun z => z ∈ x :: (l₁ ++ l₂)) he.symm (List.Mem.head (l₁ ++ l₂)))
        (fun ht => List.Mem.tail x (memAppendLeft l₁ l₂ ht))

declarations.name: EthTotal.memAppendSelf
declarations.signature: theorem memAppendSelf {b : A} (l : List A) (h : b ∈ l ++ l) : b ∈ l

declarations.name: EthTotal.memAppendRight
declarations.signature:
theorem memAppendRight {b : A} : ∀ (l₁ : List A) (l₂ : List A), b ∈ l₂ → b ∈ l₁ ++ l₂
  | [], _l₂, h => h
  | x :: l₁, l₂, h => List.Mem.tail x (memAppendRight l₁ l₂ h)

declarations.name: EthTotal.memInsertMiddle
declarations.signature:
theorem memInsertMiddle {b a : A} :
    ∀ (l₁ l₂ : List A), b ∈ l₁ ++ l₂ → b ∈ l₁ ++ a :: l₂
  | [], _, h => List.Mem.tail a h
  | x :: l₁, l₂, h =>
      memConsElim h
        (fun he =>
          Eq.subst (motive := fun z => z ∈ x :: (l₁ ++ a :: l₂)) he.symm
            (List.Mem.head (l₁ ++ a :: l₂)))
        (fun ht => List.Mem.tail x (memInsertMiddle l₁ l₂ ht))

declarations.name: EthTotal.memRemoveMiddleOfNe
declarations.signature:
theorem memRemoveMiddleOfNe {b a : A} (hba : b ≠ a) :
    ∀ (l₁ l₂ : List A), b ∈ l₁ ++ a :: l₂ → b ∈ l₁ ++ l₂
  | [], _, h => memConsElim h (fun he => absurd he hba) (fun ht => ht)
  | x :: l₁, l₂, h =>
      memConsElim h
        (fun he =>
          Eq.subst (motive := fun z => z ∈ x :: (l₁ ++ l₂)) he.symm
            (List.Mem.head (l₁ ++ l₂)))
        (fun ht => List.Mem.tail x (memRemoveMiddleOfNe hba l₁ l₂ ht))

declarations.name: EthTotal.Distinct.removeMiddle
declarations.signature:
theorem Distinct.removeMiddle {a : A} :
    ∀ {l₁ l₂ : List A}, Distinct (l₁ ++ a :: l₂) → Distinct (l₁ ++ l₂)
  | [], _, Distinct.cons _ d => d
  | _x :: l₁, l₂, Distinct.cons hx d =>
      Distinct.cons (fun hm => hx (memInsertMiddle l₁ l₂ hm))
        (Distinct.removeMiddle d)

declarations.name: EthTotal.Distinct.insertMiddle
declarations.signature:
theorem Distinct.insertMiddle {a : A} :
    ∀ {l₁ l₂ : List A}, a ∉ l₁ ++ l₂ → Distinct (l₁ ++ l₂) →
      Distinct (l₁ ++ a :: l₂)
  | [], _l₂, hn, d => Distinct.cons hn d
  | x :: l₁, l₂, hn, Distinct.cons hx d =>
      let hxa : x ≠ a

declarations.name: EthTotal.Distinct.notMemMiddle
declarations.signature:
theorem Distinct.notMemMiddle {a : A} :
    ∀ {l₁ l₂ : List A}, Distinct (l₁ ++ a :: l₂) → a ∉ l₁ ++ l₂
  | [], _, Distinct.cons ha _ => ha
  | _x :: l₁, l₂, Distinct.cons hx d =>
      fun hm =>
        memConsElim hm
          (fun hax =>
            hx (Eq.subst (motive := fun z => z ∈ l₁ ++ a :: l₂) hax
              (memAppendRight l₁ (a :: l₂) (List.Mem.head l₂))))
          (fun ht => Distinct.notMemMiddle d ht)

declarations.name: EthTotal.Distinct.append
declarations.signature:
theorem Distinct.append :
    ∀ {l₁ l₂ : List A}, Distinct l₁ → Distinct l₂ →
      (∀ a : A, a ∈ l₁ → a ∉ l₂) → Distinct (l₁ ++ l₂)
  | [], _l₂, _, d₂, _ => d₂
  | x :: l₁, l₂, Distinct.cons hx d₁, d₂, hdisj =>
      Distinct.cons
        (fun hm =>
          match memAppendElim l₁ l₂ hm with
          | Or.inl h1 => hx h1
          | Or.inr h2 => hdisj x (List.Mem.head l₁) h2)
        (Distinct.append d₁ d₂ (fun a ha => hdisj a (List.Mem.tail x ha)))

declarations.name: EthTotal.Distinct.of_append_left
declarations.signature:
theorem Distinct.of_append_left :
    ∀ {l₁ l₂ : List A}, Distinct (l₁ ++ l₂) → Distinct l₁
  | [], _l₂, _ => Distinct.nil
  | x :: l₁, l₂, Distinct.cons hx d =>
      Distinct.cons (fun hm => hx (memAppendLeft l₁ l₂ hm))
        (Distinct.of_append_left d)

declarations.name: EthTotal.Distinct.of_append_right
declarations.signature:
theorem Distinct.of_append_right :
    ∀ {l₁ l₂ : List A}, Distinct (l₁ ++ l₂) → Distinct l₂
  | [], _l₂, d => d
  | _x :: l₁, l₂, Distinct.cons _ d => Distinct.of_append_right d

declarations.name: EthTotal.Distinct.disjoint_of_append
declarations.signature:
theorem Distinct.disjoint_of_append :
    ∀ {l₁ l₂ : List A}, Distinct (l₁ ++ l₂) → ∀ a : A, a ∈ l₁ → a ∉ l₂
  | [], _l₂, _, _a, ha => absurd ha notMemNil
  | x :: l₁, l₂, Distinct.cons hx d, a, ha =>
      memConsElim ha
        (fun hax h2 =>
          hx (memAppendRight l₁ l₂
            (Eq.subst (motive := fun z => z ∈ l₂) hax h2)))
        (fun ht => Distinct.disjoint_of_append d a ht)

declarations.name: EthTotal.Distinct.of_reverseAux
declarations.signature:
theorem Distinct.of_reverseAux :
    ∀ (q : List A) {t : List A}, Distinct (List.reverseAux q t) → Distinct t
  | [], _, d => d
  | b :: q', t, d =>
      match Distinct.of_reverseAux q' (t := b :: t) d with
      | Distinct.cons _ dt => dt

declarations.signature:
def revSplitAux : A → List A → List A → List A × A

  | _, [], _ => rfl
  | w, u :: t, acc => revSplitAux_spec u t (w :: acc)

declarations.name: EthTotal.exists_split_of_mem
declarations.signature:
theorem exists_split_of_mem {a : A} :
    ∀ {l : List A}, a ∈ l → ∃ l₁ l₂ : List A, l = l₁ ++ a :: l₂

  | _, List.Mem.tail x h =>
      match exists_split_of_mem h with
      | ⟨l₁, l₂, he⟩ => ⟨x :: l₁, l₂, congrArg (fun t => x :: t) he⟩

declarations.name: EthTotal.memOfMemEraseOneOfPoint
declarations.signature:
theorem memOfMemEraseOneOfPoint {a y : A} (dec : ∀ b : A, Decidable (b = a)) :
    ∀ (l : List A), y ∈ eraseOneOfPoint dec l → y ∈ l
  | [], h => absurd h notMemNil
  | x :: l, h =>
      match dec x with
      | isTrue hx =>
          List.Mem.tail x
            (Eq.subst (motive := fun s => y ∈ s)
              (eraseOneOfPoint_cons_pos dec hx l) h)
      | isFalse hx =>
          memConsElim
            (Eq.subst (motive := fun s => y ∈ s)
              (eraseOneOfPoint_cons_neg dec hx l) h)
            (fun hyx =>
              Eq.subst (motive := fun z => z ∈ x :: l) hyx.symm
                (List.Mem.head l))
            (fun h' => List.Mem.tail x (memOfMemEraseOneOfPoint dec l h'))

declarations.name: EthTotal.memOfMemEraseOne
declarations.signature:
theorem memOfMemEraseOne [inst : DecidableEq A] {a y : A} :
    ∀ (l : List A), y ∈ eraseOne a l → y ∈ l

declarations.name: EthTotal.memEraseOneOfNeOfPoint
declarations.signature:
theorem memEraseOneOfNeOfPoint {a b : A} (dec : ∀ c : A, Decidable (c = a))
    (hne : b ≠ a) :
    ∀ (l : List A), b ∈ l → b ∈ eraseOneOfPoint dec l
  | [], h => absurd h notMemNil
  | x :: l, h =>
      match dec x with
      | isTrue hx =>
          Eq.subst (motive := fun s => b ∈ s)
            (eraseOneOfPoint_cons_pos dec hx l).symm
            (memConsElim h
              (fun hbx => absurd (Eq.trans hbx hx) hne)
              (fun ht => ht))
      | isFalse hx =>
          Eq.subst (motive := fun s => b ∈ s)
            (eraseOneOfPoint_cons_neg dec hx l).symm
            (memConsElim h
              (fun hbx =>
                Eq.subst
                  (motive := fun z => z ∈ x :: eraseOneOfPoint dec l) hbx.symm
                  (List.Mem.head (eraseOneOfPoint dec l)))
              (fun ht =>
                List.Mem.tail x (memEraseOneOfNeOfPoint dec hne l ht)))

declarations.signature:
theorem memEraseOneOfNe [inst : DecidableEq A] {a b : A} (hne : b ≠ a) :
    ∀ (l : List A), b ∈ l → b ∈ eraseOne a l

declarations.name: EthTotal.Distinct.eraseOneOfPoint
declarations.signature:
theorem Distinct.eraseOneOfPoint {a : A} (dec : ∀ b : A, Decidable (b = a)) :
    ∀ {l : List A}, Distinct l → Distinct (EthTotal.eraseOneOfPoint dec l)
  | [], _ => Distinct.nil
  | x :: l, Distinct.cons hx dl =>
      match dec x with
      | isTrue hxa =>
          Eq.subst (motive := fun s => Distinct s)
            (eraseOneOfPoint_cons_pos dec hxa l).symm dl
      | isFalse hxa =>
          Eq.subst (motive := fun s => Distinct s)
            (eraseOneOfPoint_cons_neg dec hxa l).symm
            (Distinct.cons
              (fun hmem => hx (memOfMemEraseOneOfPoint dec l hmem))
              (Distinct.eraseOneOfPoint dec dl))

declarations.signature:
theorem Distinct.eraseOne [inst : DecidableEq A] (a : A) :
    ∀ {l : List A}, Distinct l → Distinct (EthTotal.eraseOne a l)

declarations.name: EthTotal.eraseOneOfPoint_middle
declarations.signature:
theorem eraseOneOfPoint_middle {a : A} (dec : ∀ b : A, Decidable (b = a)) :
    ∀ {l₁ : List A}, a ∉ l₁ → ∀ l₂ : List A,
      eraseOneOfPoint dec (l₁ ++ a :: l₂) = l₁ ++ l₂

declarations.name: EthTotal.searchPosSplit
declarations.signature:
def searchPosSplit (f : A → ℕ) :
    ∀ l : List A,
      (Σ' (b : A) (l₁ : List A) (l₂ : List A),
        (∀ c ∈ l₁, f c = 0) ∧ l = l₁ ++ b :: l₂ ∧ 0 < f b)
        ⊕' (∀ c ∈ l, f c = 0)
  | [] => PSum.inr (fun _c hc => absurd hc notMemNil)
  | x :: l =>
      match hfx : f x with
      | y + 1 =>
          PSum.inl
            ⟨x, [], l, (fun _c hc => absurd hc notMemNil), rfl,
             Eq.subst (motive := fun n => 0 < n) hfx.symm (Nat.succ_pos y)⟩
      | 0 =>
          match searchPosSplit f l with
          | PSum.inl ⟨b, l₁, l₂, hz, he, hp⟩ =>
              PSum.inl
                ⟨b, x :: l₁, l₂,
                 (fun c hc =>
                   memConsElim hc
                     (fun hcx => Eq.trans (congrArg f hcx) hfx)
                     (fun hct => hz c hct)),
                 congrArg (fun t => x :: t) he, hp⟩
          | PSum.inr hz =>
              PSum.inr
                (fun c hc =>
                  memConsElim hc
                    (fun hcx => Eq.trans (congrArg f hcx) hfx)
                    (fun hct => hz c hct))

EthTotal.searchMemOfPointOn
declarations.signature:
def searchMemOfPointOn {a : A} :
    ∀ (l : List A), (∀ b ∈ l, Decidable (a = b)) →
      (Σ' (l₁ : List A) (l₂ : List A), a ∉ l₁ ∧ l = l₁ ++ a :: l₂)

  | [], _ => PSum.inr notMemNil
  | x :: l, dec =>

      | isTrue hax =>

      | isFalse hax =>

              (fun b hb => dec b (List.Mem.tail x hb)) with

              PSum.inl

  | isTrue _, isTrue _ => rfl
  | isFalse _, isFalse _ => rfl
  | isTrue h, isFalse h' => absurd h h'
  | isFalse h', isTrue h => absurd h h'

declarations.name: EthTotal.eraseOneOfPoint_congr
declarations.signature:
theorem eraseOneOfPoint_congr {a : A} (dec dec' : ∀ b : A, Decidable (b = a)) :
    ∀ l : List A, eraseOneOfPoint dec l = eraseOneOfPoint dec' l
  | [] => rfl
  | x :: l =>
      Eq.trans
        (congrArg
          (fun d : Decidable (x = a) =>
            @ite (List A) (x = a) d l (x :: eraseOneOfPoint dec l))
          (decidable_unique (dec x) (dec' x)))
        (congrArg
          (fun t : List A => @ite (List A) (x = a) (dec' x) l (x :: t))
          (eraseOneOfPoint_congr dec dec' l))

declarations.name: EthTotal.eraseOneOfPoint_eq_eraseOne
EthTotal.eraseOneOfPointOn_congr
declarations.signature:
theorem eraseOneOfPointOn_congr {a : A} :
    ∀ (l : List A) (dec dec' : ∀ b ∈ l, Decidable (b = a)),
      eraseOneOfPointOn l dec = eraseOneOfPointOn l dec'
  | [], _, _ => rfl
  | x :: l, dec, dec' =>
      Eq.trans
        (congrArg
          (fun d : Decidable (x = a) =>
            @ite (List A) (x = a) d l
              (x :: eraseOneOfPointOn l
                (fun b hb => dec b (List.Mem.tail x hb))))
          (decidable_unique (dec x (List.Mem.head l))
            (dec' x (List.Mem.head l))))
        (congrArg
          (fun t : List A =>
            @ite (List A) (x = a) (dec' x (List.Mem.head l)) l (x :: t))
          (eraseOneOfPointOn_congr l
            (fun b hb => dec b (List.Mem.tail x hb))
            (fun b hb => dec' b (List.Mem.tail x hb))))

declarations.name: EthTotal.eraseOneOfPointOn_eq_eraseOneOfPoint
declarations.signature:
theorem eraseOneOfPointOn_eq_eraseOneOfPoint {a : A}
    (dec : ∀ b : A, Decidable (b = a)) :
    ∀ (l : List A) (decOn : ∀ b ∈ l, Decidable (b = a)),
      eraseOneOfPointOn l decOn = eraseOneOfPoint dec l
  | [], _ => rfl
  | x :: l, decOn =>
      Eq.trans
        (congrArg
          (fun d : Decidable (x = a) =>
            @ite (List A) (x = a) d l
              (x :: eraseOneOfPointOn l
                (fun b hb => decOn b (List.Mem.tail x hb))))
          (decidable_unique (decOn x (List.Mem.head l)) (dec x)))
        (congrArg
          (fun t : List A => @ite (List A) (x = a) (dec x) l (x :: t))
          (eraseOneOfPointOn_eq_eraseOneOfPoint dec l
            (fun b hb => decOn b (List.Mem.tail x hb))))

declarations.signature:
def supportOf (f : A → ℕ) : List A → List A
  | [] => []
  | x :: l => if f x = 0 then supportOf f l else x :: supportOf f l

declarations.name: EthTotal.supportOf_nil
declarations.signature: theorem supportOf_nil (f : A → ℕ) : supportOf f ([] : List A) = []

declarations.name: EthTotal.supportOf_cons_zero
declarations.signature:
theorem supportOf_cons_zero (f : A → ℕ) {x : A} (h : f x = 0) (l : List A) :
    supportOf f (x :: l) = supportOf f l

declarations.name: EthTotal.supportOf_cons_pos
declarations.signature:

declarations.name: EthTotal.memOfMemSupportOf
declarations.signature:
theorem memOfMemSupportOf (f : A → ℕ) {a : A} :
    ∀ l : List A, a ∈ supportOf f l → a ∈ l
  | [], h => absurd h notMemNil
  | x :: l, h =>
      match hfx : f x with
      | 0 =>
          List.Mem.tail x
            (memOfMemSupportOf f l
              (Eq.subst (motive := fun s => a ∈ s)
                (supportOf_cons_zero f hfx l) h))
      | _ + 1 =>
          memConsElim
            (Eq.subst (motive := fun s => a ∈ s)
              (supportOf_cons_pos f
                (fun h0 => Nat.noConfusion (Eq.trans hfx.symm h0)) l)
              h)
            (fun hax =>
              Eq.subst (motive := fun z => z ∈ x :: l) hax.symm
                (List.Mem.head l))
            (fun hat => List.Mem.tail x (memOfMemSupportOf f l hat))

declarations.name: EthTotal.ne_zero_of_mem_supportOf
declarations.signature:
theorem ne_zero_of_mem_supportOf (f : A → ℕ) {a : A} :
    ∀ l : List A, a ∈ supportOf f l → f a ≠ 0
  | [], h => absurd h notMemNil
  | x :: l, h =>
      match hfx : f x with
      | 0 =>
          ne_zero_of_mem_supportOf f l
            (Eq.subst (motive := fun s => a ∈ s)
              (supportOf_cons_zero f hfx l) h)
      | _ + 1 =>
          memConsElim
            (Eq.subst (motive := fun s => a ∈ s)
              (supportOf_cons_pos f
                (fun h0 => Nat.noConfusion (Eq.trans hfx.symm h0)) l)
              h)
            (fun hax h0 =>
              Nat.noConfusion
                (Eq.trans hfx.symm (Eq.trans (congrArg f hax).symm h0)))
            (fun hat => ne_zero_of_mem_supportOf f l hat)

declarations.name: EthTotal.memSupportOfOfMem
declarations.signature:
theorem memSupportOfOfMem (f : A → ℕ) {a : A} :
    ∀ l : List A, a ∈ l → f a ≠ 0 → a ∈ supportOf f l
  | [], h, _ => absurd h notMemNil
  | x :: l, h, hne =>
      match hfx : f x with
      | 0 =>
          Eq.subst (motive := fun s => a ∈ s)
            (supportOf_cons_zero f hfx l).symm
            (memConsElim h
              (fun hax =>
                absurd (Eq.trans (congrArg f hax) hfx) hne)
              (fun hat => memSupportOfOfMem f l hat hne))
      | _ + 1 =>
          Eq.subst (motive := fun s => a ∈ s)
            (supportOf_cons_pos f
              (fun h0 => Nat.noConfusion (Eq.trans hfx.symm h0)) l).symm
            (memConsElim h
              (fun hax =>
                Eq.subst (motive := fun z => z ∈ x :: supportOf f l) hax.symm
                  (List.Mem.head (supportOf f l)))
              (fun hat =>
                List.Mem.tail x (memSupportOfOfMem f l hat hne)))

declarations.name: EthTotal.mem_supportOf_iff
declarations.signature:
theorem mem_supportOf_iff (f : A → ℕ) (l : List A) (a : A) :
    a ∈ supportOf f l ↔ (a ∈ l ∧ f a ≠ 0)

declarations.name: EthTotal.supportOf_eq_nil_of_zero
declarations.signature:
theorem supportOf_eq_nil_of_zero (f : A → ℕ) :
    ∀ {l : List A}, (∀ a ∈ l, f a = 0) → supportOf f l = []
  | [], _ => rfl
  | x :: l, hz =>
      Eq.trans (supportOf_cons_zero f (hz x (List.Mem.head l)) l)
        (supportOf_eq_nil_of_zero f (fun a ha => hz a (List.Mem.tail x ha)))

declarations.name: EthTotal.zero_of_supportOf_eq_nil

theorem zero_of_supportOf_eq_nil (f : A → ℕ) {l : List A}

declarations.signature:
theorem supportOf_eq_nil_iff (f : A → ℕ) (l : List A) :

declarations.name: EthTotal.Distinct.supportOf
declarations.signature:
theorem Distinct.supportOf (f : A → ℕ) :
    ∀ {l : List A}, Distinct l → Distinct (EthTotal.supportOf f l)
  | [], _ => Distinct.nil
  | x :: l, Distinct.cons hx dl =>
      match hfx : f x with
      | 0 =>
          Eq.subst (motive := fun s => Distinct s)
            (supportOf_cons_zero f hfx l).symm (Distinct.supportOf f dl)
      | _ + 1 =>
          Eq.subst (motive := fun s => Distinct s)
            (supportOf_cons_pos f
              (fun h0 => Nat.noConfusion (Eq.trans hfx.symm h0)) l).symm
            (Distinct.cons
              (fun hm => hx (memOfMemSupportOf f l hm))
              (Distinct.supportOf f dl))

      | 0 =>
          Eq.trans
            (congrArg (sumOver f) (supportOf_cons_zero f hfx l))
            (Eq.trans (sumOver_supportOf f l)
              (Eq.trans (Nat.zero_add (sumOver f l)).symm
                (congrArg (fun n => n + sumOver f l) hfx.symm)))
      | _ + 1 =>
          Eq.trans
            (congrArg (sumOver f)
              (supportOf_cons_pos f
                (fun h0 => Nat.noConfusion (Eq.trans hfx.symm h0)) l))
            (congrArg (fun n => f x + n) (sumOver_supportOf f l))

    ∀ l : List A, a ∈ kernelOf f l → a ∈ l
  | [], h => absurd h notMemNil
  | x :: l, h =>
      match hfx : f x with
      | 0 =>
          memConsElim

            (fun hax =>

            (fun hat => List.Mem.tail x (memOfMemKernelOf f l hat))

            (memOfMemKernelOf f l

  | [], h, _ => absurd h notMemNil
  | x :: l, h, hz =>

            (kernelOf_cons_zero f hfx l).symm
            (memConsElim h
              (fun hax =>

      | _ + 1 =>
          Eq.subst (motive := fun s => a ∈ s)

              (fun h0 => Nat.noConfusion (Eq.trans hfx.symm h0)) l).symm
            (memConsElim h

declarations.name: EthTotal.supportOf_flipWeight
declarations.signature:
theorem supportOf_flipWeight (f : A → ℕ) :
    ∀ l : List A, supportOf (flipWeight f) l = kernelOf f l
  | [] => rfl
  | x :: l =>
      match hfx : f x with
      | 0 =>
          Eq.trans
            (supportOf_cons_pos (flipWeight f)
              (flipWeight_ne_zero_of_zero f hfx) l)
            (Eq.trans
              (congrArg (fun t => x :: t) (supportOf_flipWeight f l))
              (kernelOf_cons_zero f hfx l).symm)
      | _ + 1 =>
          let hne : f x ≠ 0

    ∀ l : List A, kernelOf (flipWeight f) l = supportOf f l

declarations.signature:
theorem sumOver_flipWeight (f : A → ℕ) :
    ∀ l : List A, sumOver (flipWeight f) l = (kernelOf f l).length
  | [] => rfl
  | x :: l =>
      match hfx : f x with
      | 0 =>
          Eq.trans
            (congrArg (fun n => n + sumOver (flipWeight f) l)
              (flipWeight_of_zero f hfx))
            (Eq.trans
              (congrArg (fun n => 1 + n) (sumOver_flipWeight f l))
              (Eq.trans (Nat.add_comm 1 (kernelOf f l).length)
                (congrArg List.length (kernelOf_cons_zero f hfx l)).symm))
      | _n + 1 =>
          let hne : f x ≠ 0

declarations.name: EthTotal.sumOver_flipWeight_flipWeight
declarations.signature:
theorem sumOver_flipWeight_flipWeight (f : A → ℕ) :
    ∀ l : List A,
      sumOver (flipWeight (flipWeight f)) l = (supportOf f l).length
  | [] => rfl
  | x :: l =>
      match hfx : f x with
      | 0 =>
          Eq.trans
            (congrArg
              (fun n => n + sumOver (flipWeight (flipWeight f)) l)
              (flipWeight_flipWeight_of_zero f hfx))
            (Eq.trans
              (Nat.zero_add (sumOver (flipWeight (flipWeight f)) l))
              (Eq.trans (sumOver_flipWeight_flipWeight f l)
                (congrArg List.length (supportOf_cons_zero f hfx l)).symm))
      | _n + 1 =>
          let hne : f x ≠ 0

    (wd : ConfinedRecorded W ([] : List A) L M')
    (hb : 0 < burned tx.trace) (hm : 0 < minted wd.trace) :
    M.supply < M'.supply

declarations.name: EthTotal.block_endpoints_order_free
declarations.signature:
theorem block_endpoints_order_free {W B : List A} {L M N : Ledger A}
    (tx : ConfinedRecorded ([] : List A) B L M)
    (wd : ConfinedRecorded W ([] : List A) M N) :
    N.supply + burned tx.trace = L.supply + minted wd.trace

declarations.name: EthTotal.block_gross_excess_detects_both
declarations.signature:
theorem block_gross_excess_detects_both {W B : List A} {L M N : Ledger A}
    (tx : ConfinedRecorded ([] : List A) B L M)

    (hb : 0 < burned tx.trace) (hm : 0 < minted wd.trace) :

          (ConfinedRecorded.blockMorphism tx wd).toRecorded).burn
        - (Accounting.normal L N).burn

declarations.name: EthTotal.a_cover_splits_at_any_live_account
declarations.signature:
theorem a_cover_splits_at_any_live_account (L : Ledger A) (d : A)
    (l₁ l₂ : List A) (hsplit : L.live = l₁ ++ d :: l₂) :
    L.supply = L.bal d + sumOver L.bal (l₁ ++ l₂)

declarations.name: EthTotal.the_correction_term_is_exactly_the_mirror_balance
declarations.signature:
theorem the_correction_term_is_exactly_the_mirror_balance (L : Ledger A)
    (d : A) (l₁ l₂ : List A) (hsplit : L.live = l₁ ++ d :: l₂) (cl : ℕ) :
    L.supply + cl = (sumOver L.bal (l₁ ++ l₂) + cl) + L.bal d

declarations.name: EthTotal.the_naive_total_is_strictly_larger
declarations.signature:
theorem the_naive_total_is_strictly_larger (L : Ledger A) (d : A)
    (l₁ l₂ : List A) (hsplit : L.live = l₁ ++ d :: l₂) (cl : ℕ)

    sumOver L.bal (l₁ ++ l₂) + cl < L.supply + cl

declarations.name: EthTotal.a_single_ledger_supply_cannot_span_two_books
declarations.signature:
theorem a_single_ledger_supply_cannot_span_two_books (L : Ledger A) (d : A)
    (l₁ l₂ : List A) (hsplit : L.live = l₁ ++ d :: l₂) (cl : ℕ)

    (haudit : L.supply + cl = sumOver L.bal (l₁ ++ l₂) + cl) : False

declarations.name: EthTotal.a_saturating_debit_keeps_the_shortfall
declarations.signature:
theorem a_saturating_debit_keeps_the_shortfall (b d : ℕ) :
    (b - d) + min d b = b

declarations.name: EthTotal.a_saturating_debit_is_exact_iff_covered
declarations.signature:
theorem a_saturating_debit_is_exact_iff_covered (b d : ℕ) :
    (b - d) + d = b ↔ d ≤ b

declarations.name: EthTotal.a_saturating_debit_reports_zero_on_overdraft
declarations.signature:
theorem a_saturating_debit_reports_zero_on_overdraft (b d : ℕ) (h : b < d) :
    b - d = 0

declarations.name: EthTotal.the_same_operator_is_forbidden_here_and_specified_there
declarations.signature:
theorem the_same_operator_is_forbidden_here_and_specified_there (b d : ℕ)
    (h : b < d) :
    (b - d = 0)
      ∧ ((b - d) + d = b ↔ d ≤ b)
      ∧ ((b - d) + min d b = b)

declarations.name: EthTotal.a_quantized_output_has_no_value_below_its_quantum
declarations.signature:
theorem a_quantized_output_has_no_value_below_its_quantum :
    ∀ q d : ℕ, q * d = 0 ∨ d ≤ q * d
  | 0, d => Or.inl (Nat.zero_mul d)
  | k + 1, d =>
      Or.inr
        (Eq.subst (motive := fun n : ℕ => d ≤ n) (Nat.succ_mul k d).symm
          (Nat.le_add_left d (k * d)))

declarations.name: EthTotal.a_quantized_output_below_the_quantum_is_zero
declarations.signature:
theorem a_quantized_output_below_the_quantum_is_zero {q d : ℕ}
    (h : q * d < d) : q * d = 0

declarations.name: EthTotal.the_collapsed_band_is_monotone_in_the_quantum
declarations.signature:
theorem the_collapsed_band_is_monotone_in_the_quantum {d d' v : ℕ}
    (h : d' ≤ d) (hv : v < d') : v < d

declarations.name: EthTotal.a_finer_quantum_collapses_a_narrower_band
declarations.signature:
theorem a_finer_quantum_collapses_a_narrower_band {d d' : ℕ} (h : d' ≤ d) :
    (∀ v : ℕ, v < d' → v < d)
      ∧ (∀ q : ℕ, q * d' = 0 ∨ d' ≤ q * d')

declarations.name: EthTotal.a_quantization_carries_a_remainder
declarations.signature:
theorem a_quantization_carries_a_remainder (n : ℕ) :
    evenFloor n + parity n = n

declarations.name: EthTotal.a_quantized_value_lies_on_its_lattice
declarations.signature:
theorem a_quantized_value_lies_on_its_lattice (n : ℕ) :
    parity (evenFloor n) = 0

declarations.name: EthTotal.the_lattice_points_are_exactly_the_fixed_points
declarations.signature:
theorem the_lattice_points_are_exactly_the_fixed_points (n : ℕ) :
    evenFloor n = n ↔ parity n = 0

declarations.name: EthTotal.quantization_is_idempotent
declarations.signature:
theorem quantization_is_idempotent (n : ℕ) :
    evenFloor (evenFloor n) = evenFloor n

declarations.name: EthTotal.the_residue_is_collapsed_to_zero
declarations.signature:
theorem the_residue_is_collapsed_to_zero (n : ℕ) :
    evenFloor (parity n) = 0

declarations.name: EthTotal.the_quantization_defect_is_the_carry
declarations.signature:
theorem the_quantization_defect_is_the_carry (a b : ℕ) :
    half (a + b) = (half a + half b) + carry a b

declarations.name: EthTotal.quantization_collapses_its_band_at_every_lattice
declarations.signature:
theorem quantization_collapses_its_band_at_every_lattice (n : ℕ) :
    (evenFloor (parity n) = 0 ∧ evenFloor n + parity n = n)
      ∧ (∀ q d : ℕ, q * d = 0 ∨ d ≤ q * d)

declarations.name: EthTotal.a_two_way_split_is_exact
declarations.signature: theorem a_two_way_split_is_exact (w a : ℕ) (h : a ≤ w) : a + (w - a) = w

declarations.name: EthTotal.the_split_remainder_is_one_sided
declarations.signature:
theorem the_split_remainder_is_one_sided (w a : ℕ) (h : a ≤ w) :
    a + (w - a) = w ∧ w - (w - a) = a

declarations.name: EthTotal.a_rounded_share_never_exceeds_the_whole
declarations.signature:
theorem a_rounded_share_never_exceeds_the_whole {w a : ℕ} (h : a ≤ w) :
    a + (w - a) = w ∧ w - (w - a) = a

declarations.name: EthTotal.supply_destroy_ne

theorem supply_destroy_ne [DecidableEq A] (L : Ledger A) (a : A)
    (ha : a ∈ L.live) (hpos : 0 < L.bal a) :
    ((L.setBal a 0 ha).eraseLive a (Ledger.destroy_guard L a ha)).supply

declarations.name: EthTotal.supply_destroy_le
declarations.signature:
theorem supply_destroy_le [DecidableEq A] (L : Ledger A) (a : A)
    (ha : a ∈ L.live) :
    ((L.setBal a 0 ha).eraseLive a (Ledger.destroy_guard L a ha)).supply
      ≤ L.supply

declarations.name: EthTotal.burn_witness_of_destroy
declarations.signature:
theorem burn_witness_of_destroy [DecidableEq A] (L : Ledger A) (a : A)
    (ha : a ∈ L.live) (hpos : 0 < L.bal a) {τ : Trace A} {M B : List A}
    (hacc :
      ((L.setBal a 0 ha).eraseLive a (Ledger.destroy_guard L a ha)).supply
        + burned τ = L.supply + minted τ)
    (hc : SiteConfined M B τ) :
    ∃ (s : A) (v : ℕ), Ev.burn s v ∈ τ ∧ 0 < v ∧ s ∈ B

declarations.name: EthTotal.no_empty_burnSig_of_destroy
declarations.signature:
theorem no_empty_burnSig_of_destroy [DecidableEq A] (L : Ledger A) (a : A)
    (ha : a ∈ L.live) (hpos : 0 < L.bal a) {τ : Trace A} {M : List A}
    (hacc :
      ((L.setBal a 0 ha).eraseLive a (Ledger.destroy_guard L a ha)).supply
        + burned τ = L.supply + minted τ)
    (hc : SiteConfined M ([] : List A) τ) : False

declarations.name: EthTotal.burn_at_singleton_of_destroy
declarations.signature:
theorem burn_at_singleton_of_destroy [DecidableEq A] (L : Ledger A) (a : A)
    (ha : a ∈ L.live) (hpos : 0 < L.bal a) {τ : Trace A} {M : List A} {x : A}
    (hacc :
      ((L.setBal a 0 ha).eraseLive a (Ledger.destroy_guard L a ha)).supply
        + burned τ = L.supply + minted τ)
    (hc : SiteConfined M [x] τ) :
    ∃ v : ℕ, Ev.burn x v ∈ τ ∧ 0 < v

declarations.name: EthTotal.no_neutral_record_of_destroy
declarations.signature:
theorem no_neutral_record_of_destroy [DecidableEq A] (L : Ledger A) (a : A)
    (ha : a ∈ L.live) (hpos : 0 < L.bal a) :
    ¬ Nonempty
        (ConfinedRecorded ([] : List A) ([] : List A) L
          ((L.setBal a 0 ha).eraseLive a (Ledger.destroy_guard L a ha)))

declarations.name: EthTotal.record_of_destroy_of_mem
declarations.signature:
def record_of_destroy_of_mem [DecidableEq A] (L : Ledger A) (a : A)
    (ha : a ∈ L.live) {B : List A} (hs : a ∈ B) :
    ConfinedRecorded ([] : List A) B L

declarations.name: EthTotal.destroy_burnSig_dichotomy
declarations.signature:
theorem destroy_burnSig_dichotomy [DecidableEq A] (L : Ledger A) (a : A)
    (ha : a ∈ L.live) (hpos : 0 < L.bal a) :
    (¬ Nonempty
        (ConfinedRecorded ([] : List A) ([] : List A) L

declarations.signature:
theorem burned_forced_of_destroy [DecidableEq A] (L : Ledger A) (a : A)

    (F : ConfinedRecorded ([] : List A) B L

theorem cap_not_additive :

theorem cap_is_not_additive :

declarations.name: EthTotal.cap_strictly_subadditive_witness
declarations.signature:
theorem cap_strictly_subadditive_witness :

declarations.name: EthTotal.per_frame_cap_never_undercounts
declarations.signature:
theorem per_frame_cap_never_undercounts (a b c : ℕ) :

theorem per_frame_cap_may_overcount :
    ∃ a b c : ℕ, min (a + b) c < min a c + min b c

declarations.name: EthTotal.cap_exact_iff_no_saturation
declarations.signature:
theorem cap_exact_iff_no_saturation (a b c : ℕ) (ha : a ≤ c) (hb : b ≤ c) :
    min (a + b) c = min a c + min b c ↔ a + b ≤ c

declarations.name: EthTotal.cap_idempotent
declarations.signature: theorem cap_idempotent (a c : ℕ) : min (min a c) c = min a c

declarations.name: EthTotal.cap_monotone
declarations.signature: theorem cap_monotone {a b : ℕ} (h : a ≤ b) (c : ℕ) : min a c ≤ min b c

declarations.name: EthTotal.cap_is_interior
declarations.signature: theorem cap_is_interior (c : ℕ) : IsInteriorOperator Nat.le (fun x => min x c)

declarations.name: EthTotal.interior_never_additive_with_unit
declarations.signature:
theorem interior_never_additive_with_unit :

declarations.name: EthTotal.cap_three_frames
declarations.signature:
theorem cap_three_frames (a b d c : ℕ) :

declarations.name: EthTotal.cap_frames_gap_grows
declarations.signature:
theorem cap_frames_gap_grows :
    min ((1 : ℕ) + (1 + 1)) 1 < min (1 : ℕ) 1 + (min (1 : ℕ) 1 + min (1 : ℕ) 1)

declarations.name: EthTotal.half_defect_is_exactly_the_carry
declarations.signature:
theorem half_defect_is_exactly_the_carry (a b : ℕ) :

declarations.name: EthTotal.carry_is_the_parity_meet
declarations.signature:
theorem carry_is_the_parity_meet (a b : ℕ) :
    carry a b = min (parity a) (parity b)

declarations.name: EthTotal.half_additive_iff_no_carry
declarations.signature:
theorem half_additive_iff_no_carry (a b : ℕ) :
    half (a + b) = half a + half b ↔ carry a b = 0

declarations.name: EthTotal.half_is_not_additive
declarations.signature: theorem half_is_not_additive : half (1 + 1) ≠ half 1 + half 1

declarations.name: EthTotal.splitting_error_is_at_most_one
declarations.signature:
theorem splitting_error_is_at_most_one (a b : ℕ) :
    half (a + b) ≤ (half a + half b) + 1

declarations.name: EthTotal.both_odd_is_the_only_defect
declarations.signature:
theorem both_odd_is_the_only_defect (a b : ℕ) :
    half (a + b) ≠ half a + half b
      ↔ (parity a ≠ 0 ∧ parity b ≠ 0)

declarations.name: EthTotal.value_and_carry_form_a_monoid
declarations.signature:
theorem value_and_carry_form_a_monoid :
    IsMonoid (extMul Nat.add carry) ((0, 0) : ℕ × ℕ)

declarations.name: EthTotal.extension_asymmetry
declarations.signature:
theorem extension_asymmetry (a b : ℕ) :
    extProj (extMul Nat.add carry (extSect a) (extSect b)) = a + b
      ∧ (extMul Nat.add carry (extSect a) (extSect b) = extSect (a + b)
          ↔ carry a b = 0)

declarations.name: EthTotal.value_only_is_not_a_hom
declarations.signature:
theorem value_only_is_not_a_hom :
    extMul Nat.add carry (extSect 1) (extSect 1) ≠ extSect (1 + 1)

declarations.name: EthTotal.detour_vanishes_iff_between
declarations.signature:
theorem detour_vanishes_iff_between (x y z : ℕ) :
    Bal.detour x y z = 0 ↔ (min x z ≤ y ∧ y ≤ max x z)

declarations.name: EthTotal.two_cocycles_obey_the_same_law
declarations.signature:
theorem two_cocycles_obey_the_same_law :
    (∀ a b c : ℕ,
        carry a b + carry (a + b) c = carry b c + carry a (b + c))
      ∧ (∀ x y z w : ℕ,
          Bal.detour x y z + Bal.detour x z w
            = Bal.detour y z w + Bal.detour x y w)

declarations.name: EthTotal.neither_cocycle_is_trivial
declarations.signature:
theorem neither_cocycle_is_trivial :
    carry 1 1 ≠ 0 ∧ Bal.detour 0 1 0 ≠ 0

declarations.name: EthTotal.halving_dichotomy
declarations.signature:
theorem halving_dichotomy {x : ℕ} (f : Bal x x) :
    ((∃ g : Bal x x, g.comp g = f) ↔ parity f.burn = 0)
      ∧ (∀ g h : Bal x x, g.comp g = f → h.comp h = f → g = h)

declarations.name: EthTotal.no_halving_and_no_choice
declarations.signature:
theorem no_halving_and_no_choice {x : ℕ} (f : Bal x x)
    (h : parity f.burn ≠ 0) (g : Bal x x) : g.comp g ≠ f

declarations.name: EthTotal.Bal.central_is_constant

theorem central_is_constant (η : ∀ x : ℕ, Bal x x) (h : IsCentral η)

declarations.name: EthTotal.Bal.central_determined_by_one_point
declarations.signature:
theorem central_determined_by_one_point (η : ∀ x : ℕ, Bal x x)

declarations.name: EthTotal.Bal.central_eq_of_agree_at_zero
declarations.signature:
theorem central_eq_of_agree_at_zero (η θ : ∀ x : ℕ, Bal x x)
    (hη : IsCentral η) (hθ : IsCentral θ) (h : η 0 = θ 0) (x : ℕ) :

declarations.name: EthTotal.Bal.central_parameter_inj
declarations.signature:
theorem central_parameter_inj {k j : ℕ}

declarations.name: EthTotal.Bal.non_constant_not_central
declarations.signature:
theorem non_constant_not_central (η : ∀ x : ℕ, Bal x x) (x y : ℕ)
    (h : (η x).burn ≠ (η y).burn) : ¬ IsCentral η

declarations.name: EthTotal.Bal.supply_dependent_fee_not_central
declarations.signature:
theorem supply_dependent_fee_not_central :

declarations.name: EthTotal.Bal.central_action_adds
declarations.signature:
theorem central_action_adds (k j x : ℕ) :
    (centerShift k x).comp (centerShift j x) = centerShift (k + j) x

declarations.name: EthTotal.Bal.central_action_on_shift
declarations.signature:
theorem central_action_on_shift (m x y k : ℕ) :
    (centerShift m x).comp (shift x y k) = shift x y (m + k)

declarations.name: EthTotal.Bal.central_is_self_dual
declarations.signature:
theorem central_is_self_dual (k x : ℕ) :
    (centerShift k x).symm = centerShift k x

declarations.name: EthTotal.Bal.central_unit
declarations.signature: theorem central_unit (x : ℕ) : centerShift 0 x = Bal.id x

declarations.name: EthTotal.Bal.uniform_fee_has_no_inverse
declarations.signature:
theorem uniform_fee_has_no_inverse {k : ℕ} (hk : k ≠ 0) (g : Bal 0 0) :

declarations.name: EthTotal.Bal.uniform_fee_cannot_restore_normal
declarations.signature:
theorem uniform_fee_cannot_restore_normal {k : ℕ} (hk : k ≠ 0) (m x y : ℕ) :

declarations.name: EthTotal.Bal.excess_conversion_forces_equality
declarations.signature:
theorem excess_conversion_forces_equality {k j m m' : ℕ}
    (h : m + k = j) (h' : m' + j = k) : k = j

declarations.name: EthTotal.Bal.central_target_determined
declarations.signature:
theorem central_target_determined (k j m x y : ℕ) :
    (centerShift m x).comp (shift x y k) = shift x y j ↔ m + k = j

declarations.name: EthTotal.Bal.uniform_fee_classification
declarations.signature:
theorem uniform_fee_classification :
    (∀ k : ℕ, IsCentral (centerShift k))
      ∧ (∀ (η : ∀ x : ℕ, Bal x x), IsCentral η →
          ∀ x : ℕ, η x = centerShift ((η 0).burn) x)
      ∧ ¬ IsCentral (fun x : ℕ => shift x x x)

declarations.name: EthTotal.overflow_requires_mint

declarations.name: EthTotal.no_growth_without_mint

theorem no_growth_without_mint (Ls : ℕ → Ledger A) (bs : ℕ → ℕ)

declarations.name: EthTotal.flash_loan_impossible

theorem flash_loan_impossible (Ls : ℕ → Ledger A) (bs : ℕ → ℕ)
    (h : ∀ i : ℕ, (Ls (i + 1)).supply + bs i = (Ls i).supply + 0)
    {i n : ℕ} (hin : i ≤ n) (a : A)

declarations.signature:
theorem pair_bound_along_chain (Ls : ℕ → Ledger A) (bs ms : ℕ → ℕ)
    (h : ∀ i : ℕ, (Ls (i + 1)).supply + bs i = (Ls i).supply + ms i)

declarations.name: EthTotal.chain_bal_under_cap
declarations.signature:
theorem chain_bal_under_cap (Ls : ℕ → Ledger A) (bs ms : ℕ → ℕ)
    (h : ∀ i : ℕ, (Ls (i + 1)).supply + bs i = (Ls i).supply + ms i)

declarations.name: EthTotal.internal_churn_indep
declarations.signature:
theorem internal_churn_indep (L L' : Ledger A)
    {l₁ : List A} (d₁ : Distinct l₁)
    (hc₁ : ∀ a : A, L.bal a ≠ 0 → a ∈ l₁)
    (hc₁' : ∀ a : A, L'.bal a ≠ 0 → a ∈ l₁)
    {l₂ : List A} (d₂ : Distinct l₂)
    (hc₂ : ∀ a : A, L.bal a ≠ 0 → a ∈ l₂)
    (hc₂' : ∀ a : A, L'.bal a ≠ 0 → a ∈ l₂) :
    (Accounting.pointwise L L' l₁ d₁ hc₁ hc₁').burn
      = (Accounting.pointwise L L' l₂ d₂ hc₂ hc₂').burn

declarations.name: EthTotal.net_le_pointwise_gross
declarations.signature:
theorem net_le_pointwise_gross (L L' : Ledger A) (l : List A)
    (dl : Distinct l) (hcov : ∀ a : A, L.bal a ≠ 0 → a ∈ l)
    (hcov' : ∀ a : A, L'.bal a ≠ 0 → a ∈ l) :
    (Accounting.normal L L').burn
      ≤ (Accounting.pointwise L L' l dl hcov hcov').burn

declarations.name: EthTotal.internal_churn_pos_iff
declarations.signature:
theorem internal_churn_pos_iff (L L' : Ledger A) (l : List A)
    (dl : Distinct l) (hcov : ∀ a : A, L.bal a ≠ 0 → a ∈ l)
    (hcov' : ∀ a : A, L'.bal a ≠ 0 → a ∈ l) :
    0 < (Accounting.pointwise L L' l dl hcov hcov').burn
          - (Accounting.normal L L').burn
      ↔ (0 < (Accounting.pointwise L L' l dl hcov hcov').burn
          ∧ 0 < (Accounting.pointwise L L' l dl hcov hcov').mint)

declarations.name: EthTotal.churn_invisible_to_supply
declarations.signature:
theorem churn_invisible_to_supply (L L' : Ledger A) (l : List A)
    (dl : Distinct l) (hcov : ∀ a : A, L.bal a ≠ 0 → a ∈ l)
    (hcov' : ∀ a : A, L'.bal a ≠ 0 → a ∈ l) (hs : L'.supply = L.supply) :
    (Accounting.normal L L').burn = 0
      ∧ (Accounting.pointwise L L' l dl hcov hcov').burn
            - (Accounting.normal L L').burn
        = (Accounting.pointwise L L' l dl hcov hcov').burn

declarations.name: EthTotal.burn_audit_independent_of_cut
declarations.signature:
theorem burn_audit_independent_of_cut {Ls : ℕ → Ledger A}
    (fs : ∀ i : ℕ, Recorded (Ls i) (Ls (i + 1))) (m k m' k' : ℕ)
    (h : m + k = m' + k') :
    burned (Recorded.chain fs m).trace
        + burned (Recorded.chain (Ls := fun i => Ls (m + i))
            (fun i => fs (m + i)) k).trace
      = burned (Recorded.chain fs m').trace
        + burned (Recorded.chain (Ls := fun i => Ls (m' + i))
            (fun i => fs (m' + i)) k').trace

declarations.name: EthTotal.mint_audit_independent_of_cut
declarations.signature:
theorem mint_audit_independent_of_cut {Ls : ℕ → Ledger A}
    (fs : ∀ i : ℕ, Recorded (Ls i) (Ls (i + 1))) (m k m' k' : ℕ)
    (h : m + k = m' + k') :
    minted (Recorded.chain fs m).trace
        + minted (Recorded.chain (Ls := fun i => Ls (m + i))
            (fun i => fs (m + i)) k).trace
      = minted (Recorded.chain fs m').trace
        + minted (Recorded.chain (Ls := fun i => Ls (m' + i))
            (fun i => fs (m' + i)) k').trace

declarations.name: EthTotal.chain_discrepancy_localizes
declarations.signature:
theorem chain_discrepancy_localizes {Ls : ℕ → Ledger A}
    (fs gs : ∀ i : ℕ, Recorded (Ls i) (Ls (i + 1))) (n : ℕ)
    (h : Recorded.chain fs n ≠ Recorded.chain gs n) :
    ¬ (∀ i : ℕ, i < n → fs i = gs i)

declarations.name: EthTotal.no_suffix_undoes_burn
declarations.signature:
theorem no_suffix_undoes_burn {Ls : ℕ → Ledger A}
    (fs : ∀ i : ℕ, Recorded (Ls i) (Ls (i + 1))) {i n : ℕ} (h : i ≤ n)
    (hlt : burned (Recorded.chain fs n).trace
        < burned (Recorded.chain fs i).trace) : False

declarations.name: EthTotal.no_suffix_undoes_mint
declarations.signature:
theorem no_suffix_undoes_mint {Ls : ℕ → Ledger A}
    (fs : ∀ i : ℕ, Recorded (Ls i) (Ls (i + 1))) {i n : ℕ} (h : i ≤ n)
    (hlt : minted (Recorded.chain fs n).trace
        < minted (Recorded.chain fs i).trace) : False

declarations.name: EthTotal.parity_checksum
declarations.signature:
theorem parity_checksum {L L' : Ledger A} (f : Accounting L L') :
    parity (f.burn + f.mint)
      = parity (max L.supply L'.supply - min L.supply L'.supply)

declarations.name: EthTotal.trace_parity_checksum
declarations.signature:
theorem trace_parity_checksum {L L' : Ledger A} (f : Recorded L L') :
    parity (burned f.trace + minted f.trace)
      = parity (max L.supply L'.supply - min L.supply L'.supply)

declarations.name: EthTotal.parity_mismatch_is_corruption
declarations.signature:
theorem parity_mismatch_is_corruption {L L' : Ledger A} (f : Recorded L L')
    (h : parity (burned f.trace + minted f.trace)
        ≠ parity (max L.supply L'.supply - min L.supply L'.supply)) :
    False

declarations.name: EthTotal.no_trace_with_wrong_parity
declarations.signature:
theorem no_trace_with_wrong_parity (L L' : Ledger A)
    (h : parity (max L.supply L'.supply - min L.supply L'.supply) = 1) :
    ¬ ∃ f : Recorded L L', parity (burned f.trace + minted f.trace) = 0

declarations.name: EthTotal.no_even_trace_over_odd_gap
declarations.signature:
theorem no_even_trace_over_odd_gap (L L' : Ledger A)
    (h : parity (max L.supply L'.supply - min L.supply L'.supply) = 0) :
    ¬ ∃ f : Recorded L L', parity (burned f.trace + minted f.trace) = 1

declarations.name: EthTotal.chain_parity_checksum
declarations.signature:
theorem chain_parity_checksum {Ls : ℕ → Ledger A}
    (fs : ∀ i : ℕ, Recorded (Ls i) (Ls (i + 1))) (n : ℕ) :
    parity
        (sumOver (fun i => burned (fs i).trace) (List.range n)
          + sumOver (fun i => minted (fs i).trace) (List.range n))
      = parity
          (max (Ls 0).supply (Ls n).supply
            - min (Ls 0).supply (Ls n).supply)

declarations.name: EthTotal.Bal.meet_is_endpoint_free
declarations.signature:
theorem meet_is_endpoint_free (x y k : ℕ) :
    min (shift x y k).burn (shift x y k).mint = k

declarations.name: EthTotal.Bal.join_needs_amplitude
declarations.signature:
theorem join_needs_amplitude (x y k : ℕ) :
    max (shift x y k).burn (shift x y k).mint = (max x y - min x y) + k

declarations.name: EthTotal.Bal.total_needs_amplitude_and_half
declarations.signature:
theorem total_needs_amplitude_and_half (x y k : ℕ) :
    (shift x y k).burn + (shift x y k).mint
      = (max x y - min x y) + (k + k)

declarations.name: EthTotal.Bal.total_determines_excess_within_a_fiber
declarations.signature:
theorem total_determines_excess_within_a_fiber {x y : ℕ} (f g : Bal x y)
    (h : f.burn + f.mint = g.burn + g.mint) :
    min f.burn f.mint = min g.burn g.mint

declarations.name: EthTotal.Bal.total_does_not_determine_excess
declarations.signature:
theorem total_does_not_determine_excess (k : ℕ) :
    (shift 0 0 (k + 1)).burn + (shift 0 0 (k + 1)).mint
        = (shift 0 ((k + 1) + (k + 1)) 0).burn
          + (shift 0 ((k + 1) + (k + 1)) 0).mint
      ∧ min (shift 0 0 (k + 1)).burn (shift 0 0 (k + 1)).mint
        ≠ min (shift 0 ((k + 1) + (k + 1)) 0).burn
            (shift 0 ((k + 1) + (k + 1)) 0).mint

declarations.name: EthTotal.Bal.excess_determines_everything
declarations.signature:
theorem excess_determines_everything {x y : ℕ} (f g : Bal x y)
    (h : min f.burn f.mint = min g.burn g.mint) : f = g

declarations.name: EthTotal.Bal.five_recoveries_agree
declarations.signature:
theorem five_recoveries_agree {x y : ℕ} (f : Bal x y) :
    shift x y (min f.burn f.mint) = f
      ∧ shift x y (max f.burn f.mint - (max x y - min x y)) = f
      ∧ shift x y (half ((f.burn + f.mint) - (max x y - min x y))) = f
      ∧ shift x y (f.burn - (normal x y).burn) = f
      ∧ shift x y (f.mint - (normal x y).mint) = f

declarations.name: EthTotal.Bal.total_amp_same_parity
declarations.signature:
theorem total_amp_same_parity {x y : ℕ} (f : Bal x y) :
    parity (f.burn + f.mint) = parity (max x y - min x y)

declarations.name: EthTotal.Bal.half_recovery_is_exact
declarations.signature:
theorem half_recovery_is_exact {x y : ℕ} (f : Bal x y) :
    half ((f.burn + f.mint) - (max x y - min x y))
      = min f.burn f.mint

declarations.name: EthTotal.Bal.join_recovery_is_exact
declarations.signature:
theorem join_recovery_is_exact {x y : ℕ} (f : Bal x y) :
    max f.burn f.mint - (max x y - min x y) = min f.burn f.mint

declarations.name: EthTotal.internal_churn_closed_form
declarations.signature:
theorem internal_churn_closed_form (L L' : Ledger A) (l : List A)
    (dl : Distinct l) (hcov : ∀ a : A, L.bal a ≠ 0 → a ∈ l)
    (hcov' : ∀ a : A, L'.bal a ≠ 0 → a ∈ l) :
    Accounting.pointwise L L' l dl hcov hcov'
      = Accounting.shift L L'
          (sumOver (fun a => L.bal a - L'.bal a) l
            - (L.supply - L'.supply))

declarations.name: EthTotal.churn_is_the_meet_of_the_two_totals
declarations.signature:
theorem churn_is_the_meet_of_the_two_totals (L L' : Ledger A) (l : List A)
    (dl : Distinct l) (hcov : ∀ a : A, L.bal a ≠ 0 → a ∈ l)
    (hcov' : ∀ a : A, L'.bal a ≠ 0 → a ∈ l) :
    min (sumOver (fun a => L.bal a - L'.bal a) l)
        (sumOver (fun a => L'.bal a - L.bal a) l)
      = sumOver (fun a => L.bal a - L'.bal a) l - (L.supply - L'.supply)

declarations.name: EthTotal.total_decrease_is_net_plus_churn
declarations.signature:
theorem total_decrease_is_net_plus_churn (L L' : Ledger A) (l : List A)
    (dl : Distinct l) (hcov : ∀ a : A, L.bal a ≠ 0 → a ∈ l)
    (hcov' : ∀ a : A, L'.bal a ≠ 0 → a ∈ l) :
    sumOver (fun a => L.bal a - L'.bal a) l
      = (L.supply - L'.supply)
        + (sumOver (fun a => L.bal a - L'.bal a) l - (L.supply - L'.supply))

declarations.name: EthTotal.total_increase_is_net_plus_churn
declarations.signature:
theorem total_increase_is_net_plus_churn (L L' : Ledger A) (l : List A)
    (dl : Distinct l) (hcov : ∀ a : A, L.bal a ≠ 0 → a ∈ l)
    (hcov' : ∀ a : A, L'.bal a ≠ 0 → a ∈ l) :
    sumOver (fun a => L'.bal a - L.bal a) l
      = (L'.supply - L.supply)
        + (sumOver (fun a => L.bal a - L'.bal a) l - (L.supply - L'.supply))

declarations.name: EthTotal.churn_does_not_depend_on_the_covering
declarations.signature:
theorem churn_does_not_depend_on_the_covering (L L' : Ledger A)
    {l₁ : List A} (d₁ : Distinct l₁)
    (hc₁ : ∀ a : A, L.bal a ≠ 0 → a ∈ l₁)
    (hc₁' : ∀ a : A, L'.bal a ≠ 0 → a ∈ l₁)
    {l₂ : List A} (d₂ : Distinct l₂)
    (hc₂ : ∀ a : A, L.bal a ≠ 0 → a ∈ l₂)
    (hc₂' : ∀ a : A, L'.bal a ≠ 0 → a ∈ l₂) :
    sumOver (fun a => L.bal a - L'.bal a) l₁ - (L.supply - L'.supply)
      = sumOver (fun a => L.bal a - L'.bal a) l₂ - (L.supply - L'.supply)

declarations.name: EthTotal.churn_positive_iff_both_directions_move
declarations.signature:
theorem churn_positive_iff_both_directions_move (L L' : Ledger A)
    (l : List A) (dl : Distinct l) (hcov : ∀ a : A, L.bal a ≠ 0 → a ∈ l)
    (hcov' : ∀ a : A, L'.bal a ≠ 0 → a ∈ l) :
    0 < sumOver (fun a => L.bal a - L'.bal a) l - (L.supply - L'.supply)
      ↔ (0 < sumOver (fun a => L.bal a - L'.bal a) l
          ∧ 0 < sumOver (fun a => L'.bal a - L.bal a) l)

declarations.name: EthTotal.supply_neutral_block_is_pure_churn
declarations.signature:
theorem supply_neutral_block_is_pure_churn (L L' : Ledger A) (l : List A)
    (dl : Distinct l) (hcov : ∀ a : A, L.bal a ≠ 0 → a ∈ l)
    (hcov' : ∀ a : A, L'.bal a ≠ 0 → a ∈ l) (hs : L'.supply = L.supply) :
    sumOver (fun a => L.bal a - L'.bal a) l - (L.supply - L'.supply)
      = sumOver (fun a => L.bal a - L'.bal a) l

declarations.name: EthTotal.net_does_not_bound_churn
declarations.signature:
theorem net_does_not_bound_churn (L L' : Ledger A) :
    ¬ ∃ c : ℕ, ∀ f : Accounting L L',
        f.burn - (Accounting.normal L L').burn ≤ c

declarations.name: EthTotal.churn_is_a_function_of_state_not_of_accounting
declarations.signature:
theorem churn_is_a_function_of_state_not_of_accounting (L L' : Ledger A)
    {l₁ : List A} (d₁ : Distinct l₁)
    (hc₁ : ∀ a : A, L.bal a ≠ 0 → a ∈ l₁)
    (hc₁' : ∀ a : A, L'.bal a ≠ 0 → a ∈ l₁)
    {l₂ : List A} (d₂ : Distinct l₂)
    (hc₂ : ∀ a : A, L.bal a ≠ 0 → a ∈ l₂)
    (hc₂' : ∀ a : A, L'.bal a ≠ 0 → a ∈ l₂) :
    (sumOver (fun a => L.bal a - L'.bal a) l₁ - (L.supply - L'.supply)
        = sumOver (fun a => L.bal a - L'.bal a) l₂ - (L.supply - L'.supply))
      ∧ ¬ ∃ c : ℕ, ∀ f : Accounting L L',
          f.burn - (Accounting.normal L L').burn ≤ c

declarations.name: EthTotal.accounting_certificate_is_unique_on_the_nose
declarations.signature:
theorem accounting_certificate_is_unique_on_the_nose {L L' : Ledger A}

declarations.name: EthTotal.the_certificate_is_the_net
declarations.signature:
theorem the_certificate_is_the_net (L L' : Ledger A) :

declarations.name: EthTotal.signature_certificate_is_unique_only_up_to_inclusion
declarations.signature:
theorem signature_certificate_is_unique_only_up_to_inclusion
    {τ : Trace A} (c c' : Confinement τ) :
    ((∀ a ∈ c.mintSig, a ∈ c'.mintSig)
        ∧ (∀ a ∈ c'.mintSig, a ∈ c.mintSig))
      ∧ ((∀ a ∈ c.burnSig, a ∈ c'.burnSig)
        ∧ (∀ a ∈ c'.burnSig, a ∈ c.burnSig))

declarations.name: EthTotal.signature_equality_is_the_wrong_test

theorem signature_equality_is_the_wrong_test (x : A) :
    (∀ τ : Trace A,
        SiteConfined [x] ([] : List A) τ
          ↔ SiteConfined [x, x] ([] : List A) τ)
      ∧ ([x] : List A) ≠ [x, x]

declarations.name: EthTotal.two_certificates_two_equalities
declarations.signature:
theorem two_certificates_two_equalities {L L' : Ledger A} (x : A)
    (c c' : Accounting.Canonical L L') :
    c.cert = c'.cert
      ∧ (∀ τ : Trace A,
          SiteConfined [x] ([] : List A) τ
            ↔ SiteConfined [x, x] ([] : List A) τ)
      ∧ ([x] : List A) ≠ [x, x]

declarations.name: EthTotal.no_mint_signature_forces_a_dichotomy
declarations.signature:
theorem no_mint_signature_forces_a_dichotomy {B : List A} {s : A}
    (hs : s ∈ B) (L L' : Ledger A) :
    (¬ Nonempty (ConfinedRecorded ([] : List A) B L L')
        ∧ L.supply < L'.supply)
      ∨ (Nonempty (ConfinedRecorded ([] : List A) B L L')
        ∧ ∀ f g : ConfinedRecorded ([] : List A) B L L',
            Recorded.measure f.toRecorded = Recorded.measure g.toRecorded)

declarations.name: EthTotal.growth_without_a_mint_site_has_no_record
declarations.signature:
theorem growth_without_a_mint_site_has_no_record {B : List A}
    {L L' : Ledger A} (hlt : L.supply < L'.supply) :

declarations.name: EthTotal.a_zero_mint_is_a_legal_record
declarations.signature:
theorem a_zero_mint_is_a_legal_record (x : A) (L : Ledger A) :
    Recorded.measure (⟨[Ev.mint x 0], rfl⟩ : Recorded L L)
        = Recorded.measure (⟨([] : Trace A), rfl⟩ : Recorded L L)
      ∧ mintCount ([Ev.mint x 0] : Trace A) ≠ mintCount ([] : Trace A)

declarations.name: EthTotal.normalization_creates_events_from_nothing
declarations.signature:
theorem normalization_creates_events_from_nothing (x : A) (L : Ledger A) :
    mintCount (Recorded.id L).trace = 0
      ∧ 0 < mintCount (Recorded.normalize x (Recorded.id L)).trace

declarations.name: EthTotal.normalized_records_always_carry_both_polarities
declarations.signature:
theorem normalized_records_always_carry_both_polarities (x : A)
    {L L' : Ledger A} (g : Recorded L L') :
    mintCount (Recorded.normalize x g).trace
        = burnCount (Recorded.normalize x g).trace
      ∧ 0 < mintCount (Recorded.normalize x g).trace

declarations.name: EthTotal.counting_after_normalizing_is_the_wrong_test
declarations.signature:
theorem counting_after_normalizing_is_the_wrong_test (x : A) (L : Ledger A) :
    (mintCount (Recorded.id L).trace = 0
        ∧ 0 < mintCount (Recorded.normalize x (Recorded.id L)).trace)
      ∧ Recorded.measure (Recorded.normalize x (Recorded.id L))
        = Recorded.measure (Recorded.id L)

declarations.name: EthTotal.single_burn_site_forces_the_record
declarations.signature:
theorem single_burn_site_forces_the_record {x s s' : A} (hs : s ∈ [x])
    (hs' : s' ∈ [x]) (L L' : Ledger A) (hle : L'.supply ≤ L.supply) :
    ConfinedRecorded.canonicalBurn hs L L' hle
      = ConfinedRecorded.canonicalBurn hs' L L' hle

declarations.name: EthTotal.many_burn_sites_force_only_the_measure
declarations.signature:
theorem many_burn_sites_force_only_the_measure {B : List A} {s s' : A}
    (hs : s ∈ B) (hs' : s' ∈ B) (L L' : Ledger A)
    (hle : L'.supply ≤ L.supply) :
    Recorded.measure (ConfinedRecorded.canonicalBurn hs L L' hle).toRecorded
      = Recorded.measure
          (ConfinedRecorded.canonicalBurn hs' L L' hle).toRecorded

declarations.name: EthTotal.two_burn_sites_give_two_different_records
declarations.signature:
theorem two_burn_sites_give_two_different_records {x y : A} (hxy : x ≠ y)
    (L L' : Ledger A) (hle : L'.supply ≤ L.supply) :
    (ConfinedRecorded.canonicalBurn (B := [x, y])
        (List.Mem.head [y]) L L' hle).trace
      ≠ (ConfinedRecorded.canonicalBurn (B := [x, y])
          (List.Mem.tail x (List.Mem.head ([] : List A))) L L' hle).trace

declarations.name: EthTotal.same_accounting_two_legal_blocks
declarations.signature:
theorem same_accounting_two_legal_blocks {x y : A} (hxy : x ≠ y)
    (L L' : Ledger A) (hle : L'.supply ≤ L.supply) :
    Recorded.measure
        (ConfinedRecorded.canonicalBurn (B := [x, y])
          (List.Mem.head [y]) L L' hle).toRecorded
      = Recorded.measure
          (ConfinedRecorded.canonicalBurn (B := [x, y])
            (List.Mem.tail x (List.Mem.head ([] : List A))) L L' hle).toRecorded
    ∧ (ConfinedRecorded.canonicalBurn (B := [x, y])
          (List.Mem.head [y]) L L' hle).trace
      ≠ (ConfinedRecorded.canonicalBurn (B := [x, y])
          (List.Mem.tail x (List.Mem.head ([] : List A))) L L' hle).trace

declarations.name: EthTotal.internal_transfer_leaves_no_record
declarations.signature:
def internal_transfer_leaves_no_record {L K : Ledger A} (p : XferPath L K) :
    ConfinedRecorded ([] : List A) ([] : List A) L K

declarations.name: EthTotal.internal_transfer_trace_is_empty
declarations.signature:
theorem internal_transfer_trace_is_empty {L K : Ledger A} (p : XferPath L K) :
    (xferPathRecorded p).trace = ([] : Trace A)

declarations.name: EthTotal.any_reshuffling_records_as_the_empty_log
declarations.signature:
theorem any_reshuffling_records_as_the_empty_log [DecidableEq A]
    (L L' : Ledger A) (hlive : L'.live = L.live)
    (hsupply : L'.supply = L.supply) :
    (xferPathRecorded (XferPath.of_fiber L L' hlive hsupply).fst).trace
        = ([] : Trace A)
      ∧ minted
          (xferPathRecorded (XferPath.of_fiber L L' hlive hsupply).fst).trace
        = 0
      ∧ burned
          (xferPathRecorded (XferPath.of_fiber L L' hlive hsupply).fst).trace
        = 0

declarations.name: EthTotal.tax_and_payout_in_one_block_create_churn
declarations.signature:
theorem tax_and_payout_in_one_block_create_churn {W B : List A}
    {L M N : Ledger A}
    (tx : ConfinedRecorded ([] : List A) B L M)
    (wd : ConfinedRecorded W ([] : List A) M N)
    (hb : 0 < burned tx.trace) (hm : 0 < minted wd.trace) :
    0 < (Recorded.measure
          (ConfinedRecorded.blockMorphism tx wd).toRecorded).burn
        - (Accounting.normal L N).burn

declarations.name: EthTotal.block_dagger_reverses_the_two_phases
declarations.signature:
theorem block_dagger_reverses_the_two_phases {W B : List A} {L M N : Ledger A}
    (tx : ConfinedRecorded ([] : List A) B L M)
    (wd : ConfinedRecorded W ([] : List A) M N) :
    (ConfinedRecorded.blockMorphism tx wd).dagger
      = ConfinedRecorded.blockMorphism wd.dagger tx.dagger

declarations.name: EthTotal.Ledger.fresh_double_credit
declarations.signature:
theorem fresh_double_credit [DecidableEq A] (L : Ledger A) (s : A)
    (hs : s ∈ L.live) (R T : ℕ) :
    ((L.setBal s (L.bal s + R) hs).setBal s
        ((L.setBal s (L.bal s + R) hs).bal s + T) hs).bal s
      = (L.bal s + T) + R

declarations.name: EthTotal.Ledger.stale_double_credit
declarations.signature:
theorem stale_double_credit [DecidableEq A] (L : Ledger A) (s : A)
    (hs : s ∈ L.live) (R T : ℕ) :
    ((L.setBal s (L.bal s + R) hs).setBal s (L.bal s + T) hs).bal s
      = L.bal s + T

declarations.name: EthTotal.Ledger.stale_double_credit_loses
declarations.signature:
theorem stale_double_credit_loses [DecidableEq A] (L : Ledger A) (s : A)
    (hs : s ∈ L.live) (R T : ℕ) (hR : 0 < R) :
    ((L.setBal s (L.bal s + R) hs).setBal s (L.bal s + T) hs).bal s
      < ((L.setBal s (L.bal s + R) hs).setBal s
          ((L.setBal s (L.bal s + R) hs).bal s + T) hs).bal s

declarations.name: EthTotal.Ledger.stale_double_credit_gap
declarations.signature:
theorem stale_double_credit_gap [DecidableEq A] (L : Ledger A) (s : A)
    (hs : s ∈ L.live) (R T : ℕ) :
    ((L.setBal s (L.bal s + R) hs).setBal s (L.bal s + T) hs).bal s + R
      = ((L.setBal s (L.bal s + R) hs).setBal s
          ((L.setBal s (L.bal s + R) hs).bal s + T) hs).bal s

declarations.name: EthTotal.Ledger.distinct_credits_are_order_free
declarations.signature:
theorem distinct_credits_are_order_free [DecidableEq A] (L : Ledger A)
    (s c : A) (hs : s ∈ L.live) (hc : c ∈ L.live) (R T : ℕ) (hcs : c ≠ s) :
    ((L.setBal s (L.bal s + R) hs).setBal c (L.bal c + T) hc).bal c
      = ((L.setBal s (L.bal s + R) hs).setBal c
          ((L.setBal s (L.bal s + R) hs).bal c + T) hc).bal c

declarations.name: EthTotal.Ledger.stale_credit_supply_gap
declarations.signature:
theorem stale_credit_supply_gap (M N N' : Ledger A) (s : A) (b R T : ℕ)
    (hN : N.supply + M.bal s = M.supply + (b + T))
    (hN' : N'.supply + M.bal s = M.supply + ((b + R) + T)) :
    N.supply + R = N'.supply

declarations.name: EthTotal.Ledger.stale_credit_supply_lt
declarations.signature:
theorem stale_credit_supply_lt (M N N' : Ledger A) (s : A) (b R T : ℕ)
    (hN : N.supply + M.bal s = M.supply + (b + T))
    (hN' : N'.supply + M.bal s = M.supply + ((b + R) + T)) (hR : 0 < R) :
    N.supply < N'.supply

declarations.name: EthTotal.Ledger.two_balances_bounded
declarations.signature:
theorem two_balances_bounded (L : Ledger A) (a b : A) (hba : b ≠ a) :
    L.bal a + L.bal b ≤ L.supply

declarations.name: EthTotal.Ledger.no_ledger_with_two_bal_gt_supply
declarations.signature:
theorem no_ledger_with_two_bal_gt_supply (L : Ledger A) (a b : A)
    (hba : b ≠ a) (h : L.supply < L.bal a + L.bal b) : False

declarations.name: EthTotal.Ledger.pair_bal_le_supply_invariant
declarations.signature:
theorem pair_bal_le_supply_invariant (L : Ledger A) (a b : A) (hba : b ≠ a) :
    ¬ (L.supply < L.bal a + L.bal b)

declarations.name: EthTotal.Ledger.bal_credit_after_zero
declarations.signature:
theorem bal_credit_after_zero [DecidableEq A] (L : Ledger A) (a : A)
    (ha : a ∈ L.live) (v : ℕ) :
    ((L.setBal a 0 ha).setBal a (((L.setBal a 0 ha).bal a) + v) ha).bal a = v

declarations.name: EthTotal.Ledger.destroy_guard_invalidated_by_credit
declarations.signature:
theorem destroy_guard_invalidated_by_credit [DecidableEq A] (L : Ledger A)
    (a : A) (ha : a ∈ L.live) (v : ℕ) (hv : v ≠ 0) :
    ((L.setBal a 0 ha).setBal a (((L.setBal a 0 ha).bal a) + v) ha).bal a ≠ 0

declarations.name: EthTotal.Ledger.destroy_guard_survives_credit_iff
declarations.signature:
theorem destroy_guard_survives_credit_iff [DecidableEq A] (L : Ledger A)
    (a : A) (ha : a ∈ L.live) (v : ℕ) :
    ((L.setBal a 0 ha).setBal a (((L.setBal a 0 ha).bal a) + v) ha).bal a = 0
      ↔ v = 0

declarations.name: EthTotal.Ledger.supply_zero_credit_destroy
declarations.signature:
theorem supply_zero_credit_destroy (L L₁ L₂ D : Ledger A) (a : A) (v : ℕ)
    (h₁ : L₁.supply + L.bal a = L.supply)
    (h₂ : L₂.supply = L₁.supply + v)
    (h₃ : D.supply + L₂.bal a = L₂.supply)
    (h₄ : L₂.bal a = v) :
    D.supply + L.bal a = L.supply

declarations.name: EthTotal.Ledger.supply_zero_destroy_credit
declarations.signature:
theorem supply_zero_destroy_credit (L L₁ D₀ M E : Ledger A) (a : A) (v : ℕ)
    (h₁ : L₁.supply + L.bal a = L.supply)
    (h₂ : D₀.supply = L₁.supply)
    (h₃ : M.supply = D₀.supply)
    (h₄ : E.supply + M.bal a = M.supply + v)
    (h₅ : M.bal a = 0) :
    E.supply + L.bal a = L.supply + v

declarations.name: EthTotal.Ledger.supply_credit_then_destroy
declarations.signature:
theorem supply_credit_then_destroy [DecidableEq A] (L : Ledger A) (a : A)
    (ha : a ∈ L.live) (v : ℕ) :
    (((((L.setBal a 0 ha).setBal a (((L.setBal a 0 ha).bal a) + v)
              ha).setBal a 0 ha).eraseLive a
          (destroy_guard
            ((L.setBal a 0 ha).setBal a (((L.setBal a 0 ha).bal a) + v) ha) a
            ha)).supply)
        + L.bal a
      = L.supply

declarations.name: EthTotal.Ledger.supply_destroy_then_credit
declarations.signature:
theorem supply_destroy_then_credit [DecidableEq A] (L : Ledger A) (a : A)
    (ha : a ∈ L.live) (v : ℕ) :
    (((((L.setBal a 0 ha).eraseLive a (destroy_guard L a ha)).addLive a
            (destroy_notMem L a ha)).setBal a v
          (List.Mem.head
            ((L.setBal a 0 ha).eraseLive a (destroy_guard L a ha)).live)).supply)
        + L.bal a
      = L.supply + v

declarations.name: EthTotal.Ledger.credit_destroy_supply_gap
declarations.signature:
theorem credit_destroy_supply_gap (L : Ledger A) (a : A) (v : ℕ)
    (D E : Ledger A)
    (h₁ : D.supply + L.bal a = L.supply)
    (h₂ : E.supply + L.bal a = L.supply + v) :
    E.supply = D.supply + v

declarations.name: EthTotal.Ledger.credit_destroy_ne
declarations.signature:
theorem credit_destroy_ne (L : Ledger A) (a : A) (v : ℕ) (hv : v ≠ 0)
    (D E : Ledger A)
    (h₁ : D.supply + L.bal a = L.supply)
    (h₂ : E.supply + L.bal a = L.supply + v) :
    D.supply ≠ E.supply

declarations.name: EthTotal.Ledger.credit_destroy_order_matters
declarations.signature:
theorem credit_destroy_order_matters [DecidableEq A] (L : Ledger A) (a : A)
    (ha : a ∈ L.live) (v : ℕ) (hv : v ≠ 0) :
    (((((L.setBal a 0 ha).setBal a (((L.setBal a 0 ha).bal a) + v)
              ha).setBal a 0 ha).eraseLive a
          (destroy_guard
            ((L.setBal a 0 ha).setBal a (((L.setBal a 0 ha).bal a) + v) ha) a
            ha)).supply)
      ≠ (((((L.setBal a 0 ha).eraseLive a (destroy_guard L a ha)).addLive a
              (destroy_notMem L a ha)).setBal a v
            (List.Mem.head
              ((L.setBal a 0 ha).eraseLive a
                (destroy_guard L a ha)).live)).supply)

declarations.name: EthTotal.Ledger.credit_then_destroy_balanced
declarations.signature:
theorem credit_then_destroy_balanced (L D : Ledger A) (a : A) (v : ℕ)
    (h : D.supply + L.bal a = L.supply) :
    D.supply + (L.bal a + v) = L.supply + v

declarations.name: EthTotal.Ledger.credit_then_destroy_meet
declarations.signature: theorem credit_then_destroy_meet (c v : ℕ) : min (c + v) v = v

declarations.name: EthTotal.staging_splits_the_reported_burn
declarations.signature:
theorem staging_splits_the_reported_burn (L M N : Ledger A) :
    (L.supply - N.supply) + Accounting.detour L M N
      = (L.supply - M.supply) + (M.supply - N.supply)

declarations.name: EthTotal.staging_splits_the_reported_mint
declarations.signature:
theorem staging_splits_the_reported_mint (L M N : Ledger A) :
    (N.supply - L.supply) + Accounting.detour L M N
      = (M.supply - L.supply) + (N.supply - M.supply)

declarations.name: EthTotal.staging_never_reduces_the_reported_burn
declarations.signature:
theorem staging_never_reduces_the_reported_burn (L M N : Ledger A) :
    (L.supply - N.supply)
      ≤ (L.supply - M.supply) + (M.supply - N.supply)

declarations.name: EthTotal.detour_vanishes_iff_the_stage_is_between
declarations.signature:
theorem detour_vanishes_iff_the_stage_is_between (L M N : Ledger A) :
    Accounting.detour L M N = 0
      ↔ (min L.supply N.supply ≤ M.supply
          ∧ M.supply ≤ max L.supply N.supply)

declarations.name: EthTotal.a_stage_outside_the_interval_inflates_the_report
declarations.signature:
theorem a_stage_outside_the_interval_inflates_the_report (L M N : Ledger A)
    (h : ¬ (min L.supply N.supply ≤ M.supply
            ∧ M.supply ≤ max L.supply N.supply)) :
    (L.supply - N.supply)
      < (L.supply - M.supply) + (M.supply - N.supply)

declarations.name: EthTotal.round_trip_costs_the_absolute_difference
declarations.signature:
theorem round_trip_costs_the_absolute_difference (L M : Ledger A) :
    Accounting.detour L M L
      = (L.supply - M.supply) + (M.supply - L.supply)

declarations.name: EthTotal.an_undone_stage_is_never_free
declarations.signature:
theorem an_undone_stage_is_never_free {L M : Ledger A}
    (h : M.supply ≠ L.supply) : Accounting.detour L M L ≠ 0

declarations.name: EthTotal.churn_composes_with_a_detour_defect
declarations.signature:
theorem churn_composes_with_a_detour_defect (L M N : Ledger A) (k j : ℕ) :
    (Accounting.shift L M k).comp (Accounting.shift M N j)
      = Accounting.shift L N (k + j + Accounting.detour L M N)

declarations.name: EthTotal.churn_is_additive_exactly_when_the_stage_is_between
declarations.signature:
theorem churn_is_additive_exactly_when_the_stage_is_between
    (L M N : Ledger A) (k j : ℕ)
    (h : min L.supply N.supply ≤ M.supply)
    (h' : M.supply ≤ max L.supply N.supply) :
    (Accounting.shift L M k).comp (Accounting.shift M N j)
      = Accounting.shift L N (k + j)

declarations.name: EthTotal.the_ledger_detour_is_a_two_cocycle
declarations.signature:
theorem the_ledger_detour_is_a_two_cocycle (L M N L' : Ledger A) :
    Accounting.detour L M N + Accounting.detour L N L'
      = Accounting.detour M N L' + Accounting.detour L M L'

declarations.name: EthTotal.detour_is_symmetric_under_reversal
declarations.signature:
theorem detour_is_symmetric_under_reversal (L M L' : Ledger A) :
    Accounting.detour L' M L = Accounting.detour L M L'

declarations.name: EthTotal.detour_at_the_endpoints_is_zero
declarations.signature:
theorem detour_at_the_endpoints_is_zero (L M : Ledger A) :
    Accounting.detour L L M = 0 ∧ Accounting.detour L M M = 0

declarations.name: EthTotal.burn_only_blocks_never_detour
declarations.signature:
theorem burn_only_blocks_never_detour {B : List A} {L M L' : Ledger A}
    (f : ConfinedRecorded ([] : List A) B L M)
    (g : ConfinedRecorded ([] : List A) B M L') :
    Accounting.detour L M L' = 0

declarations.name: EthTotal.burn_only_blocks_compose_exactly
declarations.signature:
theorem burn_only_blocks_compose_exactly {B : List A} {L M L' : Ledger A}
    (f : ConfinedRecorded ([] : List A) B L M)
    (g : ConfinedRecorded ([] : List A) B M L') :
    (Accounting.normal L M).comp (Accounting.normal M L')
      = Accounting.normal L L'

declarations.name: EthTotal.monotone_staging_is_the_only_detour_free_staging
declarations.signature:
theorem monotone_staging_is_the_only_detour_free_staging
    {B : List A} {L M L' : Ledger A}
    (f : ConfinedRecorded ([] : List A) B L M)
    (g : ConfinedRecorded ([] : List A) B M L') :
    Accounting.detour L M L' = 0
      ∧ (min L.supply L'.supply ≤ M.supply
          ∧ M.supply ≤ max L.supply L'.supply)

declarations.name: EthTotal.debit_credit_orthogonal
declarations.signature:
theorem debit_credit_orthogonal (p : ℕ × ℕ) :
    inclLeftRetract.idem (inclRightRetract.idem p) = zeroPair

declarations.name: EthTotal.credit_debit_orthogonal
declarations.signature:
theorem credit_debit_orthogonal (p : ℕ × ℕ) :
    inclRightRetract.idem (inclLeftRetract.idem p) = zeroPair

declarations.name: EthTotal.double_entry_resolution
declarations.signature:
theorem double_entry_resolution (p : ℕ × ℕ) :
    addPair (inclLeftRetract.idem p) (inclRightRetract.idem p) = p

declarations.name: EthTotal.debit_credit_jointly_monic
declarations.signature:
theorem debit_credit_jointly_monic {p q : ℕ × ℕ}
    (h₁ : projLeft p = projLeft q) (h₂ : projRight p = projRight q) : p = q

declarations.name: EthTotal.single_entry_collapses
declarations.signature:
theorem single_entry_collapses
    (h : ∀ p : ℕ × ℕ, natPairAddBiproduct.retract₁.idem p = p) (k : ℕ) :
    k = 0

declarations.name: EthTotal.single_entry_credit_collapses
declarations.signature:
theorem single_entry_credit_collapses
    (h : ∀ p : ℕ × ℕ, natPairAddBiproduct.retract₂.idem p = p) (k : ℕ) :
    k = 0

declarations.name: EthTotal.debit_projection_not_surjective
declarations.signature:
theorem debit_projection_not_surjective :
    ¬ (∀ p : ℕ × ℕ, natPairAddBiproduct.retract₁.idem p = p)

declarations.name: EthTotal.double_entry_is_forced
declarations.signature:
theorem double_entry_is_forced :
    (∀ p : ℕ × ℕ,
        addPair (inclLeftRetract.idem p) (inclRightRetract.idem p) = p)
      ∧ ¬ (∀ p : ℕ × ℕ, natPairAddBiproduct.retract₁.idem p = p)

declarations.name: EthTotal.total_does_not_determine_pair
declarations.signature:
theorem total_does_not_determine_pair :
    codiagPair ((1, 0) : ℕ × ℕ) = codiagPair ((0, 1) : ℕ × ℕ)
      ∧ ((1, 0) : ℕ × ℕ) ≠ ((0, 1) : ℕ × ℕ)

declarations.name: EthTotal.total_determines_with_endpoints
declarations.signature:
theorem total_determines_with_endpoints {x y : ℕ} (f g : Bal x y)
    (h : f.burn + f.mint = g.burn + g.mint) : f = g

declarations.name: EthTotal.scalar_audit_needs_endpoints
declarations.signature:
theorem scalar_audit_needs_endpoints :
    (codiagPair ((1, 0) : ℕ × ℕ) = codiagPair ((0, 1) : ℕ × ℕ)
        ∧ ((1, 0) : ℕ × ℕ) ≠ ((0, 1) : ℕ × ℕ))
      ∧ (∀ (x y : ℕ) (f g : Bal x y),
          f.burn + f.mint = g.burn + g.mint → f = g)

declarations.name: EthTotal.total_is_additive
declarations.signature:
theorem total_is_additive :
    IsUnitalHom addPair zeroPair Nat.add 0 codiagPair

declarations.name: EthTotal.total_is_not_multiplicative
declarations.signature:
theorem total_is_not_multiplicative :
    ¬ IsUnitalHom mulPair onePair Nat.mul 1 codiagPair

declarations.name: EthTotal.rate_scaling_breaks_double_entry
declarations.signature:
theorem rate_scaling_breaks_double_entry :
    IsUnitalHom addPair zeroPair Nat.add 0 codiagPair
      ∧ ¬ IsUnitalHom mulPair onePair Nat.mul 1 codiagPair

declarations.name: EthTotal.debit_credit_pairing_is_the_cross_term
declarations.signature:
theorem debit_credit_pairing_is_the_cross_term (p q : ℕ × ℕ) :
    normPair (addPair p q) = (normPair p + normPair q) + pairingPair p q

declarations.name: EthTotal.no_cross_term_iff_orthogonal

declarations.name: EthTotal.eraseOne_comm
declarations.signature:
theorem eraseOne_comm [inst : DecidableEq A] (a b : A) :
    ∀ l : List A, eraseOne b (eraseOne a l) = eraseOne a (eraseOne b l)
  | [] => rfl
  | x :: l =>
      match inst x a, inst x b with
      | isTrue hxa, isTrue hxb =>
          Eq.trans
            (congrArg (fun t : List A => eraseOne b t)
              (eraseOne_cons_pos hxa l))
            (Eq.trans
              (congrArg (fun z : A => eraseOne z l) (Eq.trans hxb.symm hxa))
              (congrArg (fun t : List A => eraseOne a t)
                (eraseOne_cons_pos hxb l)).symm)
      | isTrue hxa, isFalse hxb =>
          Eq.trans
            (congrArg (fun t : List A => eraseOne b t)
              (eraseOne_cons_pos hxa l))
            (Eq.trans (eraseOne_cons_pos hxa (eraseOne b l)).symm
              (congrArg (fun t : List A => eraseOne a t)
                (eraseOne_cons_neg hxb l)).symm)
      | isFalse hxa, isTrue hxb =>
          Eq.trans
            (congrArg (fun t : List A => eraseOne b t)
              (eraseOne_cons_neg hxa l))
            (Eq.trans (eraseOne_cons_pos hxb (eraseOne a l))
              (congrArg (fun t : List A => eraseOne a t)
                (eraseOne_cons_pos hxb l)).symm)
      | isFalse hxa, isFalse hxb =>
          Eq.trans
            (congrArg (fun t : List A => eraseOne b t)
              (eraseOne_cons_neg hxa l))
            (Eq.trans (eraseOne_cons_neg hxb (eraseOne a l))
              (Eq.trans
                (congrArg (fun t : List A => x :: t) (eraseOne_comm a b l))
                (Eq.trans (eraseOne_cons_neg hxa (eraseOne b l)).symm
                  (congrArg (fun t : List A => eraseOne a t)
                    (eraseOne_cons_neg hxb l)).symm)))

        = sumOver (fun i : ℕ => if i = 0 then 0 else (k + 1) + (k + 1))
            (List.range 2)
      ∧ (fun _ : ℕ => k + 1) 0
        ≠ (fun i : ℕ => if i = 0 then 0 else (k + 1) + (k + 1)) 0

      ∧ (sumOver (fun _ : ℕ => k + 1) (List.range 2)
            = sumOver (fun i : ℕ => if i = 0 then 0 else (k + 1) + (k + 1))
                (List.range 2)
          ∧ (fun _ : ℕ => k + 1) 0
            ≠ (fun i : ℕ => if i = 0 then 0 else (k + 1) + (k + 1)) 0)
