declarations.signature:
theorem no_central_endo_record (x : A) {L : Ledger A} (f : Recorded L L)
    (hm : f.comp (⟨[Ev.mint x 0], rfl⟩ : Recorded L L)
        = (⟨[Ev.mint x 0], rfl⟩ : Recorded L L).comp f)
    (hb : f.comp (⟨[Ev.burn x 0], rfl⟩ : Recorded L L)
        = (⟨[Ev.burn x 0], rfl⟩ : Recorded L L).comp f) :
    f = Recorded.id L

declarations.name: EthTotal.nonempty_record_is_detected
declarations.signature:
theorem nonempty_record_is_detected (x : A) {L : Ledger A} (f : Recorded L L)
    (h : f.trace ≠ ([] : Trace A))
    (hm : f.comp (⟨[Ev.mint x 0], rfl⟩ : Recorded L L)
        = (⟨[Ev.mint x 0], rfl⟩ : Recorded L L).comp f)
    (hb : f.comp (⟨[Ev.burn x 0], rfl⟩ : Recorded L L)
        = (⟨[Ev.burn x 0], rfl⟩ : Recorded L L).comp f) : False

declarations.name: EthTotal.only_identity_is_central
declarations.signature:
theorem only_identity_is_central (x : A) {L : Ledger A} (f : Recorded L L)
    (hm : f.comp (⟨[Ev.mint x 0], rfl⟩ : Recorded L L)
        = (⟨[Ev.mint x 0], rfl⟩ : Recorded L L).comp f)
    (hb : f.comp (⟨[Ev.burn x 0], rfl⟩ : Recorded L L)
        = (⟨[Ev.burn x 0], rfl⟩ : Recorded L L).comp f) :
    f.trace = ([] : Trace A)
      ∧ burned f.trace = 0
      ∧ minted f.trace = 0

declarations.name: EthTotal.normalizeSig_after_normalizeAmt_constant
declarations.signature:
theorem normalizeSig_after_normalizeAmt_constant (f : A → ℕ) (x : A)
    (τ σ : Trace A) :
    normalizeSig f (Trace.normalizeAmt x τ)
      = normalizeSig f (Trace.normalizeAmt x σ)

declarations.name: EthTotal.normalizeSig_after_normalizeAmt_forgets
declarations.signature:
theorem normalizeSig_after_normalizeAmt_forgets (f : A → ℕ) (x : A)
    (τ : Trace A) :
    normalizeSig f (Trace.normalizeAmt x τ) = [Ev.mint x (f x), Ev.burn x (f x)]

declarations.name: EthTotal.normalizeAmt_after_normalizeSig_keeps_sums
declarations.signature:
theorem normalizeAmt_after_normalizeSig_keeps_sums (f : A → ℕ) (x : A)
    (τ : Trace A) :
    Trace.normalizeAmt x (normalizeSig f τ)
      = [Ev.burn x (sumOver f (burnSites τ)),
         Ev.mint x (sumOver f (mintSites τ))]

declarations.name: EthTotal.normalization_order_matters
declarations.signature:
theorem normalization_order_matters (x : A) (v : ℕ) :
    normalizeSig (fun _ : A => 1) (Trace.normalizeAmt x [Ev.mint x v])
        = normalizeSig (fun _ : A => 1) (Trace.normalizeAmt x ([] : Trace A))
      ∧ Trace.normalizeAmt x (normalizeSig (fun _ : A => 1) [Ev.mint x v])
        ≠ Trace.normalizeAmt x (normalizeSig (fun _ : A => 1) ([] : Trace A))

declarations.name: EthTotal.head_of_mintOnly_not_burn
declarations.signature:
theorem head_of_mintOnly_not_burn :
    ∀ (e : Ev A) (t : Trace A),
      Trace.burnOnly (e :: t) = ([] : Trace A) → e.burnSite = none
  | Ev.mint _ _, _, _ => rfl
  | Ev.burn _ _, _, h => nomatch h

declarations.name: EthTotal.head_of_burnOnly_not_mint
declarations.signature:
theorem head_of_burnOnly_not_mint :
    ∀ (e : Ev A) (t : Trace A),
      Trace.mintOnly (e :: t) = ([] : Trace A) → e.mintSite = none
  | Ev.burn _ _, _, _ => rfl
  | Ev.mint _ _, _, h => nomatch h

declarations.name: EthTotal.mintOnly_head_burnSite
declarations.signature:
theorem mintOnly_head_burnSite (τ : Trace A) (e : Ev A) (t : Trace A)
    (h : Trace.mintOnly τ = e :: t) : e.burnSite = none

declarations.name: EthTotal.burnOnly_head_mintSite
declarations.signature:
theorem burnOnly_head_mintSite (τ : Trace A) (e : Ev A) (t : Trace A)
    (h : Trace.burnOnly τ = e :: t) : e.mintSite = none

declarations.name: EthTotal.pure_of_comm
declarations.signature:
theorem pure_of_comm : ∀ u w : Trace A,
    (∀ (e : Ev A) (t : Trace A), u = e :: t → e.burnSite = none) →
    (∀ (e : Ev A) (t : Trace A), w = e :: t → e.mintSite = none) →
    u ++ w = w ++ u →
    u = ([] : Trace A) ∨ w = ([] : Trace A)
  | [], _, _, _, _ => Or.inl rfl
  | _ :: _, [], _, _, _ => Or.inr rfl
  | m :: ms, b :: bs, hu, hw, h =>
      let hmb : m = b

declarations.name: EthTotal.fixed_by_both_is_pure
declarations.signature:
theorem fixed_by_both_is_pure (τ : Trace A)
    (h₁ : Trace.sortByPolarity τ = τ) (h₂ : Trace.sortByPolarityDual τ = τ) :
    Trace.mintOnly τ = ([] : Trace A)
      ∨ Trace.burnOnly τ = ([] : Trace A)

declarations.name: EthTotal.no_common_normal_form
declarations.signature:
theorem no_common_normal_form (τ : Trace A)
    (hm : Trace.mintOnly τ ≠ ([] : Trace A))
    (hb : Trace.burnOnly τ ≠ ([] : Trace A)) :
    ¬ (Trace.sortByPolarity τ = τ ∧ Trace.sortByPolarityDual τ = τ)

declarations.name: EthTotal.mixed_trace_has_no_common_normal_form
declarations.signature:
theorem mixed_trace_has_no_common_normal_form (x : A) (v w : ℕ) :
    ¬ (Trace.sortByPolarity ([Ev.mint x v, Ev.burn x w] : Trace A)
          = [Ev.mint x v, Ev.burn x w]
        ∧ Trace.sortByPolarityDual ([Ev.mint x v, Ev.burn x w] : Trace A)
          = [Ev.mint x v, Ev.burn x w])

declarations.name: EthTotal.id_measure_eq_realize_measure
declarations.signature:
theorem id_measure_eq_realize_measure (x : A) (L : Ledger A) :
    (Recorded.id L).measure
      = (Recorded.realize x (Accounting.id L)).measure

declarations.name: EthTotal.nothing_happened_vs_recorded_nothing
declarations.signature:
theorem nothing_happened_vs_recorded_nothing (x : A) (L : Ledger A) :
    (Recorded.id L).measure
        = (Recorded.realize x (Accounting.id L)).measure
      ∧ Recorded.id L ≠ Recorded.realize x (Accounting.id L)

declarations.name: EthTotal.id_trace_has_no_measure
declarations.signature:
theorem id_trace_has_no_measure (L : Ledger A) :
    burned (Recorded.id L).trace + minted (Recorded.id L).trace = 0

declarations.name: EthTotal.exactRetract
declarations.signature: def exactRetract (A : Type u) : Retract (Ledger A) (ExactLedger A)

declarations.name: EthTotal.exact_idem
declarations.signature:
theorem exact_idem (L : Ledger A) :
    (exactRetract A).idem L = L.normalize.toRaw

declarations.name: EthTotal.exact_idem_idem
declarations.signature:
theorem exact_idem_idem (L : Ledger A) :
    (exactRetract A).idem ((exactRetract A).idem L) = (exactRetract A).idem L

declarations.name: EthTotal.fixed_iff_kernel_free
declarations.signature:
theorem fixed_iff_kernel_free (L : Ledger A) :
    (exactRetract A).idem L = L ↔ L.kernel = ([] : List A)

declarations.name: EthTotal.fixed_iff_exact_image
declarations.signature:
theorem fixed_iff_exact_image (L : Ledger A) :
    (exactRetract A).idem L = L ↔ ∃ E : ExactLedger A, L = E.toRaw

declarations.name: EthTotal.kernel_free_iff_exact_image
declarations.signature:
theorem kernel_free_iff_exact_image (L : Ledger A) :
    L.kernel = ([] : List A) ↔ ∃ E : ExactLedger A, L = E.toRaw

declarations.name: EthTotal.normalize_injective_iff_all_kernel_free
declarations.signature:
theorem normalize_injective_iff_all_kernel_free :
    (∀ L L' : Ledger A, L.normalize = L'.normalize → L = L')
      ↔ (∀ L : Ledger A, L.kernel = ([] : List A))

declarations.name: EthTotal.exists_ledger_with_kernel
declarations.signature:
theorem exists_ledger_with_kernel (x : A) :
    ∃ L : Ledger A, L.kernel ≠ ([] : List A)

declarations.name: EthTotal.normalize_not_injective_of_site
declarations.signature:
theorem normalize_not_injective_of_site (x : A) :
    ¬ (∀ L L' : Ledger A, L.normalize = L'.normalize → L = L')

declarations.name: EthTotal.normalize_loses_exactly_the_kernel
declarations.signature:
theorem normalize_loses_exactly_the_kernel (L : Ledger A) :
    L.normalize.live.length + L.kernel.length = L.live.length

declarations.name: EthTotal.normalize_preserves_supply
declarations.signature:
theorem normalize_preserves_supply (L : Ledger A) :
    L.normalize.supply = L.supply

declarations.name: EthTotal.normalize_membership
declarations.signature:
theorem normalize_membership (L : Ledger A) (a : A) :
    a ∈ L.normalize.live ↔ L.bal a ≠ 0

declarations.name: EthTotal.addLive_invisible_to_normalize
declarations.signature:
theorem addLive_invisible_to_normalize (L : Ledger A) (a : A)
    (ha : a ∉ L.live) : (L.addLive a ha).normalize = L.normalize

declarations.name: EthTotal.eraseLive_invisible_to_normalize
declarations.signature:
theorem eraseLive_invisible_to_normalize [DecidableEq A] (L : Ledger A) (a : A)
    (h : L.bal a = 0) : (L.eraseLive a h).normalize = L.normalize

declarations.name: EthTotal.insertLive_invisible_to_normalize
declarations.signature:
theorem insertLive_invisible_to_normalize (L : Ledger A) (a : A)
    (l₁ l₂ : List A) (hsplit : L.live = l₁ ++ l₂) (ha : a ∉ L.live) :
    (L.insertLive a l₁ l₂ hsplit ha).normalize = L.normalize

declarations.name: EthTotal.create_then_clear_invisible
declarations.signature:
theorem create_then_clear_invisible [DecidableEq A] (L : Ledger A) (a : A)
    (ha : a ∉ L.live) :
    ((L.addLive a ha).eraseLive a (Ledger.addLive_bal_self L a ha)).normalize
      = L.normalize

declarations.name: EthTotal.normalize_blind_to_empty_accounts
declarations.signature:
theorem normalize_blind_to_empty_accounts (x : A) :
    ∃ L L' : Ledger A,
      L.normalize = L'.normalize
        ∧ L.supply = L'.supply
        ∧ L.live ≠ L'.live
        ∧ L.kernel ≠ L'.kernel

declarations.name: EthTotal.accounting_is_one_dimensional
declarations.signature:
theorem accounting_is_one_dimensional (L L' : Ledger A) :
    (∀ f : Accounting L L',
        f = Accounting.shift L L' (f.burn - (Accounting.normal L L').burn))
      ∧ (∀ k k' : ℕ,
          Accounting.shift L L' k = Accounting.shift L L' k' → k = k')
      ∧ Accounting.shift L L' 0 = Accounting.normal L L'

declarations.name: EthTotal.the_coordinate_is_the_excess
declarations.signature:
theorem the_coordinate_is_the_excess (L L' : Ledger A) (k : ℕ) :
    (Accounting.shift L L' k).burn - (Accounting.normal L L').burn = k

declarations.name: EthTotal.dagger_preserves_the_coordinate
declarations.signature:
theorem dagger_preserves_the_coordinate (L L' : Ledger A) (k : ℕ) :
    (Accounting.shift L L' k).symm = Accounting.shift L' L k

declarations.name: EthTotal.endomorphisms_are_the_naturals
declarations.signature:
theorem endomorphisms_are_the_naturals (L : Ledger A) :
    IsUnitalHom Nat.add 0
      (fun f g : Accounting L L => f.comp g) (Accounting.id L)
      (Accounting.shift L L)

declarations.name: EthTotal.endo_burn_is_the_coordinate
declarations.signature:
theorem endo_burn_is_the_coordinate (L : Ledger A) :
    IsInverse (fun f : Accounting L L => f.burn) (Accounting.shift L L)

declarations.name: EthTotal.endo_composition_is_addition
declarations.signature:
theorem endo_composition_is_addition {L : Ledger A} (f g : Accounting L L) :
    (f.comp g).burn = f.burn + g.burn

declarations.name: EthTotal.endo_comp_trivial_iff
declarations.signature:
theorem endo_comp_trivial_iff {L : Ledger A} (f g : Accounting L L) :
    f.comp g = Accounting.id L ↔ (f = Accounting.id L ∧ g = Accounting.id L)

declarations.name: EthTotal.churn_never_cancels
declarations.signature:
theorem churn_never_cancels {L : Ledger A} (f g : Accounting L L)
    (hf : f ≠ Accounting.id L) : f.comp g ≠ Accounting.id L

declarations.name: EthTotal.five_measures_agree_within_a_fiber
declarations.signature:
theorem five_measures_agree_within_a_fiber {x y : ℕ} (f g : Bal x y) :
    (f.burn ≤ g.burn ↔ f.mint ≤ g.mint)
      ∧ (f.burn ≤ g.burn ↔ f.burn + f.mint ≤ g.burn + g.mint)
      ∧ (f.burn ≤ g.burn ↔ min f.burn f.mint ≤ min g.burn g.mint)
      ∧ (f.burn ≤ g.burn ↔ max f.burn f.mint ≤ max g.burn g.mint)

declarations.name: EthTotal.measures_disagree_across_fibers
declarations.signature:
theorem measures_disagree_across_fibers :
    (Bal.normal 0 1).burn ≤ (Bal.normal 1 0).burn
      ∧ ¬ ((Bal.normal 0 1).mint ≤ (Bal.normal 1 0).mint)

declarations.name: EthTotal.no_cross_fiber_ranking
declarations.signature:
theorem no_cross_fiber_ranking :
    ¬ (∀ (x y x' y' : ℕ) (f : Bal x y) (g : Bal x' y'),
        f.burn ≤ g.burn → f.mint ≤ g.mint)

declarations.name: EthTotal.records_are_not_one_dimensional
declarations.signature:
theorem records_are_not_one_dimensional (x : A) (L : Ledger A) :
    ∃ f g : Recorded L L, f.measure = g.measure ∧ f.trace ≠ g.trace

declarations.name: EthTotal.accounting_collapses_what_records_keep
declarations.signature:
theorem accounting_collapses_what_records_keep (x : A) (L : Ledger A) :
    (∀ f : Accounting L L,
        f = Accounting.shift L L (f.burn - (Accounting.normal L L).burn))
      ∧ (∃ f g : Recorded L L, f.measure = g.measure ∧ f.trace ≠ g.trace)

declarations.name: EthTotal.eraseOne_removes_first_occurrence
declarations.signature:
theorem eraseOne_removes_first_occurrence [DecidableEq A] {a b : A}
    (hab : a ≠ b) :
    eraseOne a (([a, b] : List A) ++ a :: ([] : List A))
      ≠ ([a, b] : List A) ++ ([] : List A)

declarations.name: EthTotal.wrong_occurrence_invisible_to_sum
declarations.signature:
theorem wrong_occurrence_invisible_to_sum (f : A → ℕ) (a b : A) :
    sumOver f ([b, a] : List A) = sumOver f ([a, b] : List A)

declarations.name: EthTotal.silent_displacement
declarations.signature:
theorem silent_displacement [DecidableEq A] {a b : A} (hab : a ≠ b)
    (f : A → ℕ) :
    eraseOne a (([a, b] : List A) ++ a :: ([] : List A))
        ≠ ([a, b] : List A) ++ ([] : List A)
      ∧ sumOver f (eraseOne a (([a, b] : List A) ++ a :: ([] : List A)))
        = sumOver f (([a, b] : List A) ++ ([] : List A))

declarations.name: EthTotal.eraseOne_middle_needs_absence
EthTotal.erase_add_moves_position
declarations.signature:
theorem erase_add_moves_position [DecidableEq A] {x a : A} (hxa : x ≠ a) :
    a :: eraseOne a ([x, a] : List A) ≠ ([x, a] : List A)

declarations.name: EthTotal.live_order_is_observable
declarations.signature:
theorem live_order_is_observable {x y : A} (hxy : x ≠ y) :
    ∃ L L' : Ledger A,
      L.supply = L'.supply
        ∧ (∀ a : A, L.bal a = L'.bal a)
        ∧ L.live ≠ L'.live

declarations.name: EthTotal.interleaving_invisible_to_measures
declarations.signature:
theorem interleaving_invisible_to_measures (a : A) (v w : ℕ) :
    minted ([Ev.mint a v, Ev.burn a w] : Trace A)
        = minted ([Ev.burn a w, Ev.mint a v] : Trace A)
      ∧ burned ([Ev.mint a v, Ev.burn a w] : Trace A)
        = burned ([Ev.burn a w, Ev.mint a v] : Trace A)
      ∧ mintSites ([Ev.mint a v, Ev.burn a w] : Trace A)
        = mintSites ([Ev.burn a w, Ev.mint a v] : Trace A)
      ∧ burnSites ([Ev.mint a v, Ev.burn a w] : Trace A)
        = burnSites ([Ev.burn a w, Ev.mint a v] : Trace A)
      ∧ ([Ev.mint a v, Ev.burn a w] : Trace A)
        ≠ [Ev.burn a w, Ev.mint a v]

declarations.name: EthTotal.interleaving_invisible_to_pairs
declarations.signature:
theorem interleaving_invisible_to_pairs (a : A) (v w : ℕ) :
    mintPairs ([Ev.mint a v, Ev.burn a w] : Trace A)
        = mintPairs ([Ev.burn a w, Ev.mint a v] : Trace A)
      ∧ burnPairs ([Ev.mint a v, Ev.burn a w] : Trace A)
        = burnPairs ([Ev.burn a w, Ev.mint a v] : Trace A)
      ∧ ([Ev.mint a v, Ev.burn a w] : Trace A)
        ≠ [Ev.burn a w, Ev.mint a v]

declarations.name: EthTotal.interleaving_invisible_to_counts
declarations.signature:
theorem interleaving_invisible_to_counts (a : A) (v w : ℕ) :
    mintCount ([Ev.mint a v, Ev.burn a w] : Trace A)
        = mintCount ([Ev.burn a w, Ev.mint a v] : Trace A)
      ∧ burnCount ([Ev.mint a v, Ev.burn a w] : Trace A)
        = burnCount ([Ev.burn a w, Ev.mint a v] : Trace A)

declarations.name: EthTotal.interleaving_invisible_to_polarity_sort
declarations.signature:
theorem interleaving_invisible_to_polarity_sort (a : A) (v w : ℕ) :
    Trace.sortByPolarity ([Ev.mint a v, Ev.burn a w] : Trace A)
      = Trace.sortByPolarity ([Ev.burn a w, Ev.mint a v] : Trace A)

declarations.name: EthTotal.stage_witness_not_unique
declarations.signature:
theorem stage_witness_not_unique (x : A) (L : Ledger A) (i j : ℕ) :
    Ev.mint x 0
        ∈ ((fun _ : ℕ => (⟨[Ev.mint x 0], rfl⟩ : Recorded L L)) i).trace
      ∧ Ev.mint x 0
        ∈ ((fun _ : ℕ => (⟨[Ev.mint x 0], rfl⟩ : Recorded L L)) j).trace

declarations.name: EthTotal.attribution_ambiguous
declarations.signature:
theorem attribution_ambiguous (x : A) (L : Ledger A) (n i : ℕ) (hi : i < n) :
    Ev.mint x 0
      ∈ (Recorded.chain (Ls := fun _ : ℕ => L)
          (fun _ => (⟨[Ev.mint x 0], rfl⟩ : Recorded L L)) n).trace

declarations.name: EthTotal.intermediate_state_order_dependent
declarations.signature:
theorem intermediate_state_order_dependent (S b m : ℕ) (hm : 0 < m) :
    S - b ≠ S + m

declarations.name: EthTotal.order_changes_intermediate_not_endpoints
declarations.signature:
theorem order_changes_intermediate_not_endpoints (S b m : ℕ)
    (hb : b ≤ S) (hm : 0 < m) :
    (S - b) + m = (S + m) - b ∧ S - b ≠ S + m

declarations.name: EthTotal.mono_transfer
declarations.signature:
theorem mono_transfer {I : Type u} (key arg : I → ℕ) (P : ℕ → Prop)
    (hP : ∀ m n : ℕ, m ≤ n → P m → P n)
    (harg : ∀ i j : I, key i ≤ key j → arg i ≤ arg j)
    (i j : I) (hij : key i ≤ key j) (hi : P (arg i)) : P (arg j)

declarations.name: EthTotal.arg_mono_of_transfer
declarations.signature:
theorem arg_mono_of_transfer {I : Type u} (key arg : I → ℕ)
    (h : ∀ P : ℕ → Prop, (∀ m n : ℕ, m ≤ n → P m → P n) →
      ∀ i j : I, key i ≤ key j → P (arg i) → P (arg j))
    (i j : I) (hij : key i ≤ key j) : arg i ≤ arg j

declarations.name: EthTotal.transfer_iff_arg_mono
declarations.signature:
theorem transfer_iff_arg_mono {I : Type u} (key arg : I → ℕ) :
    (∀ P : ℕ → Prop, (∀ m n : ℕ, m ≤ n → P m → P n) →
        ∀ i j : I, key i ≤ key j → P (arg i) → P (arg j))
      ↔ (∀ i j : I, key i ≤ key j → arg i ≤ arg j)

declarations.name: EthTotal.two_coordinate_order_independent
declarations.signature:
theorem two_coordinate_order_independent :
    ∃ keyA keyB : Bool → ℕ,
      keyA false ≤ keyA true ∧ keyB true < keyB false

declarations.name: EthTotal.key_order_not_transfer
declarations.signature:
theorem key_order_not_transfer :
    ∃ (keyA argB : Bool → ℕ) (P : ℕ → Prop),
      (∀ m n : ℕ, m ≤ n → P m → P n)
        ∧ keyA false ≤ keyA true
        ∧ P (argB false)
        ∧ ¬ P (argB true)

declarations.name: EthTotal.sorted_key_not_sound_without_arg_mono
declarations.signature:
theorem sorted_key_not_sound_without_arg_mono {I : Type u}
    (key arg : I → ℕ) (i j : I) (hij : key i ≤ key j)
    (hne : ¬ (arg i ≤ arg j)) :
    ¬ (∀ P : ℕ → Prop, (∀ m n : ℕ, m ≤ n → P m → P n) →
        ∀ i' j' : I, key i' ≤ key j' → P (arg i') → P (arg j'))

declarations.name: EthTotal.strict_transfer
declarations.signature:
theorem strict_transfer {I : Type u} (key arg : I → ℕ) (P : ℕ → Prop)
    (hP : ∀ m n : ℕ, m ≤ n → P m → P n)
    (harg : ∀ i j : I, key i ≤ key j → arg i ≤ arg j)
    (i j : I) (hij : key i ≤ key j) (hj : ¬ P (arg j)) : ¬ P (arg i)

declarations.name: EthTotal.single_predicate_transfer_insufficient
declarations.signature:
theorem single_predicate_transfer_insufficient :
    ∃ (key arg : Bool → ℕ) (P : ℕ → Prop),
      (∀ m n : ℕ, m ≤ n → P m → P n)
        ∧ (∀ i j : Bool, key i ≤ key j → P (arg i) → P (arg j))
        ∧ ¬ (∀ i j : Bool, key i ≤ key j → arg i ≤ arg j)

declarations.name: EthTotal.transfer_needs_all_predicates
declarations.signature:
theorem transfer_needs_all_predicates {I : Type u} (key arg : I → ℕ)
    (h : ∀ P : ℕ → Prop, (∀ m n : ℕ, m ≤ n → P m → P n) →
      ∀ i j : I, key i ≤ key j → P (arg i) → P (arg j))
    (i j : I) (hij : key i ≤ key j) : arg i ≤ arg j

declarations.name: EthTotal.Bal.pairing_ge_left
declarations.signature:
theorem pairing_ge_left {x y z : ℕ} (f : Bal x y) (g : Bal y z) :
    f.burn * g.mint ≤ pairing f g

declarations.name: EthTotal.Bal.pairing_ge_right
declarations.signature:
theorem pairing_ge_right {x y z : ℕ} (f : Bal x y) (g : Bal y z) :
    g.burn * f.mint ≤ pairing f g

theorem xfer_overdraft_inflates_iff [DecidableEq A] (L : Ledger A) (s d : A)

theorem moved_zero_does_not_bound_length {L : Ledger A} (a : A)

    (loopPow a ha (k + 1)).growCount = k + 1
      ∧ (loopPow a ha (k + 1)).shrinkCount = k + 1

declarations.signature:
theorem too_few_steps_is_impossible {L K : Ledger A} (p : NeutralPath L K)

declarations.name: EthTotal.length_splits_into_xfers_change_and_waste
declarations.signature:
theorem length_splits_into_xfers_change_and_waste {L K : Ledger A}
    (p : NeutralPath L K) :
    p.length
      = p.xferCount
        + (((L.live.length - K.live.length) + (K.live.length - L.live.length))
           + (min p.shrinkCount p.growCount + min p.shrinkCount p.growCount))

theorem waste_determined_by_length {L K : Ledger A} (p : NeutralPath L K)
    (hx : p.xferCount = 0) :
    p.length
      = ((L.live.length - K.live.length) + (K.live.length - L.live.length))
        + (min p.shrinkCount p.growCount + min p.shrinkCount p.growCount)

declarations.signature:
theorem endo_length_is_xfers_plus_two_waste {L : Ledger A}
    (p : NeutralPath L L) :
    p.length
      = p.xferCount
        + (min p.shrinkCount p.growCount + min p.shrinkCount p.growCount)

declarations.name: EthTotal.account_counts_are_one_scalar
declarations.signature:
theorem account_counts_are_one_scalar {L K : Ledger A}
    (p q : NeutralPath L K) :
    p.shrinkCount + q.growCount = q.shrinkCount + p.growCount
      ∧ (p.shrinkCount = q.shrinkCount → p.growCount = q.growCount)
      ∧ (p.shrinkCount + p.growCount = q.shrinkCount + q.growCount →
          p.shrinkCount = q.shrinkCount ∧ p.growCount = q.growCount)

declarations.name: EthTotal.zeroXfer
declarations.signature: def zeroXfer {L : Ledger A} (s : A) (hs : s ∈ L.live) : NeutralPath L L

declarations.name: EthTotal.zeroXfer_counts
declarations.signature:
theorem zeroXfer_counts {L : Ledger A} (s : A) (hs : s ∈ L.live) :
    (zeroXfer s hs).xferCount = 1
      ∧ (zeroXfer s hs).growCount = 0
      ∧ (zeroXfer s hs).shrinkCount = 0
      ∧ (zeroXfer s hs).moved = 0
      ∧ (zeroXfer s hs).length = 1

declarations.name: EthTotal.account_counts_do_not_bound_xfers
declarations.signature:
theorem account_counts_do_not_bound_xfers {L : Ledger A} (s : A)
    (hs : s ∈ L.live) :
    (zeroXfer s hs).growCount
        = (NeutralPath.refl (L := L) (K := L) rfl (fun _b => rfl)).growCount
      ∧ (zeroXfer s hs).shrinkCount
        = (NeutralPath.refl (L := L) (K := L) rfl (fun _b => rfl)).shrinkCount
      ∧ (zeroXfer s hs).moved
        = (NeutralPath.refl (L := L) (K := L) rfl (fun _b => rfl)).moved
      ∧ (zeroXfer s hs).xferCount
        ≠ (NeutralPath.refl (L := L) (K := L) rfl (fun _b => rfl)).xferCount

declarations.name: EthTotal.iterateZeroXfer
declarations.signature:
def iterateZeroXfer {L : Ledger A} (s : A) (hs : s ∈ L.live) :
    ℕ → NeutralPath L L
  | 0 => NeutralPath.refl rfl (fun _b => rfl)
  | k + 1 => (iterateZeroXfer s hs k).trans (zeroXfer s hs)

declarations.name: EthTotal.iterateZeroXfer_counts
declarations.signature:
theorem iterateZeroXfer_counts {L : Ledger A} (s : A) (hs : s ∈ L.live) :
    ∀ k : ℕ,
      (iterateZeroXfer s hs k).xferCount = k
        ∧ (iterateZeroXfer s hs k).growCount = 0
        ∧ (iterateZeroXfer s hs k).shrinkCount = 0
  | 0 => ⟨rfl, rfl, rfl⟩
  | k + 1 =>
      match iterateZeroXfer_counts s hs k,
        NeutralPath.counts_trans (iterateZeroXfer s hs k) (zeroXfer s hs) with
      | ⟨hx, hg, hsh⟩, ⟨_tl, tx, tg, tsh⟩ =>
          ⟨Eq.trans tx (congrArg (fun n : ℕ => n + 1) hx),
           Eq.trans tg (Eq.trans (congrArg (fun n : ℕ => n + 0) hg) rfl),
           Eq.trans tsh (Eq.trans (congrArg (fun n : ℕ => n + 0) hsh) rfl)⟩

declarations.name: EthTotal.iterateZeroXfer_moved
declarations.signature:
theorem iterateZeroXfer_moved {L : Ledger A} (s : A) (hs : s ∈ L.live) :
    ∀ k : ℕ, (iterateZeroXfer s hs k).moved = 0
  | 0 => rfl
  | k + 1 =>
      Eq.trans
        (NeutralPath.moved_trans (iterateZeroXfer s hs k) (zeroXfer s hs))
        (Eq.trans
          (congrArg (fun n : ℕ => n + (zeroXfer s hs).moved)
            (iterateZeroXfer_moved s hs k))
          (Nat.zero_add (zeroXfer s hs).moved))

declarations.name: EthTotal.xferCount_unbounded_at_fixed_state
declarations.signature:
theorem xferCount_unbounded_at_fixed_state {L : Ledger A} (s : A)
    (hs : s ∈ L.live) :
    ¬ ∃ c : ℕ,
        ∀ p : NeutralPath L L,
          p.moved = 0 → p.growCount = 0 → p.shrinkCount = 0 →
            p.xferCount ≤ c

declarations.name: EthTotal.no_state_measure_bounds_the_record
declarations.signature:
theorem no_state_measure_bounds_the_record {L : Ledger A} (s : A)
    (hs : s ∈ L.live) (c : ℕ) :
    (iterateZeroXfer s hs (c + 1)).moved = 0
      ∧ (iterateZeroXfer s hs (c + 1)).growCount = 0
      ∧ (iterateZeroXfer s hs (c + 1)).shrinkCount = 0
      ∧ c < (iterateZeroXfer s hs (c + 1)).xferCount

declarations.name: EthTotal.moved_ge_account_deficit
declarations.signature:
theorem moved_ge_account_deficit {L K : Ledger A} (p : NeutralPath L K)

declarations.name: EthTotal.moved_ge_account_surplus
declarations.signature:
theorem moved_ge_account_surplus {L K : Ledger A} (p : NeutralPath L K)
    (a : A) : K.bal a - L.bal a ≤ p.moved

declarations.name: EthTotal.too_little_moved_is_impossible
declarations.signature:
theorem too_little_moved_is_impossible {L K : Ledger A} (p : NeutralPath L K)
    (a : A) (h : p.moved < L.bal a - K.bal a) : False

declarations.name: EthTotal.account_change_needs_two_moved

theorem account_change_needs_two_moved {L K : Ledger A} (p : NeutralPath L K)

declarations.name: EthTotal.shortPath
EthTotal.shortPath_length_le
declarations.signature:
theorem shortPath_length_le [DecidableEq A] (L L' : Ledger A)
    (hlive : L'.live = L.live) (hsupply : L'.supply = L.supply) :

      ≤ sumOver (fun a => L.bal a - L'.bal a) L.live

declarations.name: EthTotal.shortPath_touches_no_account
declarations.signature:
theorem shortPath_touches_no_account [DecidableEq A] (L L' : Ledger A)
    (hlive : L'.live = L.live) (hsupply : L'.supply = L.supply) :

      ∧ (shortPath L L' hlive hsupply).shrinkCount = 0

declarations.name: EthTotal.cost_sandwich
declarations.signature:
theorem cost_sandwich [DecidableEq A] (L L' : Ledger A)
    (hlive : L'.live = L.live) (hsupply : L'.supply = L.supply) :
    (∀ (p : NeutralPath L L') (a : A), L.bal a - L'.bal a ≤ p.moved)
      ∧ (∃ p : NeutralPath L L',
          p.length ≤ sumOver (fun a => L.bal a - L'.bal a) L.live
            ∧ p.growCount = 0 ∧ p.shrinkCount = 0)

declarations.name: EthTotal.no_path_is_cheaper_than_its_largest_repair
declarations.signature:
theorem no_path_is_cheaper_than_its_largest_repair {L K : Ledger A}
    (p : NeutralPath L K) (a : A)
    (h : p.moved + p.moved
        < max (L.bal a) (K.bal a) - min (L.bal a) (K.bal a)) : False

EthTotal.debit_at_an_account_is_bounded_by_the_total
EthTotal.a_positive_account_credit_forces_a_positive_total
EthTotal.no_total_credit_means_no_account_credit

EthTotal.account_totals_are_additive_over_blocks
declarations.signature:
theorem account_totals_are_additive_over_blocks {a : A}
    (dec : ∀ b : A, Decidable (b = a)) (τ₁ τ₂ : Trace A) :
    mintedAt dec (τ₁ ++ τ₂) = mintedAt dec τ₁ + mintedAt dec τ₂
      ∧ burnedAt dec (τ₁ ++ τ₂) = burnedAt dec τ₁ + burnedAt dec τ₂

declarations.name: EthTotal.dagger_swaps_credit_and_debit_pointwise
declarations.signature:
theorem dagger_swaps_credit_and_debit_pointwise {a : A}
    (dec : ∀ b : A, Decidable (b = a)) (τ : Trace A) :
    mintedAt dec (conj τ) = burnedAt dec τ
      ∧ burnedAt dec (conj τ) = mintedAt dec τ

declarations.name: EthTotal.account_totals_ignore_the_order
declarations.signature:
theorem account_totals_ignore_the_order {a : A}
    (dec : ∀ b : A, Decidable (b = a)) (τ : Trace A) :
    mintedAt dec (Trace.rev τ) = mintedAt dec τ
      ∧ burnedAt dec (Trace.rev τ) = burnedAt dec τ

declarations.name: EthTotal.pair_membership_is_event_membership
declarations.signature:
theorem pair_membership_is_event_membership (d : A) (v : ℕ) (τ : Trace A) :
    ((d, v) ∈ mintPairs τ ↔ Ev.mint d v ∈ τ)
      ∧ ((d, v) ∈ burnPairs τ ↔ Ev.burn d v ∈ τ)

declarations.name: EthTotal.the_two_polarity_projections_are_orthogonal_idempotents
declarations.signature:
theorem the_two_polarity_projections_are_orthogonal_idempotents
    (τ : Trace A) :
    Trace.mintOnly (Trace.mintOnly τ) = Trace.mintOnly τ
      ∧ Trace.burnOnly (Trace.burnOnly τ) = Trace.burnOnly τ
      ∧ Trace.burnOnly (Trace.mintOnly τ) = ([] : Trace A)
      ∧ Trace.mintOnly (Trace.burnOnly τ) = ([] : Trace A)

declarations.name: EthTotal.the_decomposition_is_complete_in_count
declarations.signature:
theorem the_decomposition_is_complete_in_count (τ : Trace A) :
    (Trace.mintOnly τ).length + (Trace.burnOnly τ).length = τ.length

declarations.name: EthTotal.the_decomposition_is_lossy_in_the_log
declarations.signature:
theorem the_decomposition_is_lossy_in_the_log (a : A) (v w : ℕ) :
    (Trace.mintOnly ([Ev.burn a w, Ev.mint a v] : Trace A)).length
        + (Trace.burnOnly ([Ev.burn a w, Ev.mint a v] : Trace A)).length
      = ([Ev.burn a w, Ev.mint a v] : Trace A).length
    ∧ Trace.sortByPolarity ([Ev.burn a w, Ev.mint a v] : Trace A)
      ≠ ([Ev.burn a w, Ev.mint a v] : Trace A)

declarations.name: EthTotal.a_log_is_pure_credit_iff_it_has_no_debit
declarations.signature:
theorem a_log_is_pure_credit_iff_it_has_no_debit (τ : Trace A) :

declarations.name: EthTotal.a_log_is_pure_debit_iff_it_has_no_credit
declarations.signature:
theorem a_log_is_pure_debit_iff_it_has_no_credit (τ : Trace A) :
    Trace.burnOnly τ = τ ↔ Trace.mintOnly τ = ([] : Trace A)

declarations.name: EthTotal.pure_logs_are_exactly_the_images
declarations.signature:
theorem pure_logs_are_exactly_the_images (τ : Trace A) :
    (Trace.mintOnly τ = τ ↔ ∃ σ : Trace A, τ = Trace.mintOnly σ)
      ∧ (Trace.burnOnly τ = τ ↔ ∃ σ : Trace A, τ = Trace.burnOnly σ)

theorem logs_cancel_on_the_right {m n l : Trace A} (h : m ++ l = n ++ l) :

declarations.signature:
theorem only_the_empty_log_commutes_with_everything (x : A) (τ : Trace A)

declarations.name: EthTotal.the_two_normalizations_do_not_commute
declarations.signature:
theorem the_two_normalizations_do_not_commute (x : A) (τ : Trace A) :
    Trace.sortByPolarityDual (Trace.normalizeAmt x τ)
        = Trace.normalizeAmt x τ
      ∧ Trace.sortByPolarity (Trace.normalizeAmt x τ)

      ∧ Trace.normalizeAmt x (Trace.sortByPolarity τ)
        = Trace.normalizeAmt x τ
      ∧ Trace.normalizeAmt x (Trace.sortByPolarityDual τ)
        = Trace.normalizeAmt x τ

declarations.name: EthTotal.liveProfile
declarations.signature: def liveProfile {L K : Ledger A} (p : NeutralPath L K) : List ℕ

declarations.name: EthTotal.liveProfile_length
declarations.signature:
theorem liveProfile_length {L : Ledger A} :
    ∀ {K : Ledger A} (p : NeutralPath L K),
      (liveProfile p).length = p.length + 1
  | _, NeutralPath.refl _ _ => rfl
  | K, NeutralPath.step _s _d _v _hs _hd p _ _ _ _ _ =>
      Eq.trans (length_append (liveProfile p) [K.live.length])
        (congrArg (fun n : ℕ => n + 1) (liveProfile_length p))
  | K, NeutralPath.grow _a _l₁ _l₂ p _ _ _ =>
      Eq.trans (length_append (liveProfile p) [K.live.length])
        (congrArg (fun n : ℕ => n + 1) (liveProfile_length p))
  | K, NeutralPath.shrink _a _l₁ _l₂ p _ _ _ _ =>
      Eq.trans (length_append (liveProfile p) [K.live.length])
        (congrArg (fun n : ℕ => n + 1) (liveProfile_length p))

declarations.signature:
theorem widening_changes_nothing {M M' B B' : List A} {L L' : Ledger A}

    (relabel hM hB f).trace = f.trace
      ∧ Recorded.measure (relabel hM hB f).toRecorded

declarations.signature:
theorem signature_is_a_claim_not_a_change {M M' B B' : List A}
    {L K L' : Ledger A}
    (hM : ∀ a : A, a ∈ M → a ∈ M') (hB : ∀ a : A, a ∈ B → a ∈ B')

declarations.name: EthTotal.the_unreported_burn_is_the_injected_supply

theorem the_unreported_burn_is_the_injected_supply [DecidableEq A]

    (Accounting.ofSetBalSub L s v hs).burn + (v - L.bal s) = v
      ∧ ((L.setBal s (L.bal s - v) hs).setBal d
          ((L.setBal s (L.bal s - v) hs).bal d + v) hd).supply
        = L.supply + (v - L.bal s)

      ∧ (((L.setBal s (L.bal s - v) hs).setBal d
            ((L.setBal s (L.bal s - v) hs).bal d + v) hd).supply = L.supply
          ↔ v ≤ L.bal s)

declarations.name: EthTotal.normalizeSelf_is_order_dependent

theorem normalizeSelf_is_order_dependent {x y : A} (hxy : x ≠ y)
    (L : Ledger A) :
    (Recorded.normalizeSelf
          (⟨[Ev.mint x 1, Ev.burn y 1], rfl⟩ : Recorded L L)
          (Nat.le.step (Nat.le_refl 1))).measure
        = (Recorded.normalizeSelf
            (⟨[Ev.burn y 1, Ev.mint x 1], rfl⟩ : Recorded L L)
            (Nat.le.step (Nat.le_refl 1))).measure
      ∧ (Recorded.normalizeSelf
          (⟨[Ev.mint x 1, Ev.burn y 1], rfl⟩ : Recorded L L)
          (Nat.le.step (Nat.le_refl 1))).trace
        ≠ (Recorded.normalizeSelf

theorem clear_and_recreate_permutes_the_state [DecidableEq A] {x y z : A}
    (hxy : x ≠ y) (hxz : x ≠ z) (hyz : y ≠ z) :
    (((triple hxy hxz hyz).eraseLive y (triple_bal_zero hxy hxz hyz)).addLive
        y (notMem_eraseOne (triple hxy hxz hyz).live_distinct)).supply
      = (triple hxy hxz hyz).supply
    ∧ (((triple hxy hxz hyz).eraseLive y
          (triple_bal_zero hxy hxz hyz)).addLive y
          (notMem_eraseOne (triple hxy hxz hyz).live_distinct)).normalize
      = (triple hxy hxz hyz).normalize
    ∧ (((triple hxy hxz hyz).eraseLive y
          (triple_bal_zero hxy hxz hyz)).addLive y
          (notMem_eraseOne (triple hxy hxz hyz).live_distinct)).live
      ≠ (triple hxy hxz hyz).live

      ∧ (((triple hxy hxz hyz).eraseLive y

            (notMem_eraseOne (triple hxy hxz hyz).live_distinct)).live
        ≠ (triple hxy hxz hyz).live

declarations.name: EthTotal.supportOf_congr_pointwise
declarations.signature:
theorem supportOf_congr_pointwise (f g : A → ℕ) (h : ∀ a : A, f a = g a) :
    ∀ l : List A, supportOf f l = supportOf g l
  | [] => rfl
  | x :: l =>
      match hfx : f x with
      | 0 =>
          Eq.trans (supportOf_cons_zero f hfx l)
            (Eq.trans (supportOf_congr_pointwise f g h l)
              (supportOf_cons_zero g (Eq.trans (h x).symm hfx) l).symm)
      | _n + 1 =>
          let hne : f x ≠ 0

declarations.name: EthTotal.zero_sub_eq_zero
declarations.signature:
theorem zero_sub_eq_zero : ∀ y : Nat, 0 - y = 0
  | 0 => rfl
  | y + 1 => congrArg Nat.pred (zero_sub_eq_zero y)

declarations.name: EthTotal.sub_eq_zero_of_le
declarations.signature:
theorem sub_eq_zero_of_le : ∀ {x y : Nat}, x ≤ y → x - y = 0
  | 0, y, _ => zero_sub_eq_zero y
  | _ + 1, 0, h => absurd h (Nat.not_succ_le_zero _)
  | x + 1, y + 1, h =>
      Eq.trans (Nat.succ_sub_succ x y)
        (sub_eq_zero_of_le (Nat.le_of_succ_le_succ h))

declarations.name: EthTotal.add_sub_cancel_of_le
declarations.signature:
theorem add_sub_cancel_of_le : ∀ {x y : Nat}, x ≤ y → x + (y - x) = y
  | 0, y, _ => Nat.zero_add y
  | _ + 1, 0, h => absurd h (Nat.not_succ_le_zero _)
  | x + 1, y + 1, h =>
      Eq.trans
        (congrArg (fun n => (x + 1) + n) (Nat.succ_sub_succ y x))
        (Eq.trans (Nat.succ_add x (y - x))
          (congrArg Nat.succ (add_sub_cancel_of_le (Nat.le_of_succ_le_succ h))))

declarations.name: EthTotal.add_left_cancel
declarations.signature:
theorem add_left_cancel : ∀ {n m k : Nat}, n + m = n + k → m = k
  | 0, m, k, h =>
      Eq.trans (Nat.zero_add m).symm (Eq.trans h (Nat.zero_add k))
  | n + 1, m, k, h =>
      add_left_cancel (n := n)
        (Nat.succ.inj
          (Eq.trans (Nat.succ_add n m).symm (Eq.trans h (Nat.succ_add n k))))

theorem add_sub_cancel_right : ∀ (n m : Nat), n + m - m = n
  | _, 0 => rfl
  | n, m + 1 =>

EthTotal.eq_zero_of_add_eq_zero
declarations.signature:
theorem eq_zero_of_add_eq_zero : ∀ {a b : Nat}, a + b = 0 → a = 0 ∧ b = 0
  | 0, 0, _ => ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
  | _, _ + 1, h => Nat.noConfusion h
  | _ + 1, 0, h => Nat.noConfusion h

declarations.name: EthTotal.eq_of_double_eq
declarations.signature:
theorem eq_of_double_eq : ∀ {a b : Nat}, a + a = b + b → a = b
  | 0, 0, _ => rfl
  | 0, _ + 1, h => Nat.noConfusion h
  | _ + 1, 0, h => Nat.noConfusion h
  | a + 1, b + 1, h =>
      congrArg (fun n => n + 1)
        (eq_of_double_eq
          (Nat.succ.inj
            (Eq.trans (Nat.succ_add a a).symm
              (Eq.trans (Nat.succ.inj h) (Nat.succ_add b b)))))

declarations.name: EthTotal.half
declarations.signature:
def half : Nat → Nat
  | 0 => 0
  | 1 => 0
  | n + 2 => half n + 1

declarations.name: EthTotal.half_double
declarations.signature:
theorem half_double : ∀ k : Nat, half (k + k) = k
  | 0 => rfl
  | k + 1 =>
      Eq.trans (congrArg half (congrArg Nat.succ (Nat.succ_add k k)))
        (congrArg (fun n => n + 1) (half_double k))

declarations.name: EthTotal.half_double_add
declarations.signature:
theorem half_double_add : ∀ (m d : Nat), half ((m + m) + d) = m + half d
  | 0, d =>
      Eq.trans (congrArg half (Nat.zero_add d)) (Nat.zero_add (half d)).symm
  | m + 1, d =>
      Eq.trans
        (congrArg half
          (Eq.trans
            (congrArg (fun n => n + d)
              (congrArg Nat.succ (Nat.succ_add m m)))
            (Eq.trans (Nat.succ_add (Nat.succ (m + m)) d)
              (congrArg Nat.succ (Nat.succ_add (m + m) d)))))
        (Eq.trans (congrArg (fun n => n + 1) (half_double_add m d))
          (Nat.succ_add m (half d)).symm)

def parity : Nat → Nat

theorem half_add_half_add_parity :
    ∀ n : Nat, (half n + half n) + parity n = n
  | 0 => rfl
  | 1 => rfl
  | n + 2 =>
      Eq.trans
        (congrArg (fun k => k + parity n)
          (congrArg Nat.succ (Nat.succ_add (half n) (half n))))
        (Eq.trans
          (Nat.succ_add (Nat.succ (half n + half n)) (parity n))
          (Eq.trans
            (congrArg Nat.succ
              (Nat.succ_add (half n + half n) (parity n)))
            (congrArg (fun k => k + 2) (half_add_half_add_parity n))))

theorem parity_add_add : ∀ (m d : Nat), parity ((m + m) + d) = parity d
  | 0, d => congrArg parity (Nat.zero_add d)
  | m + 1, d =>
      Eq.trans
        (congrArg parity
          (Eq.trans
            (congrArg (fun n => n + d)
              (congrArg Nat.succ (Nat.succ_add m m)))
            (Eq.trans (Nat.succ_add (Nat.succ (m + m)) d)
              (congrArg Nat.succ (Nat.succ_add (m + m) d)))))

declarations.name: EthTotal.flipNat_min
declarations.signature:
theorem flipNat_min :
    ∀ u v : ℕ, flipNat (min u v) = max (flipNat u) (flipNat v)
  | 0, 0 => Eq.trans (congrArg flipNat (min_self 0)) (max_self 1).symm
  | 0, w + 1 =>
      Eq.trans (congrArg flipNat (min_eq_left (Nat.zero_le (w + 1))))
        (max_eq_left (Nat.zero_le 1)).symm
  | n + 1, 0 =>
      Eq.trans (congrArg flipNat (min_eq_right (Nat.zero_le (n + 1))))
        (max_eq_right (Nat.zero_le 1)).symm
  | n + 1, w + 1 =>
      Eq.trans
        (flipNat_of_ne_zero
          ((min_ne_zero_iff (n + 1) (w + 1)).mpr
            ⟨fun h => Nat.noConfusion h, fun h => Nat.noConfusion h⟩))
        (max_self 0).symm

declarations.name: EthTotal.flipNat_max
declarations.signature:
theorem flipNat_max :
    ∀ u v : ℕ, flipNat (max u v) = min (flipNat u) (flipNat v)
  | 0, 0 => Eq.trans (congrArg flipNat (max_self 0)) (min_self 1).symm
  | 0, w + 1 =>
      Eq.trans (congrArg flipNat (max_eq_right (Nat.zero_le (w + 1))))
        (min_eq_right (Nat.zero_le 1)).symm
  | n + 1, 0 =>
      Eq.trans (congrArg flipNat (max_eq_left (Nat.zero_le (n + 1))))
        (min_eq_left (Nat.zero_le 1)).symm
  | n + 1, w + 1 =>
      Eq.trans
        (flipNat_of_ne_zero
          ((max_ne_zero_iff (n + 1) (w + 1)).mpr
            (Or.inl (fun h => Nat.noConfusion h))))
        (min_self 0).symm

declarations.name: EthTotal.mul_add
declarations.signature:
theorem mul_add : ∀ (k m n : Nat), k * (m + n) = k * m + k * n
  | _, _, 0 => rfl
  | k, m, n + 1 =>
      Eq.trans (congrArg (fun x => x + k) (mul_add k m n))
        (Nat.add_assoc (k * m) (k * n) k)

declarations.name: EthTotal.add_mul
declarations.signature:
theorem add_mul : ∀ (m n k : Nat), (m + n) * k = m * k + n * k
  | _, _, 0 => rfl
  | m, n, k + 1 =>
      Eq.trans (congrArg (fun x => x + (m + n)) (add_mul m n k))
        (Eq.trans (Nat.add_assoc (m * k) (n * k) (m + n))
          (Eq.trans
            (congrArg (fun x => m * k + x)
              (Eq.trans (Nat.add_assoc (n * k) m n).symm
                (Eq.trans
                  (congrArg (fun y => y + n) (Nat.add_comm (n * k) m))
                  (Nat.add_assoc m (n * k) n))))
            (Nat.add_assoc (m * k) m (n * k + n)).symm))

declarations.name: EthTotal.zero_mul
declarations.signature:
theorem zero_mul : ∀ n : Nat, 0 * n = 0
  | 0 => rfl
  | n + 1 => zero_mul n

declarations.name: EthTotal.succ_mul
declarations.signature:
theorem succ_mul : ∀ (n m : Nat), (n + 1) * m = n * m + m
  | _, 0 => rfl
  | n, m + 1 =>
      Eq.trans (congrArg (fun k => k + (n + 1)) (succ_mul n m))
        (Eq.trans (Nat.add_assoc (n * m) m (n + 1))
          (Eq.trans (congrArg (fun k => n * m + k) (Nat.add_left_comm m n 1))
            (Nat.add_assoc (n * m) n (m + 1)).symm))

declarations.name: EthTotal.mul_comm
declarations.signature:
theorem mul_comm : ∀ (n m : Nat), n * m = m * n
  | n, 0 => (zero_mul n).symm
  | n, m + 1 =>
      Eq.trans (congrArg (fun k => k + n) (mul_comm n m)) (succ_mul m n).symm

declarations.name: EthTotal.mul_assoc
declarations.signature:
theorem mul_assoc : ∀ (a b c : Nat), (a * b) * c = a * (b * c)
  | _, _, 0 => rfl
  | a, b, c + 1 =>
      Eq.trans (congrArg (fun n => n + a * b) (mul_assoc a b c))
        (mul_add a (b * c) b).symm

declarations.name: EthTotal.eq_of_cons_hom_agree
declarations.signature:
theorem eq_of_cons_hom_agree {N : Type v} {G : Type u} (op : N → N → N)
    (ψ φ : List G → N)
    (hnil : ψ [] = φ [])
    (hψ : ∀ (g : G) (l : List G), ψ (g :: l) = op (ψ [g]) (ψ l))
    (hφ : ∀ (g : G) (l : List G), φ (g :: l) = op (φ [g]) (φ l))
    (hgen : ∀ g : G, ψ [g] = φ [g]) :
    ∀ l : List G, ψ l = φ l
  | [] => hnil
  | g :: l =>
      Eq.trans (hψ g l)
        (Eq.trans (congrArg (fun n => op n (ψ l)) (hgen g))
          (Eq.trans
            (congrArg (fun n => op (φ [g]) n)
              (eq_of_cons_hom_agree op ψ φ hnil hψ hφ hgen l))
            (hφ g l).symm))

declarations.signature:
theorem eq_of_append_hom_agree {N : Type v} {G : Type u} (op : N → N → N)
    (ψ φ : List G → N)
    (hnil : ψ [] = φ [])
    (hψ : ∀ l₁ l₂ : List G, ψ (l₁ ++ l₂) = op (ψ l₁) (ψ l₂))
    (hφ : ∀ l₁ l₂ : List G, φ (l₁ ++ l₂) = op (φ l₁) (φ l₂))
    (hgen : ∀ g : G, ψ [g] = φ [g]) :
    ∀ l : List G, ψ l = φ l

    (hnil : ψ [] = φ [])
    (hψ : ∀ (g : G) (l : List G), ψ (g :: l) = op (ψ [g]) (ψ l))
    (hφ : ∀ (g : G) (l : List G), φ (g :: l) = op (φ l) (φ [g]))
    (hgen : ∀ g : G, ψ [g] = φ [g]) :
    ∀ l : List G, ψ l = φ l

declarations.name: EthTotal.sumOver_append
declarations.signature:
theorem sumOver_append {A : Type u} (f : A → ℕ) :
    ∀ (l₁ l₂ : List A), sumOver f (l₁ ++ l₂) = sumOver f l₁ + sumOver f l₂
  | [], l₂ => (Nat.zero_add (sumOver f l₂)).symm
  | a :: l₁, l₂ =>
      Eq.trans
        (congrArg (fun n => f a + n) (sumOver_append f l₁ l₂))
        (Nat.add_assoc (f a) (sumOver f l₁) (sumOver f l₂)).symm

declarations.name: EthTotal.sumOver_unique
declarations.signature:
theorem sumOver_unique {A : Type u} (f : A → ℕ) (ψ : List A → ℕ)
    (hnil : ψ [] = 0)
    (hψ : ∀ l₁ l₂ : List A, ψ (l₁ ++ l₂) = ψ l₁ + ψ l₂)
    (hgen : ∀ a : A, ψ [a] = f a) :
    ∀ l : List A, ψ l = sumOver f l

declarations.name: EthTotal.sumOver_zero
declarations.signature:
theorem sumOver_zero {A : Type u} : ∀ l : List A, sumOver (fun _ => 0) l = 0
  | [] => rfl
  | _ :: l => congrArg (fun n => 0 + n) (sumOver_zero l)

declarations.name: EthTotal.sumOver_congr_mem
declarations.signature:
theorem sumOver_congr_mem {A : Type u} {f g : A → ℕ} :
    ∀ l : List A, (∀ a ∈ l, f a = g a) → sumOver f l = sumOver g l
  | [], _ => rfl
  | a :: l, h =>
      Eq.trans
        (congrArg (fun n => f a + n)
          (sumOver_congr_mem l (fun x hx => h x (List.Mem.tail a hx))))
        (congrArg (fun m => m + sumOver g l) (h a (List.Mem.head l)))

declarations.name: EthTotal.sumOver_congr
declarations.signature:
theorem sumOver_congr {A : Type u} {f g : A → ℕ} (h : ∀ a : A, f a = g a) :
    ∀ l : List A, sumOver f l = sumOver g l

declarations.name: EthTotal.sumOver_add
declarations.signature:
theorem sumOver_add {A : Type u} (f g : A → ℕ) :
    ∀ l : List A, sumOver (fun a => f a + g a) l = sumOver f l + sumOver g l
  | [] => rfl
  | a :: l =>
      Eq.trans
        (congrArg (fun n => (f a + g a) + n) (sumOver_add f g l))
        (Eq.trans (Nat.add_assoc (f a) (g a) (sumOver f l + sumOver g l))
          (Eq.trans
            (congrArg (fun n => f a + n)
              (Eq.trans (Nat.add_assoc (g a) (sumOver f l) (sumOver g l)).symm
                (Eq.trans
                  (congrArg (fun m => m + sumOver g l)
                    (Nat.add_comm (g a) (sumOver f l)))
                  (Nat.add_assoc (sumOver f l) (g a) (sumOver g l)))))
            (Nat.add_assoc (f a) (sumOver f l) (g a + sumOver g l)).symm))

declarations.name: EthTotal.sumOver_mul_left
declarations.signature:
theorem sumOver_mul_left {A : Type u} (k : ℕ) (f : A → ℕ) :
    ∀ l : List A, sumOver (fun a => k * f a) l = k * sumOver f l
  | [] => rfl
  | a :: l =>
      Eq.trans
        (congrArg (fun n => k * f a + n) (sumOver_mul_left k f l))
        (mul_add k (f a) (sumOver f l)).symm

declarations.name: EthTotal.sumOver_le_mem
declarations.signature:
theorem sumOver_le_mem {A : Type u} {f g : A → ℕ} :
    ∀ l : List A, (∀ a ∈ l, f a ≤ g a) → sumOver f l ≤ sumOver g l
  | [], _ => Nat.le_refl 0
  | a :: l, h =>
      Nat.le_trans
        (Nat.add_le_add_right (h a (List.Mem.head l)) (sumOver f l))
        (Nat.add_le_add_left
          (sumOver_le_mem l (fun x hx => h x (List.Mem.tail a hx))) (g a))

declarations.name: EthTotal.sumOver_min_add_max

    sumOver (fun a => min (f a) (g a)) l
        + sumOver (fun a => max (f a) (g a)) l

declarations.name: EthTotal.sumOver_min_le
declarations.signature:
theorem sumOver_min_le {A : Type u} (f g : A → ℕ) (l : List A) :

declarations.name: EthTotal.le_sumOver_max

theorem le_sumOver_max {A : Type u} (f g : A → ℕ) (l : List A) :

declarations.name: EthTotal.mem_supportOf_min_iff

declarations.signature:
theorem mem_kernelOf_max_iff {A : Type u} (f g : A → ℕ) (l : List A)

declarations.name: EthTotal.supportOf_length_min_add_max
declarations.signature:
theorem supportOf_length_min_add_max {A : Type u} (f g : A → ℕ)

    (supportOf (fun b => min (f b) (g b)) l).length

declarations.name: EthTotal.kernelOf_length_min_add_max
declarations.signature:
theorem kernelOf_length_min_add_max {A : Type u} (f g : A → ℕ)
    (l : List A) :
    (kernelOf (fun b => min (f b) (g b)) l).length
        + (kernelOf (fun b => max (f b) (g b)) l).length

declarations.name: EthTotal.sumOver_lt_mem
declarations.signature:
theorem sumOver_lt_mem {A : Type u} {f g : A → ℕ} {a₀ : A} :
    ∀ l : List A, (∀ a ∈ l, f a ≤ g a) → a₀ ∈ l →
      f a₀ < g a₀ → sumOver f l < sumOver g l
  | [], _, hm, _ => absurd hm notMemNil
  | a :: l, h, hm, hlt =>
      memConsElim hm
        (fun he =>
          Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le
            (Eq.subst
              (motive := fun n => n ≤ g a + sumOver f l)
              (Nat.succ_add (f a) (sumOver f l))
              (Nat.add_le_add_right
                (Eq.subst (motive := fun z => f z < g z) he hlt)
                (sumOver f l)))
            (Nat.add_le_add_left
              (sumOver_le_mem l (fun x hx => h x (List.Mem.tail a hx)))
              (g a)))
        (fun ht =>
          Nat.lt_of_le_of_lt
            (Nat.add_le_add_right (h a (List.Mem.head l)) (sumOver f l))
            (Nat.add_le_add_left
              (sumOver_lt_mem l (fun x hx => h x (List.Mem.tail a hx))
                ht hlt)
              (g a)))

declarations.name: EthTotal.sumOver_reverseAux
declarations.signature:
theorem sumOver_reverseAux {A : Type u} (f : A → ℕ) :
    ∀ (q s : List A),
      sumOver f (List.reverseAux q s) = sumOver f q + sumOver f s
  | [], s => (Nat.zero_add (sumOver f s)).symm
  | b :: q, s =>
      Eq.trans (sumOver_reverseAux f q (b :: s))
        (Eq.trans (Nat.add_assoc (sumOver f q) (f b) (sumOver f s)).symm
          (congrArg (fun n => n + sumOver f s)
            (Nat.add_comm (sumOver f q) (f b))))

declarations.name: EthTotal.append_nil
declarations.signature:
theorem append_nil {α : Type v} : ∀ l : List α, l ++ [] = l
  | [] => rfl
  | a :: l => congrArg (fun s => a :: s) (append_nil l)

declarations.name: EthTotal.memMapOfMem
declarations.signature:
theorem memMapOfMem {α : Type u} {β : Type v} (φ : α → β) {a : α} :
    ∀ l : List α, a ∈ l → φ a ∈ List.map φ l
  | [], h => absurd h notMemNil
  | x :: l, h =>
      memConsElim h
        (fun he =>
          Eq.subst (motive := fun z => φ z ∈ List.map φ (x :: l)) he.symm
            (List.Mem.head (List.map φ l)))
        (fun ht => List.Mem.tail (φ x) (memMapOfMem φ l ht))

declarations.name: EthTotal.existsOfMemMap
declarations.signature:
theorem existsOfMemMap {α : Type u} {β : Type v} (φ : α → β) {b : β} :
    ∀ l : List α, b ∈ List.map φ l → ∃ a : α, a ∈ l ∧ b = φ a
  | [], h => absurd h notMemNil
  | x :: l, h =>
      memConsElim h
        (fun he => ⟨x, List.Mem.head l, he⟩)
        (fun ht =>
          match existsOfMemMap φ l ht with
          | ⟨a, ha, hb⟩ => ⟨a, List.Mem.tail x ha, hb⟩)

declarations.name: EthTotal.searchPreimage
declarations.signature:
def searchPreimage {α : Type u} {β : Type v} (φ : α → β) {b : β}
    (dec : ∀ y : β, Decidable (b = y)) :
    ∀ l : List α,
      (Σ' (a : α), a ∈ l ∧ b = φ a) ⊕' (b ∉ List.map φ l)
  | [] => PSum.inr notMemNil
  | x :: l =>
      match dec (φ x) with
      | isTrue hb => PSum.inl ⟨x, List.Mem.head l, hb⟩
      | isFalse hb =>
          match searchPreimage φ dec l with
          | PSum.inl ⟨a, ha, he⟩ => PSum.inl ⟨a, List.Mem.tail x ha, he⟩
          | PSum.inr hn => PSum.inr (notMemCons hb hn)

declarations.signature:
theorem Distinct.map {α : Type u} {β : Type v} (φ : α → β)
    (hinj : ∀ a a' : α, φ a = φ a' → a = a') :
    ∀ {l : List α}, Distinct l → Distinct (List.map φ l)
  | [], _ => Distinct.nil
  | x :: l, Distinct.cons hx dl =>
      Distinct.cons
        (fun hm =>
          match existsOfMemMap φ l hm with
          | ⟨a, ha, hb⟩ =>
              hx (Eq.subst (motive := fun z => z ∈ l) (hinj x a hb).symm ha))
        (Distinct.map φ hinj dl)

  | a :: l₁, l₂ =>
      Eq.trans (congrArg (fun n => n + 1) (length_append l₁ l₂))
        (Nat.add_right_comm l₁.length l₂.length 1)

declarations.name: EthTotal.append_right_cancel_of_length
declarations.signature:
theorem append_right_cancel_of_length {α : Type v} (l : List α) :
    ∀ {m n : List α}, m.length = n.length → m ++ l = n ++ l → m = n
  | [], [], _, _ => rfl
  | [], _b :: _n, h, _ => Nat.noConfusion h
  | _a :: _m, [], h, _ => Nat.noConfusion h
  | a :: m, b :: _n, h, he =>
      Eq.trans
        (congrArg (fun x => x :: m)
          (congrArg (fun xs => List.headD xs a) he))
        (congrArg (fun t => b :: t)
          (append_right_cancel_of_length l (Nat.succ.inj h)
            (congrArg List.tail he)))

declarations.name: EthTotal.range_loop_append
declarations.signature:
theorem range_loop_append : ∀ (n : ℕ) (acc : List ℕ),
    List.range.loop n acc = List.range.loop n [] ++ acc
  | 0, _ => rfl
  | n + 1, acc =>
      Eq.trans (range_loop_append n (n :: acc))
        (Eq.trans
          (append_assoc (List.range.loop n []) [n] acc).symm
          (congrArg (fun l => l ++ acc) (range_loop_append n [n]).symm))

declarations.name: EthTotal.mem_range_of_lt
declarations.signature:
theorem mem_range_of_lt : ∀ {i n : ℕ}, i < n → i ∈ List.range n
  | _, 0, h => absurd h (Nat.not_succ_le_zero _)
  | i, n + 1, h =>
      Eq.subst (motive := fun l => i ∈ l) (range_succ n).symm
        (match Nat.lt_or_ge i n with
         | Or.inl hlt =>
             memAppendLeft (List.range n) [n] (mem_range_of_lt hlt)
         | Or.inr hge =>
             memAppendRight (List.range n) [n]
               (Eq.subst (motive := fun z => z ∈ [n])
                 (Nat.le_antisymm (Nat.le_of_succ_le_succ h) hge).symm
                 (List.Mem.head [])))

declarations.name: EthTotal.lt_of_mem_range
declarations.signature:
theorem lt_of_mem_range : ∀ {i n : ℕ}, i ∈ List.range n → i < n
  | _, 0, h => absurd h notMemNil
  | i, n + 1, h =>
      match memAppendElim (List.range n) [n]
          (Eq.subst (motive := fun l => i ∈ l) (range_succ n) h) with
      | Or.inl hl => Nat.le_succ_of_le (lt_of_mem_range hl)
      | Or.inr hr =>
          Eq.subst (motive := fun z => z < n + 1) (eqOfMemSingleton hr).symm
            (Nat.le_refl (n + 1))

declarations.name: EthTotal.step_mono_le_on
declarations.signature:
theorem step_mono_le_on (f : ℕ → ℕ) {i : ℕ} :
    ∀ {n : ℕ}, (∀ k : ℕ, i ≤ k → k < n → f k ≤ f (k + 1)) → i ≤ n →
      f i ≤ f n
  | 0, _, hin => Nat.le_of_eq (congrArg f (Nat.eq_zero_of_le_zero hin))
  | n + 1, h, hin =>
      match Nat.lt_or_ge i (n + 1) with
      | Or.inl hlt =>
          Nat.le_trans
            (step_mono_le_on f
              (fun k hik hkn => h k hik (Nat.le_succ_of_le hkn))
              (Nat.le_of_succ_le_succ hlt))
            (h n (Nat.le_of_succ_le_succ hlt) (Nat.le_refl (n + 1)))
      | Or.inr hge => Nat.le_of_eq (congrArg f (Nat.le_antisymm hin hge))

theorem eq_zero_of_sumOver_eq_zero {A : Type u} (f : A → ℕ) :
    ∀ (l : List A), sumOver f l = 0 → ∀ a ∈ l, f a = 0
  | [], _, _a, ha => absurd ha notMemNil
  | x :: l, h, a, ha =>
      let hx : f x = 0

declarations.name: EthTotal.le_sumOver_of_mem
declarations.signature:
theorem le_sumOver_of_mem {A : Type u} (f : A → ℕ) {a : A} :
    ∀ (l : List A), a ∈ l → f a ≤ sumOver f l
  | [], h => absurd h notMemNil
  | x :: l, h =>
      memConsElim h
        (fun he =>
          Eq.subst (motive := fun n => n ≤ f x + sumOver f l)
            (congrArg f he).symm
            (Nat.le_add_right (f x) (sumOver f l)))
        (fun ht =>
          Nat.le_trans (le_sumOver_of_mem f l ht)
            (Nat.le_add_left (sumOver f l) (f x)))

declarations.name: EthTotal.exists_pos_of_sumOver_pos
declarations.signature:
theorem exists_pos_of_sumOver_pos {A : Type u} (f : A → ℕ) :
    ∀ (l : List A), 0 < sumOver f l → ∃ a : A, a ∈ l ∧ 0 < f a
  | [], h => absurd h (Nat.lt_irrefl 0)
  | x :: l, h =>
      match Nat.eq_zero_or_pos (f x) with
      | Or.inr hp => ⟨x, List.Mem.head l, hp⟩
      | Or.inl hz =>
          match exists_pos_of_sumOver_pos f l
              (Eq.subst (motive := fun n => 0 < n)
                (Eq.trans (congrArg (fun m => m + sumOver f l) hz)
                  (Nat.zero_add (sumOver f l)))
                h) with
          | ⟨a, hm, hp⟩ => ⟨a, List.Mem.tail x hm, hp⟩

declarations.signature:
theorem append_of_cons_hom {N : Type v} {G : Type u} {op : N → N → N} {e : N}
    (hmon : IsMonoid op e) (ψ : List G → N) (hnil : ψ [] = e)
    (hcons : ∀ (g : G) (l : List G), ψ (g :: l) = op (ψ [g]) (ψ l)) :
    ∀ l₁ l₂ : List G, ψ (l₁ ++ l₂) = op (ψ l₁) (ψ l₂)
  | [], l₂ =>
      Eq.trans (hmon.left_id (ψ l₂)).symm
        (congrArg (fun n => op n (ψ l₂)) hnil.symm)
  | g :: l₁, l₂ =>
      Eq.trans (hcons g (l₁ ++ l₂))
        (Eq.trans
          (congrArg (fun n => op (ψ [g]) n)
            (append_of_cons_hom hmon ψ hnil hcons l₁ l₂))
          (Eq.trans (hmon.assoc (ψ [g]) (ψ l₁) (ψ l₂)).symm
            (congrArg (fun n => op n (ψ l₂)) (hcons g l₁).symm)))

  normalized_left : ∀ x y : I, ψ x x y = 0
  normalized_right : ∀ x y : I, ψ x y y = 0
  symm : ∀ x y z : I, ψ z y x = ψ x y z

structure IsBoundedJoinSemilattice {L : Type u} (le : L → L → Prop)
    (join : L → L → L) (bot : L) : Prop where
  le_refl : ∀ x : L, le x x
  le_trans : ∀ x y z : L, le x y → le y z → le x z
  bot_le : ∀ x : L, le bot x
  left_le_join : ∀ x y : L, le x (join x y)
  right_le_join : ∀ x y : L, le y (join x y)
  join_le : ∀ x y z : L, le x z → le y z → le (join x y) z

  le_trans : ∀ x y z : L, le x y → le y z → le x z
  meet_le_left : ∀ x y : L, le (meet x y) x
  meet_le_right : ∀ x y : L, le (meet x y) y
  le_meet : ∀ x y z : L, le z x → le z y → le z (meet x y)

declarations.signature:
structure Skeleton (x y : ℕ) where
  base : Bal x y
  gen : ℕ → Bal x y
  ofBurnCoord : (n : ℕ) → base.burn ≤ n → Bal x y
  ofMintCoord : (n : ℕ) → base.mint ≤ n → Bal x y
  ofMeet : ℕ → Bal x y
  ofTotal : ℕ → Bal x y
  ofJoin : ℕ → Bal x y
  ofExcess : ℕ → Bal x y
  meet : Bal x y → Bal x y → Bal x y
  join : Bal x y → Bal x y → Bal x y
  base_eq : gen 0 = base
  faithful : ∀ k : ℕ, (gen k).burn - base.burn = k
  gen_complete : ∀ f : Bal x y, f = gen (f.burn - base.burn)
  ofBurn_burn : ∀ (n : ℕ) (h : base.burn ≤ n), (ofBurnCoord n h).burn = n
  ofMint_mint : ∀ (n : ℕ) (h : base.mint ≤ n), (ofMintCoord n h).mint = n
  ofMeet_eq : ∀ f : Bal x y, ofMeet (Nat.min f.burn f.mint) = f
  ofTotal_eq : ∀ f : Bal x y, ofTotal (f.burn + f.mint) = f
  ofJoin_eq : ∀ f : Bal x y, ofJoin (Nat.max f.burn f.mint) = f
  ofExcess_eq : ∀ f : Bal x y, ofExcess (f.burn - base.burn) = f
  base_min_burn : ∀ f : Bal x y, base.burn ≤ f.burn
  base_min_mint : ∀ f : Bal x y, base.mint ≤ f.mint
  meet_burn : ∀ f g : Bal x y, (meet f g).burn = Nat.min f.burn g.burn
  join_burn : ∀ f g : Bal x y, (join f g).burn = Nat.max f.burn g.burn
  meet_add_join : ∀ f g : Bal x y,
    (meet f g).burn + (join f g).burn = f.burn + g.burn

declarations.name: EthTotal.Bal.SkeletonLaws
declarations.signature:
structure SkeletonLaws : Prop where
  id_comp : ∀ (x y : ℕ) (f : Bal x y), (Bal.id x).comp f = f
  comp_id : ∀ (x y : ℕ) (f : Bal x y), f.comp (Bal.id y) = f
  comp_assoc : ∀ (x y z w : ℕ) (f : Bal x y) (g : Bal y z) (h : Bal z w),
    (f.comp g).comp h = f.comp (g.comp h)
  symm_symm : ∀ (x y : ℕ) (f : Bal x y), f.symm.symm = f
  symm_id : ∀ x : ℕ, (Bal.id x).symm = Bal.id x
  symm_comp : ∀ (x y z : ℕ) (f : Bal x y) (g : Bal y z),
    (f.comp g).symm = g.symm.comp f.symm
  all_normal : ∀ (x y : ℕ) (f : Bal x y),
    (f.comp f.symm).burn = (f.symm.comp f).burn
  action_free_right : ∀ (x y : ℕ) (f : Bal x y) (g : Bal y y),
    f.comp g = f → g = Bal.id y
  action_free_left : ∀ (x y : ℕ) (g : Bal x x) (f : Bal x y),
    g.comp f = f → g = Bal.id x
  cancel_right : ∀ (x y z : ℕ) (f g : Bal x y) (h : Bal y z),
    f.comp h = g.comp h → f = g
  cancel_left : ∀ (x y z : ℕ) (f : Bal x y) (g h : Bal y z),
    f.comp g = f.comp h → g = h
  core_discrete : ∀ (x : ℕ) (f g : Bal x x),
    f.comp g = Bal.id x → f = Bal.id x
  inv_is_dagger : ∀ (x y : ℕ) (f : Bal x y) (g : Bal y x),
    f.comp g = Bal.id x → g = f.symm
  torsion_free : ∀ (x : ℕ) (f : Bal x x) (n : ℕ),
    loopPow f (n + 1) = Bal.id x → f = Bal.id x
  complete_burn : ∀ (x y : ℕ) (f g : Bal x y), f.burn = g.burn → f = g
  complete_total : ∀ (x y : ℕ) (f g : Bal x y),
    f.burn + f.mint = g.burn + g.mint → f = g
  complete_meet : ∀ (x y : ℕ) (f g : Bal x y),
    Nat.min f.burn f.mint = Nat.min g.burn g.mint → f = g
  hom_lattice : ∀ x y : ℕ,
    IsDistribLattice (fun f g : Bal x y => meetHom f g)
      (fun f g : Bal x y => joinHom f g)
  char_class : ∀ (x y : ℕ) (f : Bal x y),
    parity (f.burn + f.mint) = parity (x + y)

declarations.name: EthTotal.notMem_eraseOneOfPoint
declarations.signature:
theorem notMem_eraseOneOfPoint {a : A} (dec : ∀ b : A, Decidable (b = a)) :
    ∀ {l : List A}, Distinct l → a ∉ eraseOneOfPoint dec l
  | [], _ => notMemNil
  | x :: l, Distinct.cons hx dl =>
      match dec x with
      | isTrue hxa =>
          fun hmem =>
            hx (Eq.subst (motive := fun z => z ∈ l) hxa.symm
              (Eq.subst (motive := fun s => a ∈ s)
                (eraseOneOfPoint_cons_pos dec hxa l) hmem))
      | isFalse hxa =>
          fun hmem =>
            memConsElim
              (Eq.subst (motive := fun s => a ∈ s)
                (eraseOneOfPoint_cons_neg dec hxa l) hmem)
              (fun hax => hxa hax.symm)
              (fun ht => notMem_eraseOneOfPoint dec dl ht)

  | [], _, h => absurd h notMemNil

declarations.signature:
theorem sumOver_update_needs_distinct [DecidableEq A] (a : A) (v : ℕ)
    (h : sumOver (fun b => if b = a then v else (0 : ℕ)) [a, a] + (0 : ℕ)
        = sumOver (fun _ : A => (0 : ℕ)) [a, a] + v) :

declarations.name: EthTotal.sumOver_eq_of_single_support
declarations.signature:
theorem sumOver_eq_of_single_support (f : A → ℕ) {a₀ : A} :
    ∀ {l : List A}, Distinct l → a₀ ∈ l →
      (∀ a ∈ l, a ≠ a₀ → f a = 0) → sumOver f l = f a₀
  | [], _, hmem, _ => absurd hmem notMemNil
  | x :: l, Distinct.cons hx dl, hmem, hz =>
      memConsElim hmem
        (fun ha₀x =>
          Eq.trans
            (congrArg (fun n => f x + n)
              (Eq.trans
                (sumOver_congr_mem l
                  (fun a ha =>
                    hz a (List.Mem.tail x ha)
                      (fun haa₀ =>
                        hx (Eq.subst (motive := fun z => z ∈ l)
                          (Eq.trans haa₀ ha₀x) ha))))
                (sumOver_zero l)))
            (Eq.trans (Nat.add_zero (f x)) (congrArg f ha₀x).symm))
        (fun ha₀l =>
          Eq.trans
            (congrArg (fun m => m + sumOver f l)
              (hz x (List.Mem.head l)
                (fun hxa₀ =>
                  hx (Eq.subst (motive := fun z => z ∈ l) hxa₀.symm ha₀l))))
            (Eq.trans (Nat.zero_add (sumOver f l))
              (sumOver_eq_of_single_support f dl ha₀l
                (fun a ha hne => hz a (List.Mem.tail x ha) hne))))

declarations.name: EthTotal.sumOver_eq_of_support_iff
declarations.signature:
theorem sumOver_eq_of_support_iff (f : A → ℕ) :
    ∀ {l₁ : List A}, Distinct l₁ → ∀ {l₂ : List A}, Distinct l₂ →
      (∀ a : A, f a ≠ 0 → (a ∈ l₁ ↔ a ∈ l₂)) →
      sumOver f l₁ = sumOver f l₂
  | [], _, l₂, _d₂, hiff =>
      (Eq.trans
        (sumOver_congr_mem l₂
          (fun a ha =>
            match hfa : f a with
            | 0 => hfa
            | _ + 1 =>
                absurd
                  ((hiff a (fun h0 =>
                      Nat.noConfusion (Eq.trans hfa.symm h0))).mpr ha)
                  notMemNil))
        (sumOver_zero l₂)).symm
  | x :: l₁, Distinct.cons hx d₁, l₂, d₂, hiff =>
      match hfx : f x with
      | 0 =>
          let hiff' : ∀ a : A, f a ≠ 0 → (a ∈ l₁ ↔ a ∈ l₂)

declarations.name: EthTotal.sumOver_eraseOneOfPoint
declarations.signature:
theorem sumOver_eraseOneOfPoint {a : A} (dec : ∀ b : A, Decidable (b = a))
    (f : A → ℕ) :
    ∀ (l : List A), a ∈ l →
      sumOver f (eraseOneOfPoint dec l) + f a = sumOver f l
  | [], h => absurd h notMemNil
  | x :: l, h =>
      match dec x with
      | isTrue hxa =>
          Eq.trans
            (congrArg (fun s => sumOver f s + f a)
              (eraseOneOfPoint_cons_pos dec hxa l))
            (Eq.trans
              (Nat.add_comm (sumOver f l) (f a))
              (congrArg (fun n => n + sumOver f l) (congrArg f hxa).symm))
      | isFalse hxa =>
          let hal : a ∈ l

declarations.name: EthTotal.sumOver_eraseOneOfPoint_of_zero
declarations.signature:
theorem sumOver_eraseOneOfPoint_of_zero {a : A}
    (dec : ∀ b : A, Decidable (b = a)) (f : A → ℕ) (hz : f a = 0) :
    ∀ (l : List A), sumOver f (eraseOneOfPoint dec l) = sumOver f l
  | [] => rfl
  | x :: l =>
      match dec x with
      | isTrue hxa =>
          Eq.trans
            (congrArg (fun s => sumOver f s)
              (eraseOneOfPoint_cons_pos dec hxa l))
            (Eq.trans
              (Nat.zero_add (sumOver f l)).symm
              (congrArg (fun n => n + sumOver f l)
                (Eq.trans (congrArg f hxa) hz).symm))
      | isFalse hxa =>
          Eq.trans
            (congrArg (fun s => sumOver f s)
              (eraseOneOfPoint_cons_neg dec hxa l))
            (congrArg (fun n => f x + n)
              (sumOver_eraseOneOfPoint_of_zero dec f hz l))

declarations.name: EthTotal.zero_of_sumOver_eraseOne_eq

declarations.name: EthTotal.Ledger.supply_acc_chain
declarations.signature:
theorem supply_acc_chain (Ls : ℕ → Ledger A) (bs ms : ℕ → ℕ)
    (h : ∀ i : ℕ, (Ls (i + 1)).supply + bs i = (Ls i).supply + ms i) :
    ∀ n : ℕ, (Ls n).supply + sumOver bs (List.range n)
      = (Ls 0).supply + sumOver ms (List.range n)
  | 0 => rfl
  | n + 1 =>
      Eq.trans
        (congrArg (fun l => (Ls (n + 1)).supply + sumOver bs l) (range_succ n))
        (Eq.trans
          (congrArg (fun m => (Ls (n + 1)).supply + m)
            (sumOver_append bs (List.range n) [n]))
          (Eq.trans
            (supply_acc_trans (supply_acc_chain Ls bs ms h n) (h n))
            (Eq.trans
              (congrArg (fun m => (Ls 0).supply + m)
                (sumOver_append ms (List.range n) [n])).symm
              (congrArg (fun l => (Ls 0).supply + sumOver ms l)
                (range_succ n)).symm)))

    (hs : s ∈ L.live) (hd : d ∈ L.live) (hsd : s ≠ d) (b : A) :
    ((L.setBal s (L.bal s - v) hs).setBal d
        ((L.setBal s (L.bal s - v) hs).bal d + v) hd).bal b
      = if b = d then L.bal d + v else if b = s then L.bal s - v else L.bal b

    (hs : s ∈ L.live) (hv : v ≤ L.bal s) (b : A) :
    ((L.setBal s (L.bal s - v) hs).setBal s
        ((L.setBal s (L.bal s - v) hs).bal s + v) hs).bal b = L.bal b

EthTotal.site_mem_mintSites
declarations.signature:
theorem site_mem_mintSites :
    ∀ (τ : Trace A) (e : Ev A), e ∈ τ → ∀ d : A, e.mintSite = some d →
      d ∈ mintSites τ
  | [], _, he, _, _ => absurd he notMemNil
  | Ev.mint d' _v :: τ, e, he, d, hd =>
      memConsElim he
        (fun hex =>
          Eq.subst (motive := fun z => z ∈ d' :: mintSites τ)
            (Option.some.inj
              (Eq.trans (congrArg Ev.mintSite hex).symm hd))
            (List.Mem.head (mintSites τ)))
        (fun het => List.Mem.tail d' (site_mem_mintSites τ e het d hd))
  | Ev.burn _s _v :: τ, e, he, d, hd =>
      memConsElim he
        (fun hex =>
          absurd (Eq.trans (congrArg Ev.mintSite hex).symm hd).symm
            (Option.some_ne_none d))
        (fun het => site_mem_mintSites τ e het d hd)

declarations.name: EthTotal.site_mem_burnSites
declarations.signature:
theorem site_mem_burnSites :
    ∀ (τ : Trace A) (e : Ev A), e ∈ τ → ∀ s : A, e.burnSite = some s →
      s ∈ burnSites τ
  | [], _, he, _, _ => absurd he notMemNil
  | Ev.burn s' _v :: τ, e, he, s, hs =>
      memConsElim he
        (fun hex =>
          Eq.subst (motive := fun z => z ∈ s' :: burnSites τ)
            (Option.some.inj
              (Eq.trans (congrArg Ev.burnSite hex).symm hs))
            (List.Mem.head (burnSites τ)))
        (fun het => List.Mem.tail s' (site_mem_burnSites τ e het s hs))
  | Ev.mint _d _v :: τ, e, he, s, hs =>
      memConsElim he
        (fun hex =>
          absurd (Eq.trans (congrArg Ev.burnSite hex).symm hs).symm
            (Option.some_ne_none s))
        (fun het => site_mem_burnSites τ e het s hs)

declarations.name: EthTotal.exists_of_mem_mintSites
declarations.signature:
theorem exists_of_mem_mintSites :
    ∀ (τ : Trace A) {a : A}, a ∈ mintSites τ →
      ∃ e : Ev A, e ∈ τ ∧ e.mintSite = some a
  | [], _, h => absurd h notMemNil
  | Ev.mint d v :: τ, _a, h =>
      memConsElim h
        (fun had =>
          ⟨Ev.mint d v, List.Mem.head τ, congrArg Option.some had.symm⟩)
        (fun hat =>
          match exists_of_mem_mintSites τ hat with
          | ⟨e, he, hs⟩ => ⟨e, List.Mem.tail (Ev.mint d v) he, hs⟩)
  | Ev.burn s v :: τ, _a, h =>
      match exists_of_mem_mintSites τ h with
      | ⟨e, he, hs⟩ => ⟨e, List.Mem.tail (Ev.burn s v) he, hs⟩

declarations.name: EthTotal.exists_of_mem_burnSites
declarations.signature:
theorem exists_of_mem_burnSites :
    ∀ (τ : Trace A) {a : A}, a ∈ burnSites τ →
      ∃ e : Ev A, e ∈ τ ∧ e.burnSite = some a
  | [], _, h => absurd h notMemNil
  | Ev.burn s v :: τ, _a, h =>
      memConsElim h
        (fun has =>
          ⟨Ev.burn s v, List.Mem.head τ, congrArg Option.some has.symm⟩)
        (fun hat =>
          match exists_of_mem_burnSites τ hat with
          | ⟨e, he, hs⟩ => ⟨e, List.Mem.tail (Ev.burn s v) he, hs⟩)
  | Ev.mint d v :: τ, _a, h =>
      match exists_of_mem_burnSites τ h with
      | ⟨e, he, hs⟩ => ⟨e, List.Mem.tail (Ev.mint d v) he, hs⟩

declarations.name: EthTotal.mintSiteEventDataOfPoint
declarations.signature:
def mintSiteEventDataOfPoint {a : A} (dec : ∀ b : A, Decidable (a = b)) :
    ∀ (τ : Trace A), a ∈ mintSites τ →
      Σ' (e : Ev A), e ∈ τ ∧ e.mintSite = some a
  | [], h => absurd h notMemNil
  | Ev.mint d v :: τ, h =>
      match dec d with
      | isTrue had =>
          ⟨Ev.mint d v, List.Mem.head τ, congrArg Option.some had.symm⟩
      | isFalse had =>
          match mintSiteEventDataOfPoint dec τ
              (memConsElim h (fun he => absurd he had) (fun ht => ht)) with
          | ⟨e, he, hs⟩ => ⟨e, List.Mem.tail (Ev.mint d v) he, hs⟩
  | Ev.burn s v :: τ, h =>
      match mintSiteEventDataOfPoint dec τ h with
      | ⟨e, he, hs⟩ => ⟨e, List.Mem.tail (Ev.burn s v) he, hs⟩

declarations.name: EthTotal.burnSiteEventDataOfPoint
declarations.signature:
def burnSiteEventDataOfPoint {a : A} (dec : ∀ b : A, Decidable (a = b)) :
    ∀ (τ : Trace A), a ∈ burnSites τ →
      Σ' (e : Ev A), e ∈ τ ∧ e.burnSite = some a
  | [], h => absurd h notMemNil
  | Ev.burn s v :: τ, h =>
      match dec s with
      | isTrue has =>
          ⟨Ev.burn s v, List.Mem.head τ, congrArg Option.some has.symm⟩
      | isFalse has =>
          match burnSiteEventDataOfPoint dec τ
              (memConsElim h (fun he => absurd he has) (fun ht => ht)) with
          | ⟨e, he, hs⟩ => ⟨e, List.Mem.tail (Ev.burn s v) he, hs⟩
  | Ev.mint d v :: τ, h =>
      match burnSiteEventDataOfPoint dec τ h with
      | ⟨e, he, hs⟩ => ⟨e, List.Mem.tail (Ev.mint d v) he, hs⟩

def mintSiteWeight (f : A → ℕ) : Ev A → ℕ

declarations.name: EthTotal.burnSiteWeight
declarations.signature:
def burnSiteWeight (f : A → ℕ) : Ev A → ℕ
  | Ev.burn s _ => f s
  | Ev.mint _ _ => 0

declarations.name: EthTotal.mintSite_of_pos_weight
declarations.signature:
theorem mintSite_of_pos_weight {a : A} (f : A → ℕ)
    (hsupp : ∀ c : A, f c ≠ 0 → c = a) :
    ∀ {e : Ev A}, 0 < mintSiteWeight f e → e.mintSite = some a
  | Ev.mint d _, hp =>
      congrArg Option.some
        (hsupp d (fun h0 =>
          Nat.lt_irrefl 0 (Eq.subst (motive := fun n => 0 < n) h0 hp)))
  | Ev.burn _ _, hp => absurd hp (Nat.lt_irrefl 0)

declarations.name: EthTotal.burnSite_of_pos_weight
declarations.signature:
theorem burnSite_of_pos_weight {a : A} (f : A → ℕ)
    (hsupp : ∀ c : A, f c ≠ 0 → c = a) :
    ∀ {e : Ev A}, 0 < burnSiteWeight f e → e.burnSite = some a
  | Ev.burn s _, hp =>
      congrArg Option.some
        (hsupp s (fun h0 =>
          Nat.lt_irrefl 0 (Eq.subst (motive := fun n => 0 < n) h0 hp)))
  | Ev.mint _ _, hp => absurd hp (Nat.lt_irrefl 0)

    ∀ {e : Ev A}, e.mintSite = some a → mintSiteWeight f e = f a
  | Ev.mint _d _, hd => congrArg f (Option.some.inj hd)
  | Ev.burn _ _, hd => absurd hd.symm (Option.some_ne_none a)

declarations.name: EthTotal.burnSiteWeight_of_site
declarations.signature:
theorem burnSiteWeight_of_site {a : A} (f : A → ℕ) :
    ∀ {e : Ev A}, e.burnSite = some a → burnSiteWeight f e = f a
  | Ev.burn _s _, hd => congrArg f (Option.some.inj hd)
  | Ev.mint _ _, hd => absurd hd.symm (Option.some_ne_none a)

            ∧ (∀ a ∈ mintSites τ', a ∈ mintSites τ))
        ∧ ((∀ a ∈ burnSites τ, a ∈ burnSites τ')
            ∧ (∀ a ∈ burnSites τ', a ∈ burnSites τ))

declarations.name: EthTotal.mintSites_eq_nil_of_no_mintSite
declarations.signature:
theorem mintSites_eq_nil_of_no_mintSite :
    ∀ τ : Trace A, (∀ e ∈ τ, e.mintSite = none) → mintSites τ = []
  | [], _ => rfl
  | Ev.mint d v :: τ, h =>
      absurd (h (Ev.mint d v) (List.Mem.head τ)) (Option.some_ne_none d)
  | Ev.burn _s _v :: τ, h =>
      mintSites_eq_nil_of_no_mintSite τ (fun e he => h e (List.Mem.tail _ he))

declarations.name: EthTotal.burnSites_eq_nil_of_no_burnSite
declarations.signature:
theorem burnSites_eq_nil_of_no_burnSite :
    ∀ τ : Trace A, (∀ e ∈ τ, e.burnSite = none) → burnSites τ = []
  | [], _ => rfl
  | Ev.burn s v :: τ, h =>
      absurd (h (Ev.burn s v) (List.Mem.head τ)) (Option.some_ne_none s)
  | Ev.mint _d _v :: τ, h =>
      burnSites_eq_nil_of_no_burnSite τ (fun e he => h e (List.Mem.tail _ he))

declarations.name: EthTotal.mintSites_eq_nil_iff
declarations.signature:
theorem mintSites_eq_nil_iff (τ : Trace A) :
    mintSites τ = [] ↔ ∀ e ∈ τ, e.mintSite = none

declarations.name: EthTotal.burnSites_eq_nil_iff
declarations.signature:
theorem burnSites_eq_nil_iff (τ : Trace A) :
    burnSites τ = [] ↔ ∀ e ∈ τ, e.burnSite = none

declarations.name: EthTotal.siteConfined_nil_nil_iff
declarations.signature:
theorem siteConfined_nil_nil_iff : ∀ τ : Trace A,
    SiteConfined ([] : List A) ([] : List A) τ ↔ τ = ([] : Trace A)
  | [] =>
      Iff.intro (fun _ => rfl)
        (fun _ => SiteConfined.nil ([] : List A) ([] : List A))
  | e :: τ =>
      Iff.intro
        (fun h =>
          match Ev.site_dichotomy e with
          | Or.inl hm =>
              absurd
                (Eq.trans hm.left.symm
                  (site_none_of_confined_nil (h.mint_mem e (List.Mem.head τ))))
                (Option.some_ne_none e.site)
          | Or.inr hb =>
              absurd
                (Eq.trans hb.right.left.symm
                  (site_none_of_confined_nil (h.burn_mem e (List.Mem.head τ))))
                (Option.some_ne_none e.site))
        (fun h => nomatch h)

    (mintSites τ = ([] : List A) ∧ burnSites τ = ([] : List A))

declarations.signature:
theorem minted_append : ∀ (τ₁ τ₂ : Trace A), minted (τ₁ ++ τ₂) = minted τ₁ + minted τ₂
  | [], τ₂ => (Nat.zero_add (minted τ₂)).symm
  | e :: τ₁, τ₂ =>
      Eq.trans
        (congrArg (fun n => e.mintAmount + n) (minted_append τ₁ τ₂))
        (Nat.add_assoc e.mintAmount (minted τ₁) (minted τ₂)).symm

        (Nat.add_assoc e.burnAmount (burned τ₁) (burned τ₂)).symm

declarations.name: EthTotal.exists_pos_mintAmount_of_minted_pos
declarations.signature:
theorem exists_pos_mintAmount_of_minted_pos :
    ∀ (τ : Trace A), 0 < minted τ → ∃ e : Ev A, e ∈ τ ∧ 0 < e.mintAmount
  | [], h => absurd h (Nat.lt_irrefl 0)
  | e :: τ, h =>
      match Nat.eq_zero_or_pos e.mintAmount with
      | Or.inr hp => ⟨e, List.Mem.head τ, hp⟩
      | Or.inl hz =>
          match exists_pos_mintAmount_of_minted_pos τ
              (Eq.subst (motive := fun n => 0 < n)
                (Eq.trans (congrArg (fun m => m + minted τ) hz)
                  (Nat.zero_add (minted τ)))
                h) with
          | ⟨x, hm, hp⟩ => ⟨x, List.Mem.tail e hm, hp⟩

declarations.name: EthTotal.exists_pos_burnAmount_of_burned_pos
declarations.signature:
theorem exists_pos_burnAmount_of_burned_pos :
    ∀ (τ : Trace A), 0 < burned τ → ∃ e : Ev A, e ∈ τ ∧ 0 < e.burnAmount
  | [], h => absurd h (Nat.lt_irrefl 0)
  | e :: τ, h =>
      match Nat.eq_zero_or_pos e.burnAmount with
      | Or.inr hp => ⟨e, List.Mem.head τ, hp⟩
      | Or.inl hz =>
          match exists_pos_burnAmount_of_burned_pos τ
              (Eq.subst (motive := fun n => 0 < n)
                (Eq.trans (congrArg (fun m => m + burned τ) hz)
                  (Nat.zero_add (burned τ)))
                h) with
          | ⟨x, hm, hp⟩ => ⟨x, List.Mem.tail e hm, hp⟩

declarations.name: EthTotal.firstPosMintAmount
declarations.signature:
def firstPosMintAmount : ∀ (τ : Trace A), 0 < minted τ →
    Σ' (e : Ev A), e ∈ τ ∧ 0 < e.mintAmount
  | [], h => absurd h (Nat.lt_irrefl 0)
  | e :: τ, h =>
      match hme : e.mintAmount with
      | y + 1 =>
          ⟨e, List.Mem.head τ,
           Eq.subst (motive := fun n => 0 < n) hme.symm (Nat.succ_pos y)⟩
      | 0 =>
          match firstPosMintAmount τ
              (Eq.subst (motive := fun n => 0 < n)
                (Eq.trans (congrArg (fun m => m + minted τ) hme)
                  (Nat.zero_add (minted τ)))
                h) with
          | ⟨x, hm, hp⟩ => ⟨x, List.Mem.tail e hm, hp⟩

declarations.signature:

  | [], h => absurd h (Nat.lt_irrefl 0)
  | e :: τ, h =>
      match hbe : e.burnAmount with
      | y + 1 =>
          ⟨e, List.Mem.head τ,
           Eq.subst (motive := fun n => 0 < n) hbe.symm (Nat.succ_pos y)⟩
      | 0 =>
          match firstPosBurnAmount τ
              (Eq.subst (motive := fun n => 0 < n)
                (Eq.trans (congrArg (fun m => m + burned τ) hbe)
                  (Nat.zero_add (burned τ)))
                h) with
          | ⟨x, hm, hp⟩ => ⟨x, List.Mem.tail e hm, hp⟩

  | [], _ => rfl
  | Ev.mint d _v :: τ₁, τ₂ =>

    (hψ : ∀ τ₁ τ₂ : Trace A, ψ (τ₁ ++ τ₂) = ψ τ₂ ++ ψ τ₁)

declarations.name: EthTotal.Ev.eq_of_measurements
declarations.signature:
theorem Ev.eq_of_measurements : ∀ {e e' : Ev A},
    e.mintSite = e'.mintSite → e.burnSite = e'.burnSite →
    e.mintAmount = e'.mintAmount → e.burnAmount = e'.burnAmount → e = e'
  | .mint d v, .mint _d' _v', hm, _, ha, _ =>
      Eq.trans (congrArg (fun n => Ev.mint d n) ha)
        (congrArg (fun x => Ev.mint x _v') (Option.some.inj hm))
  | .mint d _, .burn _ _, hm, _, _, _ => absurd hm (Option.some_ne_none d)
  | .burn s _, .mint _ _, _, hb, _, _ => absurd hb (Option.some_ne_none s)
  | .burn s v, .burn _s' _v', _, hb, _, hb2 =>
      Eq.trans (congrArg (fun n => Ev.burn s n) hb2)
        (congrArg (fun x => Ev.burn x _v') (Option.some.inj hb))

declarations.name: EthTotal.antihom_involutive
declarations.signature:
theorem antihom_involutive (ψ : Trace A → Trace A)
    (hnil : ψ ([] : Trace A) = ([] : Trace A))
    (hψ : ∀ τ₁ τ₂ : Trace A, ψ (τ₁ ++ τ₂) = ψ τ₂ ++ ψ τ₁)
    (hgen : ∀ e : Ev A, ψ (ψ [e]) = [e]) :
    ∀ τ : Trace A, ψ (ψ τ) = τ
  | [] => Eq.trans (congrArg ψ hnil) hnil
  | e :: τ =>
      Eq.trans (congrArg ψ (hψ [e] τ))
        (Eq.trans (hψ (ψ τ) (ψ [e]))
          (Eq.trans (congrArg (fun t => t ++ ψ (ψ τ)) (hgen e))
            (congrArg (fun t => e :: t)
              (antihom_involutive ψ hnil hψ hgen τ))))

declarations.name: EthTotal.minted_antihom
declarations.signature:
theorem minted_antihom (ψ : Trace A → Trace A)
    (hnil : ψ ([] : Trace A) = ([] : Trace A))
    (hψ : ∀ τ₁ τ₂ : Trace A, ψ (τ₁ ++ τ₂) = ψ τ₂ ++ ψ τ₁)
    (hgen : ∀ e : Ev A, minted (ψ [e]) = burned [e]) :
    ∀ τ : Trace A, minted (ψ τ) = burned τ
  | [] => congrArg minted hnil
  | e :: τ =>
      Eq.trans (congrArg minted (hψ [e] τ))
        (Eq.trans (minted_append (ψ τ) (ψ [e]))
          (Eq.trans
            (congrArg (fun n => n + minted (ψ [e]))
              (minted_antihom ψ hnil hψ hgen τ))
            (Eq.trans (congrArg (fun n => burned τ + n) (hgen e))
              (Nat.add_comm (burned τ) (burned [e])))))

declarations.name: EthTotal.burned_antihom
declarations.signature:
theorem burned_antihom (ψ : Trace A → Trace A)
    (hnil : ψ ([] : Trace A) = ([] : Trace A))
    (hψ : ∀ τ₁ τ₂ : Trace A, ψ (τ₁ ++ τ₂) = ψ τ₂ ++ ψ τ₁)
    (hgen : ∀ e : Ev A, burned (ψ [e]) = minted [e]) :
    ∀ τ : Trace A, burned (ψ τ) = minted τ
  | [] => congrArg burned hnil
  | e :: τ =>
      Eq.trans (congrArg burned (hψ [e] τ))
        (Eq.trans (burned_append (ψ τ) (ψ [e]))
          (Eq.trans
            (congrArg (fun n => n + burned (ψ [e]))
              (burned_antihom ψ hnil hψ hgen τ))
            (Eq.trans (congrArg (fun n => minted τ + n) (hgen e))
              (Nat.add_comm (minted τ) (minted [e])))))

declarations.name: EthTotal.mem_antihom
declarations.signature:
theorem mem_antihom (ψ : Trace A → Trace A)
    (hψ : ∀ τ₁ τ₂ : Trace A, ψ (τ₁ ++ τ₂) = ψ τ₂ ++ ψ τ₁) :
    ∀ (τ : Trace A) (e : Ev A), e ∈ τ → ∀ x : Ev A, x ∈ ψ [e] → x ∈ ψ τ
  | [], _, h, _, _ => absurd h notMemNil
  | y :: τ, e, h, x, hx =>
      Eq.subst (motive := fun t => x ∈ t) (hψ [y] τ).symm
        (memConsElim h
          (fun he =>
            memAppendRight (ψ τ) (ψ [y])
              (Eq.subst (motive := fun z => x ∈ ψ [z]) he hx))
          (fun ht =>
            memAppendLeft (ψ τ) (ψ [y]) (mem_antihom ψ hψ τ e ht x hx)))

declarations.name: EthTotal.mem_of_mem_antihom
declarations.signature:
theorem mem_of_mem_antihom (ψ : Trace A → Trace A)
    (hinv : ∀ τ : Trace A, ψ (ψ τ) = τ)
    (hψ : ∀ τ₁ τ₂ : Trace A, ψ (τ₁ ++ τ₂) = ψ τ₂ ++ ψ τ₁)
    (τ : Trace A) (e : Ev A) (h : e ∈ ψ τ) :
    ∀ x : Ev A, x ∈ ψ [e] → x ∈ τ
