declarations.name: EthTotal.Ev.exists_parts
declarations.signature:
theorem Ev.exists_parts : ∀ e : Ev A,
    ∃ a : A, ∃ v : ℕ,
      (e.mintSite = some a ∧ e.burnSite = none
        ∧ e.mintAmount = v ∧ e.burnAmount = 0)
      ∨ (e.mintSite = none ∧ e.burnSite = some a
        ∧ e.burnAmount = v ∧ e.mintAmount = 0)
  | .mint d v => ⟨d, v, Or.inl ⟨rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl⟩⟩
  | .burn s v => ⟨s, v, Or.inr ⟨rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl⟩⟩

declarations.name: EthTotal.Ev.eq_of_parts
declarations.signature:
theorem Ev.eq_of_parts {e : Ev A} {a a' : A} {v v' : ℕ}
    (h : (e.mintSite = some a ∧ e.burnSite = none
        ∧ e.mintAmount = v ∧ e.burnAmount = 0)
      ∨ (e.mintSite = none ∧ e.burnSite = some a
        ∧ e.burnAmount = v ∧ e.mintAmount = 0))
    (h' : (e.mintSite = some a' ∧ e.burnSite = none
        ∧ e.mintAmount = v' ∧ e.burnAmount = 0)
      ∨ (e.mintSite = none ∧ e.burnSite = some a'
        ∧ e.burnAmount = v' ∧ e.mintAmount = 0)) :
    a = a' ∧ v = v'

theorem Ev.site_dichotomy : ∀ e : Ev A,

      ∧ e.mintAmount = e.amount ∧ e.burnAmount = 0)
    ∨ (e.mintSite = none ∧ e.burnSite = some e.site
      ∧ e.burnAmount = e.amount ∧ e.mintAmount = 0)

declarations.name: EthTotal.Ev.eq_or_eq_swap
declarations.signature:
theorem Ev.eq_or_eq_swap : ∀ {e e' : Ev A},
    e.site = e'.site → e.amount = e'.amount → e' = e ∨ e' = e.swap
  | .mint d _v, .mint _d' v', hs, ha =>
      Or.inl
        (Eq.trans (congrArg (fun z => Ev.mint z v') hs.symm)
          (congrArg (fun w => Ev.mint d w) ha.symm))
  | .mint d _v, .burn _s' w', hs, ha =>
      Or.inr
        (Eq.trans (congrArg (fun z => Ev.burn z w') hs.symm)
          (congrArg (fun w => Ev.burn d w) ha.symm))
  | .burn s _v, .mint _d' v', hs, ha =>
      Or.inr
        (Eq.trans (congrArg (fun z => Ev.mint z v') hs.symm)
          (congrArg (fun w => Ev.mint s w) ha.symm))
  | .burn s _v, .burn _s' v', hs, ha =>
      Or.inl
        (Eq.trans (congrArg (fun z => Ev.burn z v') hs.symm)
          (congrArg (fun w => Ev.burn s w) ha.symm))

declarations.name: EthTotal.Ev.decEqOfSiteEq
declarations.signature:
def Ev.decEqOfSiteEq : ∀ {e e' : Ev A}, e.site = e'.site → Decidable (e = e')
  | .mint d v, .mint d' v', hs =>
      match Nat.decEq v v' with
      | isFalse hv => isFalse (fun h => hv (congrArg Ev.amount h))
      | isTrue hv =>
          isTrue
            (Eq.trans (congrArg (fun z => Ev.mint z v) hs)
              (congrArg (fun w => Ev.mint d' w) hv))
  | .burn s v, .burn s' v', hs =>
      match Nat.decEq v v' with
      | isFalse hv => isFalse (fun h => hv (congrArg Ev.amount h))
      | isTrue hv =>
          isTrue
            (Eq.trans (congrArg (fun z => Ev.burn z v) hs)
              (congrArg (fun w => Ev.burn s' w) hv))
  | .mint _ _, .burn _ _, _ =>
      isFalse (fun h => absurd (congrArg Ev.mintSite h) (Option.some_ne_none _))
  | .burn _ _, .mint _ _, _ =>
      isFalse (fun h => absurd (congrArg Ev.burnSite h) (Option.some_ne_none _))

declarations.signature:
theorem Ev.total_amount : ∀ e : Ev A, e.mintAmount + e.burnAmount = e.amount

  | .burn _ v => Nat.zero_add v

declarations.name: EthTotal.total_measure_sum
declarations.signature:
theorem total_measure_sum : ∀ τ : Trace A,
    minted τ + burned τ = sumOver Ev.amount τ
  | [] => rfl
  | e :: τ =>
      Eq.trans
        (Eq.trans
          (Nat.add_assoc e.mintAmount (minted τ) (e.burnAmount + burned τ))
          (Eq.trans
            (congrArg (fun n => e.mintAmount + n)
              (Eq.trans
                (Nat.add_assoc (minted τ) e.burnAmount (burned τ)).symm
                (Eq.trans
                  (congrArg (fun m => m + burned τ)
                    (Nat.add_comm (minted τ) e.burnAmount))
                  (Nat.add_assoc e.burnAmount (minted τ) (burned τ)))))
            (Nat.add_assoc e.mintAmount e.burnAmount
              (minted τ + burned τ)).symm))
        (Eq.trans
          (congrArg (fun n => n + (minted τ + burned τ)) (Ev.total_amount e))
          (congrArg (fun n => e.amount + n) (total_measure_sum τ)))

declarations.signature:
theorem conjOnly_conjOnly : ∀ τ : Trace A, conjOnly (conjOnly τ) = τ
  | [] => rfl

  | .mint d v :: τ => congrArg (fun t => Ev.mint d v :: t) (Trace.map_id τ)

  | [] => rfl
  | .mint d v :: τ =>
      congrArg (fun t => Ev.mint (ψ (φ d)) v :: t) (Trace.map_comp φ ψ τ)
  | .burn s v :: τ =>
      congrArg (fun t => Ev.burn (ψ (φ s)) v :: t) (Trace.map_comp φ ψ τ)

theorem minted_map {A : Type u} {B : Type v} (φ : A → B) :

  | [] => rfl
  | e :: τ =>
      Eq.trans

        (congrArg (fun n => n + minted τ) (Ev.mintAmount_map φ e))

  | [] => rfl

declarations.name: EthTotal.conj_map
declarations.signature:
theorem conj_map {A : Type u} {B : Type v} (φ : A → B) :
    ∀ τ : Trace A, conj (Trace.map φ τ) = Trace.map φ (conj τ)
  | [] => rfl
  | e :: τ =>
      Eq.trans
        (congrArg (fun t => t ++ [(Ev.map φ e).swap]) (conj_map φ τ))
        (Eq.trans
          (congrArg (fun x => Trace.map φ (conj τ) ++ [x])
            (Ev.map_swap φ e).symm)
          (Trace.map_append φ (conj τ) [e.swap]).symm)

declarations.name: EthTotal.mem_mintPairs_iff
declarations.signature:
theorem mem_mintPairs_iff (d : A) (v : ℕ) :
    ∀ τ : Trace A, (d, v) ∈ mintPairs τ ↔ Ev.mint d v ∈ τ
  | [] =>
      Iff.intro (fun h => absurd h notMemNil) (fun h => absurd h notMemNil)
  | Ev.mint d' v' :: τ =>
      Iff.intro
        (fun h =>
          memConsElim h
            (fun he =>
              Eq.subst (motive := fun e => e ∈ Ev.mint d' v' :: τ)
                (congrArg (fun p : A × ℕ => Ev.mint p.1 p.2) he).symm
                (List.Mem.head τ))
            (fun ht =>
              List.Mem.tail (Ev.mint d' v') ((mem_mintPairs_iff d v τ).mp ht)))
        (fun h =>
          memConsElim h
            (fun he =>
              Eq.subst (motive := fun p => p ∈ (d', v') :: mintPairs τ)
                (congrArg (fun e : Ev A => (e.site, e.amount)) he).symm
                (List.Mem.head (mintPairs τ)))
            (fun ht =>
              List.Mem.tail (d', v') ((mem_mintPairs_iff d v τ).mpr ht)))
  | Ev.burn s' v' :: τ =>
      Iff.intro
        (fun h =>
          List.Mem.tail (Ev.burn s' v') ((mem_mintPairs_iff d v τ).mp h))
        (fun h =>
          memConsElim h
            (fun he =>
              absurd (congrArg Ev.mintSite he) (Option.some_ne_none d))
            (fun ht => (mem_mintPairs_iff d v τ).mpr ht))

declarations.name: EthTotal.mem_burnPairs_iff
declarations.signature:
theorem mem_burnPairs_iff (s : A) (v : ℕ) :
    ∀ τ : Trace A, (s, v) ∈ burnPairs τ ↔ Ev.burn s v ∈ τ
  | [] =>
      Iff.intro (fun h => absurd h notMemNil) (fun h => absurd h notMemNil)
  | Ev.burn s' v' :: τ =>
      Iff.intro
        (fun h =>
          memConsElim h
            (fun he =>
              Eq.subst (motive := fun e => e ∈ Ev.burn s' v' :: τ)
                (congrArg (fun p : A × ℕ => Ev.burn p.1 p.2) he).symm
                (List.Mem.head τ))
            (fun ht =>
              List.Mem.tail (Ev.burn s' v') ((mem_burnPairs_iff s v τ).mp ht)))
        (fun h =>
          memConsElim h
            (fun he =>
              Eq.subst (motive := fun p => p ∈ (s', v') :: burnPairs τ)
                (congrArg (fun e : Ev A => (e.site, e.amount)) he).symm
                (List.Mem.head (burnPairs τ)))
            (fun ht =>
              List.Mem.tail (s', v') ((mem_burnPairs_iff s v τ).mpr ht)))
  | Ev.mint d' v' :: τ =>
      Iff.intro
        (fun h =>
          List.Mem.tail (Ev.mint d' v') ((mem_burnPairs_iff s v τ).mp h))
        (fun h =>
          memConsElim h
            (fun he =>
              absurd (congrArg Ev.burnSite he) (Option.some_ne_none s))
            (fun ht => (mem_burnPairs_iff s v τ).mpr ht))

declarations.name: EthTotal.mintPairs_conjOnly
declarations.signature:
theorem mintPairs_conjOnly :
    ∀ τ : Trace A, mintPairs (conjOnly τ) = burnPairs τ
  | [] => rfl
  | Ev.burn s v :: τ =>
      congrArg (fun l => (s, v) :: l) (mintPairs_conjOnly τ)
  | Ev.mint _d _v :: τ => mintPairs_conjOnly τ

declarations.name: EthTotal.burnPairs_conjOnly
declarations.signature:
theorem burnPairs_conjOnly :
    ∀ τ : Trace A, burnPairs (conjOnly τ) = mintPairs τ
  | [] => rfl
  | Ev.mint d v :: τ =>
      congrArg (fun l => (d, v) :: l) (burnPairs_conjOnly τ)
  | Ev.burn _s _v :: τ => burnPairs_conjOnly τ

declarations.name: EthTotal.supply_eq_of_double_entry
declarations.signature:
theorem supply_eq_of_double_entry {M K : Ledger A} {s d : A} {v : ℕ}
    (hs : s ∈ M.live) (hd : d ∈ M.live) (hlive : K.live = M.live)
    (hsrc : K.bal s + v = M.bal s) (hdst : K.bal d = M.bal d + v)
    (hdec : ∀ a : A, a ≠ s → M.bal a ≤ K.bal a)
    (hinc : ∀ a : A, a ≠ d → K.bal a ≤ M.bal a) :
    K.supply = M.supply

declarations.name: EthTotal.XferReach
declarations.signature:
inductive XferReach (L : Ledger A) : Ledger A → Prop where
  | refl {K : Ledger A} (hlive : K.live = L.live)
      (hbal : ∀ a : A, K.bal a = L.bal a) : XferReach L K
  | step {M K : Ledger A} (s d : A) (v : ℕ)
      (hs : s ∈ M.live) (hd : d ∈ M.live)
      (h : XferReach L M) (hlive : K.live = M.live)
      (hsrc : K.bal s + v = M.bal s)
      (hdst : K.bal d = M.bal d + v)
      (hdec : ∀ a : A, a ≠ s → M.bal a ≤ K.bal a)
      (hinc : ∀ a : A, a ≠ d → K.bal a ≤ M.bal a) :
      XferReach L K

declarations.name: EthTotal.XferReach.live_eq
declarations.signature:
theorem live_eq {L : Ledger A} :
    ∀ {K : Ledger A}, XferReach L K → K.live = L.live
  | _, refl hlive _ => hlive
  | _, step _ _ _ _ _ h hlive _ _ _ _ => Eq.trans hlive (live_eq h)

declarations.name: EthTotal.XferReach.supply_eq
declarations.signature:
theorem supply_eq {L : Ledger A} :
    ∀ {K : Ledger A}, XferReach L K → K.supply = L.supply
  | _, refl _ hbal => supply_eq_of_bal_eq L _ hbal
  | _, step _s _d _v hs hd h hlive hsrc hdst hdec hinc =>
      Eq.trans
        (supply_eq_of_double_entry hs hd hlive hsrc hdst hdec hinc)
        (supply_eq h)

declarations.name: EthTotal.XferReach.transport
declarations.signature:
theorem transport {L : Ledger A} :
    ∀ {M M' : Ledger A}, M.live = M'.live → (∀ a : A, M.bal a = M'.bal a) →
      XferReach L M → XferReach L M'
  | _, _, hl, hb, refl hlive hbal =>
      refl (Eq.trans hl.symm hlive) (fun a => Eq.trans (hb a).symm (hbal a))
  | _, _, hl, hb, step (M := N) s d v hs hd h hlive hsrc hdst hdec hinc =>
      step s d v hs hd h (Eq.trans hl.symm hlive)
        (Eq.trans (congrArg (fun n => n + v) (hb s).symm) hsrc)
        (Eq.trans (hb d).symm hdst)
        (fun a hne =>
          Eq.subst (motive := fun n => N.bal a ≤ n) (hb a) (hdec a hne))
        (fun a hne =>
          Eq.subst (motive := fun n => n ≤ N.bal a) (hb a) (hinc a hne))

declarations.name: EthTotal.XferReach.trans
declarations.signature:
theorem trans {L M : Ledger A} (h₁ : XferReach L M) :
    ∀ {K : Ledger A}, XferReach M K → XferReach L K
  | _, refl hlive hbal =>
      transport hlive.symm (fun a => (hbal a).symm) h₁
  | _, step s d v hs hd h₂ hlive hsrc hdst hdec hinc =>
      step s d v hs hd (trans h₁ h₂) hlive hsrc hdst hdec hinc

declarations.name: EthTotal.XferReach.symm
declarations.signature:
theorem symm {L : Ledger A} :
    ∀ {K : Ledger A}, XferReach L K → XferReach K L
  | _, refl hlive hbal =>
      refl hlive.symm (fun a => (hbal a).symm)
  | _, step s d v hs hd h hlive hsrc hdst hdec hinc =>
      trans
        (step d s v
          (Eq.subst (motive := fun l => d ∈ l) hlive.symm hd)
          (Eq.subst (motive := fun l => s ∈ l) hlive.symm hs)
          (refl rfl (fun _ => rfl))
          hlive.symm
          hdst.symm
          hsrc.symm
          hinc
          hdec)
        (symm h)

declarations.name: EthTotal.xferReachEquivalence
declarations.signature:
theorem xferReachEquivalence :
    Equivalence (fun L K : Ledger A => XferReach L K)

declarations.name: EthTotal.xfer_step_determinedOfPoint
declarations.signature:
theorem xfer_step_determinedOfPoint {M K : Ledger A} (s d : A) (v : ℕ)
    (decS : ∀ b : A, Decidable (b = s)) (decD : ∀ b : A, Decidable (b = d))
    (hs : s ∈ M.live) (hd : d ∈ M.live) (hsd : s ≠ d)
    (hsrc : K.bal s + v = M.bal s) (hdst : K.bal d = M.bal d + v)
    (hdec : ∀ a : A, a ≠ s → M.bal a ≤ K.bal a)
    (hinc : ∀ a : A, a ≠ d → K.bal a ≤ M.bal a) :
    ∀ b : A, ((M.setBalOfPoint s decS (M.bal s - v) hs).setBalOfPoint d decD
      ((M.setBalOfPoint s decS (M.bal s - v) hs).bal d + v) hd).bal b
      = K.bal b

declarations.name: EthTotal.xfer_step_determined
declarations.signature:
theorem xfer_step_determined [inst : DecidableEq A] {M K : Ledger A} (s d : A)
    (v : ℕ)
    (hs : s ∈ M.live) (hd : d ∈ M.live) (hsd : s ≠ d)
    (hsrc : K.bal s + v = M.bal s) (hdst : K.bal d = M.bal d + v)
    (hdec : ∀ a : A, a ≠ s → M.bal a ≤ K.bal a)
    (hinc : ∀ a : A, a ≠ d → K.bal a ≤ M.bal a) :
    ∀ b : A, ((M.setBal s (M.bal s - v) hs).setBal d
      ((M.setBal s (M.bal s - v) hs).bal d + v) hd).bal b = K.bal b

EthTotal.xfer_step_degenerateOfPoint
declarations.signature:
theorem xfer_step_degenerateOfPoint {M K : Ledger A} {s d : A} {v : ℕ}
    (dec : ∀ b : A, Decidable (b = s))
    (hsd : s = d) (hsrc : K.bal s + v = M.bal s) (hdst : K.bal d = M.bal d + v)
    (hdec : ∀ a : A, a ≠ s → M.bal a ≤ K.bal a)
    (hinc : ∀ a : A, a ≠ d → K.bal a ≤ M.bal a) :
    ∀ b : A, M.bal b = K.bal b

EthTotal.XferReach.elim_pred
declarations.signature:
theorem XferReach.elim_pred [inst : DecidableEq A] {L : Ledger A}
    (P : Ledger A → Prop)
    (hresp : ∀ M M' : Ledger A, M.live = M'.live →
      (∀ a : A, M.bal a = M'.bal a) → P M → P M')
    (hstep : ∀ (M : Ledger A) (s d : A) (v : ℕ) (hs : s ∈ M.live)
      (hd : d ∈ M.live), s ≠ d → v ≤ M.bal s → P M →
      P ((M.setBal s (M.bal s - v) hs).setBal d
          ((M.setBal s (M.bal s - v) hs).bal d + v) hd)) :
    ∀ {K : Ledger A}, XferReach L K → P L → P K
  | _, .refl hlive hbal, hP =>
      hresp L _ hlive.symm (fun a => (hbal a).symm) hP
  | K, .step (M := N) s d v hs hd h hlive hsrc hdst hdec hinc, hP =>
      let hPN : P N

declarations.name: EthTotal.XferPath
declarations.signature:
inductive XferPath (L : Ledger A) : Ledger A → Type u where
  | refl {K : Ledger A} (hlive : K.live = L.live)
      (hbal : ∀ a : A, K.bal a = L.bal a) : XferPath L K
  | step {M K : Ledger A} (s d : A) (v : ℕ)
      (hs : s ∈ M.live) (hd : d ∈ M.live)
      (p : XferPath L M) (hlive : K.live = M.live)
      (hsrc : K.bal s + v = M.bal s)
      (hdst : K.bal d = M.bal d + v)
      (hdec : ∀ a : A, a ≠ s → M.bal a ≤ K.bal a)
      (hinc : ∀ a : A, a ≠ d → K.bal a ≤ M.bal a) :
      XferPath L K

declarations.name: EthTotal.XferPath.toReach
declarations.signature:
theorem toReach {L : Ledger A} :
    ∀ {K : Ledger A}, XferPath L K → XferReach L K
  | _, refl hlive hbal => XferReach.refl hlive hbal
  | _, step s d v hs hd p hlive hsrc hdst hdec hinc =>
      XferReach.step s d v hs hd (toReach p) hlive hsrc hdst hdec hinc

declarations.name: EthTotal.XferPath.length
declarations.signature:
def length {L : Ledger A} : ∀ {K : Ledger A}, XferPath L K → ℕ
  | _, refl _ _ => 0
  | _, step _ _ _ _ _ p _ _ _ _ _ => length p + 1

declarations.name: EthTotal.XferPath.transport
declarations.signature:
def transport {L : Ledger A} :
    ∀ {M M' : Ledger A}, M.live = M'.live → (∀ a : A, M.bal a = M'.bal a) →
      XferPath L M → XferPath L M'
  | _, _, hl, hb, refl hlive hbal =>
      refl (Eq.trans hl.symm hlive) (fun a => Eq.trans (hb a).symm (hbal a))
  | _, _, hl, hb, step (M := N) s d v hs hd p hlive hsrc hdst hdec hinc =>
      step s d v hs hd p (Eq.trans hl.symm hlive)
        (Eq.trans (congrArg (fun n => n + v) (hb s).symm) hsrc)
        (Eq.trans (hb d).symm hdst)
        (fun a hne =>
          Eq.subst (motive := fun n => N.bal a ≤ n) (hb a) (hdec a hne))
        (fun a hne =>
          Eq.subst (motive := fun n => n ≤ N.bal a) (hb a) (hinc a hne))

declarations.name: EthTotal.XferPath.length_transport
declarations.signature:
theorem length_transport {L : Ledger A} :
    ∀ {M M' : Ledger A} (hl : M.live = M'.live)
      (hb : ∀ a : A, M.bal a = M'.bal a) (p : XferPath L M),
      (transport hl hb p).length = p.length
  | _, _, _, _, refl _ _ => rfl
  | _, _, _, _, step _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ => rfl

declarations.name: EthTotal.XferPath.of_fiber_bounded
declarations.signature:
def of_fiber_bounded [inst : DecidableEq A] {L₀ : Ledger A} (L' : Ledger A) :
    ∀ (n : ℕ) (L : Ledger A), L'.live = L.live → L'.supply = L.supply →
      sumOver (fun a => L.bal a - L'.bal a) L.live ≤ n →
      (acc : XferPath L₀ L) →
      Σ' (p : XferPath L₀ L'), p.length ≤ acc.length + n
  | 0, L, hlive, hsupply, hμ, acc =>
      let hbal

declarations.name: EthTotal.XferPath.of_fiber
declarations.signature:
def of_fiber [DecidableEq A] (L L' : Ledger A)
    (hlive : L'.live = L.live) (hsupply : L'.supply = L.supply) :
    Σ' (p : XferPath L L'),
      p.length ≤ sumOver (fun a => L.bal a - L'.bal a) L.live

declarations.name: EthTotal.XferPath.bal_eq_of_length_zero
declarations.signature:
theorem bal_eq_of_length_zero {L L' : Ledger A} :
    ∀ p : XferPath L L', p.length = 0 → ∀ a : A, L'.bal a = L.bal a
  | .refl _ hbal, _ => hbal
  | .step _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _, h => nomatch h

declarations.name: EthTotal.XferPath.live_eq_of_length_zero
declarations.signature:
theorem live_eq_of_length_zero {L L' : Ledger A} :
    ∀ p : XferPath L L', p.length = 0 → L'.live = L.live
  | .refl hlive _, _ => hlive
  | .step _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _, h => nomatch h

declarations.name: EthTotal.XferPath.length_refl
declarations.signature:
theorem length_refl {L L' : Ledger A} (hlive : L'.live = L.live)

    (XferPath.refl hlive hbal).length = 0

declarations.name: EthTotal.XferReach.of_fiber
declarations.signature:
theorem XferReach.of_fiber [DecidableEq A] (L L' : Ledger A)
    (hlive : L'.live = L.live) (hsupply : L'.supply = L.supply) :
    XferReach L L'

declarations.name: EthTotal.xferReach_iff_fiber
declarations.signature:
theorem xferReach_iff_fiber [DecidableEq A] (L L' : Ledger A) :

declarations.name: EthTotal.supply_fiber_induction
declarations.signature:
theorem supply_fiber_induction [DecidableEq A] (P : Ledger A → Prop)
    (hresp : ∀ M M' : Ledger A, M.live = M'.live →
      (∀ a : A, M.bal a = M'.bal a) → P M → P M')
    (hstep : ∀ (M : Ledger A) (s d : A) (v : ℕ) (hs : s ∈ M.live) (hd : d ∈ M.live),
      s ≠ d → v ≤ M.bal s → P M →
      P ((M.setBal s (M.bal s - v) hs).setBal d
          ((M.setBal s (M.bal s - v) hs).bal d + v) hd))
    (L L' : Ledger A) (hlive : L'.live = L.live) (hsupply : L'.supply = L.supply)
    (hP : P L) : P L'

declarations.name: EthTotal.supply_fiber_iff
declarations.signature:
theorem supply_fiber_iff [DecidableEq A] (P : Ledger A → Prop)
    (hresp : ∀ M M' : Ledger A, M.live = M'.live →
      (∀ a : A, M.bal a = M'.bal a) → P M → P M')
    (hstep : ∀ (M : Ledger A) (s d : A) (v : ℕ) (hs : s ∈ M.live) (hd : d ∈ M.live),
      s ≠ d → v ≤ M.bal s → P M →
      P ((M.setBal s (M.bal s - v) hs).setBal d
          ((M.setBal s (M.bal s - v) hs).bal d + v) hd))
    (L L' : Ledger A) (hlive : L'.live = L.live) (hsupply : L'.supply = L.supply) :

declarations.name: EthTotal.NeutralReach
declarations.signature:
inductive NeutralReach (L : Ledger A) : Ledger A → Prop where
  | refl {K : Ledger A} (hlive : K.live = L.live)
      (hbal : ∀ a : A, K.bal a = L.bal a) : NeutralReach L K
  | step {M K : Ledger A} (s d : A) (v : ℕ)
      (hs : s ∈ M.live) (hd : d ∈ M.live)
      (h : NeutralReach L M) (hlive : K.live = M.live)
      (hsrc : K.bal s + v = M.bal s)
      (hdst : K.bal d = M.bal d + v)
      (hdec : ∀ a : A, a ≠ s → M.bal a ≤ K.bal a)
      (hinc : ∀ a : A, a ≠ d → K.bal a ≤ M.bal a) :
      NeutralReach L K
  | grow {M K : Ledger A} (a : A) (l₁ l₂ : List A)
      (h : NeutralReach L M) (hsplit : M.live = l₁ ++ l₂)
      (hlive : K.live = l₁ ++ a :: l₂)
      (hbal : ∀ b : A, K.bal b = M.bal b) :
      NeutralReach L K
  | shrink {M K : Ledger A} (a : A) (l₁ l₂ : List A)
      (h : NeutralReach L M) (hsplit : M.live = l₁ ++ a :: l₂)
      (hlive : K.live = l₁ ++ l₂) (hzero : M.bal a = 0)
      (hbal : ∀ b : A, K.bal b = M.bal b) :
      NeutralReach L K

declarations.name: EthTotal.NeutralPath
declarations.signature:
inductive NeutralPath (L : Ledger A) : Ledger A → Type u where
  | refl {K : Ledger A} (hlive : K.live = L.live)
      (hbal : ∀ a : A, K.bal a = L.bal a) : NeutralPath L K
  | step {M K : Ledger A} (s d : A) (v : ℕ)
      (hs : s ∈ M.live) (hd : d ∈ M.live)
      (p : NeutralPath L M) (hlive : K.live = M.live)
      (hsrc : K.bal s + v = M.bal s)
      (hdst : K.bal d = M.bal d + v)
      (hdec : ∀ a : A, a ≠ s → M.bal a ≤ K.bal a)
      (hinc : ∀ a : A, a ≠ d → K.bal a ≤ M.bal a) :
      NeutralPath L K
  | grow {M K : Ledger A} (a : A) (l₁ l₂ : List A)
      (p : NeutralPath L M) (hsplit : M.live = l₁ ++ l₂)
      (hlive : K.live = l₁ ++ a :: l₂)
      (hbal : ∀ b : A, K.bal b = M.bal b) :
      NeutralPath L K
  | shrink {M K : Ledger A} (a : A) (l₁ l₂ : List A)
      (p : NeutralPath L M) (hsplit : M.live = l₁ ++ a :: l₂)
      (hlive : K.live = l₁ ++ l₂) (hzero : M.bal a = 0)
      (hbal : ∀ b : A, K.bal b = M.bal b) :
      NeutralPath L K

declarations.name: EthTotal.NeutralPath.toReach
declarations.signature:
theorem toReach {L : Ledger A} :
    ∀ {K : Ledger A}, NeutralPath L K → NeutralReach L K
  | _, refl hlive hbal => NeutralReach.refl hlive hbal
  | _, step s d v hs hd p hlive hsrc hdst hdec hinc =>
      NeutralReach.step s d v hs hd (toReach p) hlive hsrc hdst hdec hinc
  | _, grow a l₁ l₂ p hsplit hlive hbal =>
      NeutralReach.grow a l₁ l₂ (toReach p) hsplit hlive hbal
  | _, shrink a l₁ l₂ p hsplit hlive hzero hbal =>
      NeutralReach.shrink a l₁ l₂ (toReach p) hsplit hlive hzero hbal

declarations.name: EthTotal.NeutralPath.length
declarations.signature:
def length {L : Ledger A} : ∀ {K : Ledger A}, NeutralPath L K → ℕ
  | _, refl _ _ => 0
  | _, step _ _ _ _ _ p _ _ _ _ _ => length p + 1
  | _, grow _ _ _ p _ _ _ => length p + 1
  | _, shrink _ _ _ p _ _ _ _ => length p + 1

declarations.name: EthTotal.NeutralPath.xferCount
declarations.signature:
def xferCount {L : Ledger A} : ∀ {K : Ledger A}, NeutralPath L K → ℕ
  | _, refl _ _ => 0
  | _, step _ _ _ _ _ p _ _ _ _ _ => xferCount p + 1
  | _, grow _ _ _ p _ _ _ => xferCount p
  | _, shrink _ _ _ p _ _ _ _ => xferCount p

declarations.name: EthTotal.NeutralPath.growCount
declarations.signature:
def growCount {L : Ledger A} : ∀ {K : Ledger A}, NeutralPath L K → ℕ
  | _, refl _ _ => 0
  | _, step _ _ _ _ _ p _ _ _ _ _ => growCount p
  | _, grow _ _ _ p _ _ _ => growCount p + 1
  | _, shrink _ _ _ p _ _ _ _ => growCount p

declarations.name: EthTotal.NeutralPath.shrinkCount
declarations.signature:
def shrinkCount {L : Ledger A} : ∀ {K : Ledger A}, NeutralPath L K → ℕ
  | _, refl _ _ => 0
  | _, step _ _ _ _ _ p _ _ _ _ _ => shrinkCount p
  | _, grow _ _ _ p _ _ _ => shrinkCount p
  | _, shrink _ _ _ p _ _ _ _ => shrinkCount p + 1

declarations.name: EthTotal.NeutralPath.length_eq_sum
declarations.signature:
theorem length_eq_sum {L : Ledger A} :
    ∀ {K : Ledger A} (p : NeutralPath L K),
      p.length = p.xferCount + (p.growCount + p.shrinkCount)
  | _, refl _ _ => rfl
  | _, step _s _d _v _hs _hd p _ _ _ _ _ =>
      Eq.trans (congrArg (fun n => n + 1) (length_eq_sum p))
        (Nat.succ_add p.xferCount (p.growCount + p.shrinkCount)).symm
  | _, grow _a _l₁ _l₂ p _ _ _ =>
      Eq.trans (congrArg (fun n => n + 1) (length_eq_sum p))
        (congrArg (fun n => p.xferCount + n)
          (Nat.succ_add p.growCount p.shrinkCount).symm)
  | _, shrink _a _l₁ _l₂ p _ _ _ _ =>
      congrArg (fun n => n + 1) (length_eq_sum p)

declarations.name: EthTotal.NeutralPath.transport
declarations.signature:
def transport {L : Ledger A} :
    ∀ {M M' : Ledger A}, M.live = M'.live → (∀ a : A, M.bal a = M'.bal a) →
      NeutralPath L M → NeutralPath L M'
  | _, _, hl, hb, refl hlive hbal =>
      refl (Eq.trans hl.symm hlive) (fun a => Eq.trans (hb a).symm (hbal a))
  | _, _, hl, hb, step (M := N) s d v hs hd p hlive hsrc hdst hdec hinc =>
      step s d v hs hd p (Eq.trans hl.symm hlive)
        (Eq.trans (congrArg (fun n => n + v) (hb s).symm) hsrc)
        (Eq.trans (hb d).symm hdst)
        (fun a hne =>
          Eq.subst (motive := fun n => N.bal a ≤ n) (hb a) (hdec a hne))
        (fun a hne =>
          Eq.subst (motive := fun n => n ≤ N.bal a) (hb a) (hinc a hne))
  | _, _, hl, hb, grow a l₁ l₂ p hsplit hlive hbal =>
      grow a l₁ l₂ p hsplit (Eq.trans hl.symm hlive)
        (fun b => Eq.trans (hb b).symm (hbal b))
  | _, _, hl, hb, shrink a l₁ l₂ p hsplit hlive hzero hbal =>
      shrink a l₁ l₂ p hsplit (Eq.trans hl.symm hlive) hzero
        (fun b => Eq.trans (hb b).symm (hbal b))

declarations.name: EthTotal.NeutralPath.counts_transport
declarations.signature:
theorem counts_transport {L : Ledger A} :
    ∀ {M M' : Ledger A} (hl : M.live = M'.live)
      (hb : ∀ a : A, M.bal a = M'.bal a) (p : NeutralPath L M),
      (transport hl hb p).length = p.length
      ∧ (transport hl hb p).xferCount = p.xferCount
      ∧ (transport hl hb p).growCount = p.growCount
      ∧ (transport hl hb p).shrinkCount = p.shrinkCount
  | _, _, _, _, refl _ _ => ⟨rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl⟩
  | _, _, _, _, step _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ => ⟨rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl⟩
  | _, _, _, _, grow _ _ _ _ _ _ _ => ⟨rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl⟩
  | _, _, _, _, shrink _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ => ⟨rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl⟩

declarations.name: EthTotal.NeutralPath.trans
declarations.signature:
def trans {L M : Ledger A} (p₁ : NeutralPath L M) :
    ∀ {K : Ledger A}, NeutralPath M K → NeutralPath L K
  | _, refl hlive hbal =>
      transport hlive.symm (fun a => (hbal a).symm) p₁
  | _, step s d v hs hd p₂ hlive hsrc hdst hdec hinc =>
      step s d v hs hd (trans p₁ p₂) hlive hsrc hdst hdec hinc
  | _, grow a l₁ l₂ p₂ hsplit hlive hbal =>
      grow a l₁ l₂ (trans p₁ p₂) hsplit hlive hbal
  | _, shrink a l₁ l₂ p₂ hsplit hlive hzero hbal =>
      shrink a l₁ l₂ (trans p₁ p₂) hsplit hlive hzero hbal

declarations.name: EthTotal.NeutralPath.ofXfer
declarations.signature:
def ofXfer {L : Ledger A} :
    ∀ {K : Ledger A}, XferPath L K → NeutralPath L K
  | _, XferPath.refl hlive hbal => refl hlive hbal
  | _, XferPath.step s d v hs hd p hlive hsrc hdst hdec hinc =>
      step s d v hs hd (ofXfer p) hlive hsrc hdst hdec hinc

declarations.name: EthTotal.NeutralPath.counts_ofXfer
declarations.signature:
theorem counts_ofXfer {L : Ledger A} :
    ∀ {K : Ledger A} (p : XferPath L K),
      (ofXfer p).growCount = 0 ∧ (ofXfer p).shrinkCount = 0
      ∧ (ofXfer p).xferCount = p.length
      ∧ (ofXfer p).length = p.length
  | _, XferPath.refl _ _ => ⟨rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl⟩
  | _, XferPath.step _ _ _ _ _ p _ _ _ _ _ =>
      match counts_ofXfer p with
      | ⟨hg, hs, hx, hl⟩ =>
          ⟨hg, hs, congrArg (fun n => n + 1) hx,
           congrArg (fun n => n + 1) hl⟩

declarations.name: EthTotal.NeutralPath.length_live_balanced
declarations.signature:
theorem length_live_balanced {L : Ledger A} :
    ∀ {K : Ledger A} (p : NeutralPath L K),
      K.live.length + p.shrinkCount = L.live.length + p.growCount
  | _, refl hlive _ =>
      congrArg (fun l => List.length l + 0) hlive
  | _, step _s _d _v _hs _hd p hlive _ _ _ _ =>
      Eq.trans
        (congrArg (fun l => List.length l + p.shrinkCount) hlive)
        (length_live_balanced p)
  | _, grow (M := M) a l₁ l₂ p hsplit hlive _ =>
      let hM : M.live.length = l₁.length + l₂.length

declarations.name: EthTotal.NeutralPath.dist_length_le_length
declarations.signature:
theorem dist_length_le_length {L K : Ledger A} (p : NeutralPath L K) :
    (K.live.length - L.live.length) + (L.live.length - K.live.length)
      ≤ p.length

declarations.name: EthTotal.NeutralPath.counts_trans
declarations.signature:
theorem counts_trans {L M : Ledger A} (p₁ : NeutralPath L M) :
    ∀ {K : Ledger A} (p₂ : NeutralPath M K),
      (p₁.trans p₂).length = p₁.length + p₂.length
      ∧ (p₁.trans p₂).xferCount = p₁.xferCount + p₂.xferCount
      ∧ (p₁.trans p₂).growCount = p₁.growCount + p₂.growCount
      ∧ (p₁.trans p₂).shrinkCount = p₁.shrinkCount + p₂.shrinkCount
  | _, refl hlive hbal =>
      match counts_transport hlive.symm (fun a => (hbal a).symm) p₁ with
      | ⟨hl, hx, hg, hs⟩ =>
          ⟨Eq.trans hl (Nat.add_zero p₁.length).symm,
           Eq.trans hx (Nat.add_zero p₁.xferCount).symm,
           Eq.trans hg (Nat.add_zero p₁.growCount).symm,
           Eq.trans hs (Nat.add_zero p₁.shrinkCount).symm⟩
  | _, step _s _d _v _hs _hd p₂ _ _ _ _ _ =>
      match counts_trans p₁ p₂ with
      | ⟨hl, hx, hg, hs⟩ =>
          ⟨Eq.trans (congrArg (fun n => n + 1) hl)
             (Nat.add_assoc p₁.length p₂.length 1),
           Eq.trans (congrArg (fun n => n + 1) hx)
             (Nat.add_assoc p₁.xferCount p₂.xferCount 1),
           hg, hs⟩
  | _, grow _a _l₁ _l₂ p₂ _ _ _ =>
      match counts_trans p₁ p₂ with
      | ⟨hl, hx, hg, hs⟩ =>
          ⟨Eq.trans (congrArg (fun n => n + 1) hl)
             (Nat.add_assoc p₁.length p₂.length 1),
           hx,
           Eq.trans (congrArg (fun n => n + 1) hg)
             (Nat.add_assoc p₁.growCount p₂.growCount 1),
           hs⟩
  | _, shrink _a _l₁ _l₂ p₂ _ _ _ _ =>
      match counts_trans p₁ p₂ with
      | ⟨hl, hx, hg, hs⟩ =>
          ⟨Eq.trans (congrArg (fun n => n + 1) hl)
             (Nat.add_assoc p₁.length p₂.length 1),
           hx, hg,
           Eq.trans (congrArg (fun n => n + 1) hs)
             (Nat.add_assoc p₁.shrinkCount p₂.shrinkCount 1)⟩

declarations.name: EthTotal.NeutralPath.counts_net_unique
declarations.signature:
theorem counts_net_unique {L K : Ledger A} (p q : NeutralPath L K) :
    p.shrinkCount + q.growCount = q.shrinkCount + p.growCount

declarations.name: EthTotal.NeutralPath.counts_excess_eq
declarations.signature:
theorem counts_excess_eq {L K : Ledger A} (p : NeutralPath L K) :
    p.shrinkCount - (L.live.length - K.live.length)
      = p.growCount - (K.live.length - L.live.length)

declarations.name: EthTotal.NeutralPath.toBal
declarations.signature:
def toBal {L K : Ledger A} (p : NeutralPath L K) :
    Bal L.live.length K.live.length

declarations.name: EthTotal.NeutralPath.toBal_trans
declarations.signature:
theorem toBal_trans {L M K : Ledger A} (p₁ : NeutralPath L M)
    (p₂ : NeutralPath M K) :
    (p₁.trans p₂).toBal = p₁.toBal.comp p₂.toBal

declarations.name: EthTotal.NeutralPath.meet_counts_eq_excess
declarations.signature:
theorem meet_counts_eq_excess {L K : Ledger A} (p : NeutralPath L K) :
    min p.shrinkCount p.growCount
      = p.shrinkCount - (L.live.length - K.live.length)

declarations.name: EthTotal.NeutralPath.length_eq_dist_add_excess
declarations.signature:
theorem length_eq_dist_add_excess {L K : Ledger A} (p : NeutralPath L K) :
    p.length
      = p.xferCount
        + ((max L.live.length K.live.length
              - min L.live.length K.live.length)
           + (min p.shrinkCount p.growCount
              + min p.shrinkCount p.growCount))

declarations.name: EthTotal.NeutralPath.excess_pos_iff_counts_pos
declarations.signature:
theorem excess_pos_iff_counts_pos {L K : Ledger A} (p : NeutralPath L K) :
    0 < p.shrinkCount - (L.live.length - K.live.length)
      ↔ (0 < p.shrinkCount ∧ 0 < p.growCount)

declarations.name: EthTotal.NeutralPath.excess_eq_shrinkCount_of_live_le
EthTotal.NeutralPath.excess_eq_growCount_of_le_live
EthTotal.NeutralPath.shrinkCount_le_growCount_iff
declarations.signature:
theorem shrinkCount_le_growCount_iff {L K : Ledger A} (p : NeutralPath L K) :
    p.shrinkCount ≤ p.growCount ↔ L.live.length ≤ K.live.length

declarations.name: EthTotal.NeutralPath.shrinkCount_eq_growCount_iff
declarations.signature:
theorem shrinkCount_eq_growCount_iff {L K : Ledger A} (p : NeutralPath L K) :
    p.shrinkCount = p.growCount ↔ K.live.length = L.live.length

declarations.name: EthTotal.NeutralPath.growCount_eq_of_shrinkCount_eq
EthTotal.NeutralPath.counts_eq_of_total_eq
declarations.signature:
theorem counts_eq_of_total_eq {L K : Ledger A} (p q : NeutralPath L K)
    (h : p.shrinkCount + p.growCount = q.shrinkCount + q.growCount) :
    p.shrinkCount = q.shrinkCount ∧ p.growCount = q.growCount

declarations.name: EthTotal.NeutralPath.join_counts_sub_meet
declarations.signature:
theorem join_counts_sub_meet {L K : Ledger A} (p : NeutralPath L K) :
    max p.shrinkCount p.growCount - min p.shrinkCount p.growCount
      = max L.live.length K.live.length
        - min L.live.length K.live.length

declarations.name: EthTotal.NeutralPath.dist_le_total_counts
declarations.signature:
theorem dist_le_total_counts {L K : Ledger A} (p : NeutralPath L K) :
    (L.live.length - K.live.length) + (K.live.length - L.live.length)
      ≤ p.shrinkCount + p.growCount

declarations.name: EthTotal.NeutralPath.toBal_eq_id_iff
declarations.signature:
theorem toBal_eq_id_iff {L : Ledger A} (p : NeutralPath L L) :
    p.toBal = Bal.id L.live.length ↔ p.shrinkCount = 0

declarations.name: EthTotal.NeutralPath.trans_toBal_eq_id_iff
declarations.signature:
theorem trans_toBal_eq_id_iff {L : Ledger A} (p q : NeutralPath L L) :
    (p.trans q).toBal = Bal.id L.live.length
      ↔ (p.toBal = Bal.id L.live.length
          ∧ q.toBal = Bal.id L.live.length)

declarations.name: EthTotal.NeutralPath.loopAt
declarations.signature: def loopAt {L : Ledger A} (a : A) (ha : a ∉ L.live) : NeutralPath L L

declarations.name: EthTotal.NeutralPath.counts_loopAt
declarations.signature:
theorem counts_loopAt {L : Ledger A} (a : A) (ha : a ∉ L.live) :
    (loopAt a ha).xferCount = 0
    ∧ (loopAt a ha).growCount = 1
    ∧ (loopAt a ha).shrinkCount = 1

declarations.name: EthTotal.NeutralPath.loopPow
declarations.signature:
def loopPow {L : Ledger A} (a : A) (ha : a ∉ L.live) :
    ℕ → NeutralPath L L
  | 0 => refl rfl (fun _b => rfl)
  | k + 1 => trans (loopPow a ha k) (loopAt a ha)

declarations.name: EthTotal.NeutralPath.counts_loopPow
declarations.signature:
theorem counts_loopPow {L : Ledger A} (a : A) (ha : a ∉ L.live) :
    ∀ k : ℕ,
      (loopPow a ha k).xferCount = 0
      ∧ (loopPow a ha k).growCount = k
      ∧ (loopPow a ha k).shrinkCount = k
  | 0 => ⟨rfl, rfl, rfl⟩
  | k + 1 =>
      match counts_loopPow a ha k,
        counts_trans (loopPow a ha k) (loopAt a ha) with
      | ⟨hx, hg, hs⟩, ⟨_tl, tx, tg, ts⟩ =>
          ⟨Eq.trans tx (Eq.trans (congrArg (fun n => n + 0) hx) rfl),
           Eq.trans tg (congrArg (fun n => n + 1) hg),
           Eq.trans ts (congrArg (fun n => n + 1) hs)⟩

declarations.name: EthTotal.NeutralPath.toBal_loopPow
declarations.signature:
theorem toBal_loopPow {L : Ledger A} (a : A) (ha : a ∉ L.live) (k : ℕ) :
    (loopPow a ha k).toBal
      = Bal.shift L.live.length L.live.length k

declarations.name: EthTotal.NeutralPath.symm
declarations.signature:
def symm {L : Ledger A} :
    ∀ {K : Ledger A}, NeutralPath L K → NeutralPath K L
  | _, refl hlive hbal => refl hlive.symm (fun a => (hbal a).symm)
  | _, step s d v hs hd p hlive hsrc hdst hdec hinc =>
      trans
        (step d s v
          (Eq.subst (motive := fun l => d ∈ l) hlive.symm hd)
          (Eq.subst (motive := fun l => s ∈ l) hlive.symm hs)
          (refl rfl (fun _ => rfl)) hlive.symm hdst.symm hsrc.symm hinc hdec)
        (symm p)
  | K, grow (M := M) a l₁ l₂ p hsplit hlive hbal =>
      let ha : a ∉ M.live

declarations.name: EthTotal.NeutralPath.counts_symm
declarations.signature:
theorem counts_symm {L : Ledger A} :
    ∀ {K : Ledger A} (p : NeutralPath L K),
      (symm p).xferCount = p.xferCount
      ∧ (symm p).growCount = p.shrinkCount
      ∧ (symm p).shrinkCount = p.growCount
      ∧ (symm p).length = p.length
  | _, refl _ _ => ⟨rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl⟩
  | K, step (M := M) s d v hs hd p hlive hsrc hdst hdec hinc =>
      let r : NeutralPath K M

declarations.name: EthTotal.NeutralPath.toBal_symm
declarations.signature:
theorem toBal_symm {L K : Ledger A} (p : NeutralPath L K) :
    (symm p).toBal = p.toBal.symm

declarations.name: EthTotal.NeutralPath.total_counts_symm
declarations.signature:
theorem total_counts_symm {L K : Ledger A} (p : NeutralPath L K) :
    (symm p).shrinkCount + (symm p).growCount
      = p.shrinkCount + p.growCount

declarations.name: EthTotal.NeutralPath.meet_counts_symm
declarations.signature:
theorem meet_counts_symm {L K : Ledger A} (p : NeutralPath L K) :
    min (symm p).shrinkCount (symm p).growCount
      = min p.shrinkCount p.growCount

declarations.name: EthTotal.NeutralPath.elim_data
declarations.signature:
def elim_data.{v} {L : Ledger A} (F : Ledger A → Sort v)
    (frefl : ∀ K : Ledger A, K.live = L.live →
      (∀ a : A, K.bal a = L.bal a) → F L → F K)
    (fstep : ∀ (M K : Ledger A) (s d : A) (w : ℕ), s ∈ M.live → d ∈ M.live →
      K.live = M.live → K.bal s + w = M.bal s → K.bal d = M.bal d + w →
      (∀ a : A, a ≠ s → M.bal a ≤ K.bal a) →
      (∀ a : A, a ≠ d → K.bal a ≤ M.bal a) → F M → F K)
    (fgrow : ∀ (M K : Ledger A) (a : A) (l₁ l₂ : List A),
      M.live = l₁ ++ l₂ → K.live = l₁ ++ a :: l₂ →
      (∀ b : A, K.bal b = M.bal b) → F M → F K)
    (fshrink : ∀ (M K : Ledger A) (a : A) (l₁ l₂ : List A),
      M.live = l₁ ++ a :: l₂ → K.live = l₁ ++ l₂ → M.bal a = 0 →
      (∀ b : A, K.bal b = M.bal b) → F M → F K) :
    ∀ {K : Ledger A}, NeutralPath L K → F L → F K
  | _, refl hlive hbal, x => frefl _ hlive hbal x
  | _, step s d w hs hd p hlive hsrc hdst hdec hinc, x =>
      fstep _ _ s d w hs hd hlive hsrc hdst hdec hinc
        (elim_data F frefl fstep fgrow fshrink p x)
  | _, grow a l₁ l₂ p hsplit hlive hbal, x =>
      fgrow _ _ a l₁ l₂ hsplit hlive hbal
        (elim_data F frefl fstep fgrow fshrink p x)
  | _, shrink a l₁ l₂ p hsplit hlive hzero hbal, x =>
      fshrink _ _ a l₁ l₂ hsplit hlive hzero hbal
        (elim_data F frefl fstep fgrow fshrink p x)

declarations.name: EthTotal.NeutralPath.moved
declarations.signature:
def moved {L : Ledger A} : ∀ {K : Ledger A}, NeutralPath L K → ℕ
  | _, refl _ _ => 0
  | _, step _ _ w _ _ p _ _ _ _ _ => moved p + w
  | _, grow _ _ _ p _ _ _ => moved p
  | _, shrink _ _ _ p _ _ _ _ => moved p

declarations.name: EthTotal.NeutralPath.moved_transport
declarations.signature:
theorem moved_transport {L : Ledger A} :
    ∀ {M M' : Ledger A} (hl : M.live = M'.live)
      (hb : ∀ a : A, M.bal a = M'.bal a) (p : NeutralPath L M),
      (transport hl hb p).moved = p.moved
  | _, _, _, _, refl _ _ => rfl
  | _, _, _, _, step _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ => rfl
  | _, _, _, _, grow _ _ _ _ _ _ _ => rfl
  | _, _, _, _, shrink _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ => rfl

declarations.name: EthTotal.NeutralPath.moved_trans
declarations.signature:
theorem moved_trans {L M : Ledger A} (p₁ : NeutralPath L M) :
    ∀ {K : Ledger A} (p₂ : NeutralPath M K),
      (p₁.trans p₂).moved = p₁.moved + p₂.moved
  | _, refl hlive hbal =>
      Eq.trans (moved_transport hlive.symm (fun a => (hbal a).symm) p₁)
        (Nat.add_zero p₁.moved).symm
  | _, step _s _d w _hs _hd p₂ _ _ _ _ _ =>
      Eq.trans (congrArg (fun n => n + w) (moved_trans p₁ p₂))
        (Nat.add_assoc p₁.moved p₂.moved w)
  | _, grow _a _l₁ _l₂ p₂ _ _ _ => moved_trans p₁ p₂
  | _, shrink _a _l₁ _l₂ p₂ _ _ _ _ => moved_trans p₁ p₂

declarations.name: EthTotal.NeutralPath.moved_symm
declarations.signature:
theorem moved_symm {L : Ledger A} :
    ∀ {K : Ledger A} (p : NeutralPath L K), (symm p).moved = p.moved
  | _, refl _ _ => rfl
  | K, step (M := M) s d w hs hd p hlive hsrc hdst hdec hinc =>
      let r : NeutralPath K M

declarations.name: EthTotal.NeutralPath.moved_loopPow
declarations.signature:
theorem moved_loopPow {L : Ledger A} (a : A) (ha : a ∉ L.live) :
    ∀ k : ℕ, (loopPow a ha k).moved = 0
  | 0 => rfl
  | k + 1 =>
      Eq.trans (moved_trans (loopPow a ha k) (loopAt a ha))
        (Eq.trans
          (congrArg (fun n => n + (loopAt a ha).moved) (moved_loopPow a ha k))
          (Nat.zero_add (loopAt a ha).moved))

declarations.name: EthTotal.NeutralPath.moved_step_self
declarations.signature:
theorem moved_step_self {L M K : Ledger A} (s : A) (v : ℕ)
    (hs hd : s ∈ M.live) (p : NeutralPath L M) (hlive : K.live = M.live)
    (hsrc : K.bal s + v = M.bal s) (hdst : K.bal s = M.bal s + v)
    (hdec : ∀ a : A, a ≠ s → M.bal a ≤ K.bal a)
    (hinc : ∀ a : A, a ≠ s → K.bal a ≤ M.bal a) :
    (step s s v hs hd p hlive hsrc hdst hdec hinc).moved = p.moved

declarations.name: EthTotal.NeutralPath.bal_sub_le_moved
declarations.signature:
theorem bal_sub_le_moved {L : Ledger A} :
    ∀ {K : Ledger A} (p : NeutralPath L K) (a : A),
      L.bal a - K.bal a ≤ p.moved
  | _, refl _hlive hbal, a =>
      Nat.le_of_eq (sub_eq_zero_of_le (Nat.le_of_eq (hbal a).symm))
  | K, step (M := M) s _d w _hs _hd p _hlive hsrc _hdst hdec _hinc, a =>
      let hkey : M.bal a - K.bal a ≤ w

declarations.name: EthTotal.NeutralPath.bal_sub_le_moved_symm
declarations.signature:
theorem bal_sub_le_moved_symm {L K : Ledger A} (p : NeutralPath L K) (a : A) :
    K.bal a - L.bal a ≤ p.moved

declarations.name: EthTotal.NeutralPath.dist_bal_le_moved
declarations.signature:
theorem dist_bal_le_moved {L K : Ledger A} (p : NeutralPath L K) (a : A) :
    max (L.bal a) (K.bal a) - min (L.bal a) (K.bal a)
      ≤ p.moved + p.moved

declarations.name: EthTotal.NeutralReach.supply_eq
declarations.signature:
theorem supply_eq {L : Ledger A} :
    ∀ {K : Ledger A}, NeutralReach L K → K.supply = L.supply
  | _, refl _ hbal => supply_eq_of_bal_eq L _ hbal
  | _, step _s _d _v hs hd h hlive hsrc hdst hdec hinc =>
      Eq.trans
        (supply_eq_of_double_entry hs hd hlive hsrc hdst hdec hinc)
        (supply_eq h)
  | K, grow (M := M) a l₁ l₂ h hsplit hlive hbal =>
      let ha : a ∉ M.live

declarations.name: EthTotal.NeutralReach.transport
declarations.signature:
theorem transport {L : Ledger A} :
    ∀ {M M' : Ledger A}, M.live = M'.live → (∀ a : A, M.bal a = M'.bal a) →
      NeutralReach L M → NeutralReach L M'
  | _, _, hl, hb, refl hlive hbal =>
      refl (Eq.trans hl.symm hlive) (fun a => Eq.trans (hb a).symm (hbal a))
  | _, _, hl, hb, step (M := N) s d v hs hd h hlive hsrc hdst hdec hinc =>
      step s d v hs hd h (Eq.trans hl.symm hlive)
        (Eq.trans (congrArg (fun n => n + v) (hb s).symm) hsrc)
        (Eq.trans (hb d).symm hdst)
        (fun a hne =>
          Eq.subst (motive := fun n => N.bal a ≤ n) (hb a) (hdec a hne))
        (fun a hne =>
          Eq.subst (motive := fun n => n ≤ N.bal a) (hb a) (hinc a hne))
  | _, _, hl, hb, grow a l₁ l₂ h hsplit hlive hbal =>
      grow a l₁ l₂ h hsplit (Eq.trans hl.symm hlive)
        (fun b => Eq.trans (hb b).symm (hbal b))
  | _, _, hl, hb, shrink a l₁ l₂ h hsplit hlive hzero hbal =>
      shrink a l₁ l₂ h hsplit (Eq.trans hl.symm hlive) hzero
        (fun b => Eq.trans (hb b).symm (hbal b))

declarations.name: EthTotal.NeutralReach.consolidate_acc
declarations.signature:
theorem consolidate_acc [inst : DecidableEq A] {L₀ : Ledger A} :
    ∀ (rest : List A) (M : Ledger A) (x : A), M.live = x :: rest →
      NeutralReach L₀ M →
      NeutralReach L₀
        (Ledger.mk [x] (Distinct.cons notMemNil Distinct.nil)
          (fun b => if b = x then M.supply else 0)
          (single_support_bal_live (List.Mem.head []) M.supply))
  | [], M, x, hlv, acc =>
      transport hlv
        (fun b =>
          match inst b x with
          | isTrue hbx =>
              Eq.trans (congrArg M.bal hbx)
                (Eq.trans (congrArg (sumOver M.bal) hlv).symm
                  (if_pos hbx).symm)
          | isFalse hbx =>
              Eq.trans
                (Ledger.bal_eq_zero_of_not_live (L := M)
                  (fun hm =>
                    hbx (eqOfMemSingleton
                      (Eq.subst (motive := fun l => b ∈ l) hlv hm))))
                (if_neg hbx).symm)
        acc
  | y :: rest', M, x, hlv, acc =>
      match Eq.subst (motive := fun l => Distinct l) hlv M.live_distinct with
      | Distinct.cons hxn _ =>
          let hxy : x ≠ y

declarations.name: EthTotal.NeutralReach.consolidate
declarations.signature:
theorem consolidate [DecidableEq A] (L : Ledger A) (x : A) (rest : List A)
    (hlv : L.live = x :: rest) :
    NeutralReach L
      (Ledger.mk [x] (Distinct.cons notMemNil Distinct.nil)
        (fun b => if b = x then L.supply else 0)
        (single_support_bal_live (List.Mem.head []) L.supply))

declarations.name: EthTotal.NeutralReach.rebuild_acc
declarations.signature:
theorem rebuild_acc [inst : DecidableEq A] {L₀ : Ledger A} (L' : Ledger A)
    (z : A) :
    ∀ (q : List A) (s : List A) (M : Ledger A),
      L'.live = List.reverseAux q s →
      z ∈ s →
      M.live = s →
      M.bal z = L'.bal z + sumOver L'.bal q →
      (∀ b : A, b ∈ s → b ≠ z → M.bal b = L'.bal b) →
      (∀ b : A, b ∉ s → M.bal b = 0) →
      NeutralReach L₀ M →
      NeutralReach L₀ L'
  | [], _s, M, hdec, _hzs, hlive, hz, hs, _hoff, acc =>
      transport (Eq.trans hlive hdec.symm)
        (fun b =>
          match inst b z with
          | isTrue hbz =>
              Eq.trans (congrArg M.bal hbz)
                (Eq.trans hz (congrArg L'.bal hbz.symm))
          | isFalse hbz =>
              match hMb : M.bal b with
              | _ + 1 =>
                  Eq.trans hMb.symm
                    (hs b
                      (Eq.subst (motive := fun l => b ∈ l) hlive
                        (M.bal_live b
                          (fun h0 =>
                            Nat.noConfusion (Eq.trans hMb.symm h0))))
                      hbz)
              | 0 =>
                  match hLb : L'.bal b with
                  | 0 => rfl
                  | _ + 1 =>
                      Eq.trans hMb.symm
                        (Eq.trans
                          (hs b
                            (Eq.subst (motive := fun l => b ∈ l) hdec
                              (L'.bal_live b
                                (fun h0 =>
                                  Nat.noConfusion (Eq.trans hLb.symm h0))))
                            hbz)
                          hLb))
        acc
  | b :: q', s, M, hdec, hzs, hlive, hz, hs, hoff, acc =>
      match Distinct.of_reverseAux q'
          (Eq.subst (motive := fun l => Distinct l) hdec
            L'.live_distinct) with
      | Distinct.cons hbs _ =>
          let hbz : b ≠ z

declarations.name: EthTotal.NeutralReach.toWarehouse
declarations.signature:
theorem toWarehouse [inst : DecidableEq A] (L : Ledger A) (z : A) :
    NeutralReach L
      (Ledger.mk [z] (Distinct.cons notMemNil Distinct.nil)
        (fun b => if b = z then L.supply else 0)
        (single_support_bal_live (List.Mem.head []) L.supply))

declarations.name: EthTotal.NeutralReach.of_supply_eq
declarations.signature:
theorem of_supply_eq [inst : DecidableEq A] (L L' : Ledger A)
    (hsupply : L'.supply = L.supply) : NeutralReach L L'

declarations.name: EthTotal.NeutralReach.trans
declarations.signature:
theorem trans {L M : Ledger A} (h₁ : NeutralReach L M) :
    ∀ {K : Ledger A}, NeutralReach M K → NeutralReach L K
  | _, refl hlive hbal =>
      transport hlive.symm (fun a => (hbal a).symm) h₁
  | _, step s d v hs hd h₂ hlive hsrc hdst hdec hinc =>
      step s d v hs hd (trans h₁ h₂) hlive hsrc hdst hdec hinc
  | _, grow a l₁ l₂ h₂ hsplit hlive hbal =>
      grow a l₁ l₂ (trans h₁ h₂) hsplit hlive hbal
  | _, shrink a l₁ l₂ h₂ hsplit hlive hzero hbal =>
      shrink a l₁ l₂ (trans h₁ h₂) hsplit hlive hzero hbal

declarations.name: EthTotal.NeutralReach.symm
declarations.signature:
theorem symm {L : Ledger A} :
    ∀ {K : Ledger A}, NeutralReach L K → NeutralReach K L
  | _, refl hlive hbal => refl hlive.symm (fun a => (hbal a).symm)
  | _, step s d v hs hd h hlive hsrc hdst hdec hinc =>
      trans
        (step d s v
          (Eq.subst (motive := fun l => d ∈ l) hlive.symm hd)
          (Eq.subst (motive := fun l => s ∈ l) hlive.symm hs)
          (refl rfl (fun _ => rfl)) hlive.symm hdst.symm hsrc.symm hinc hdec)
        (symm h)
  | K, grow (M := M) a l₁ l₂ h hsplit hlive hbal =>
      let ha : a ∉ M.live

declarations.name: EthTotal.NeutralReach.elim_pred
declarations.signature:
theorem elim_pred [inst : DecidableEq A] {L : Ledger A} (P : Ledger A → Prop)
    (hresp : ∀ M M' : Ledger A, M.live = M'.live →
      (∀ a : A, M.bal a = M'.bal a) → P M → P M')
    (hstep : ∀ (M : Ledger A) (s d : A) (v : ℕ) (hs : s ∈ M.live)
      (hd : d ∈ M.live), s ≠ d → v ≤ M.bal s → P M →
      P ((M.setBal s (M.bal s - v) hs).setBal d
          ((M.setBal s (M.bal s - v) hs).bal d + v) hd))
    (hgrow : ∀ (M : Ledger A) (a : A) (l₁ l₂ : List A)
      (hsplit : M.live = l₁ ++ l₂) (ha : a ∉ M.live),
      P M → P (M.insertLive a l₁ l₂ hsplit ha))
    (hshrink : ∀ (M : Ledger A) (a : A) (hz : M.bal a = 0),
      P M → P (M.eraseLive a hz)) :
    ∀ {K : Ledger A}, NeutralReach L K → P L → P K
  | _, .refl hlive hbal, hP =>
      hresp L _ hlive.symm (fun a => (hbal a).symm) hP
  | K, .step (M := N) s d v hs hd h hlive hsrc hdst hdec hinc, hP =>
      let hPN : P N

declarations.name: EthTotal.NeutralReach.shrink_hyp_point_of_remove
declarations.signature:
theorem shrink_hyp_point_of_remove {P : Ledger A → Prop}
    (hr : ∀ (M : Ledger A) (a : A) (l₁ l₂ : List A)
      (hsplit : M.live = l₁ ++ a :: l₂) (hz : M.bal a = 0),
      P M → P (M.removeLive a l₁ l₂ hsplit hz)) :
    ∀ (M : Ledger A) (a : A) (dec : ∀ b : A, Decidable (b = a))
      (hz : M.bal a = 0), P M → P (M.eraseLiveOfPoint a dec hz)

declarations.name: EthTotal.NeutralReach.shrink_hyp_erase_of_point

declarations.signature:
theorem elim_predOfSplit [inst : DecidableEq A] {L : Ledger A}
    (P : Ledger A → Prop)
    (hresp : ∀ M M' : Ledger A, M.live = M'.live →
      (∀ a : A, M.bal a = M'.bal a) → P M → P M')
    (hstep : ∀ (M : Ledger A) (s d : A) (v : ℕ) (hs : s ∈ M.live)
      (hd : d ∈ M.live), s ≠ d → v ≤ M.bal s → P M →
      P ((M.setBal s (M.bal s - v) hs).setBal d
          ((M.setBal s (M.bal s - v) hs).bal d + v) hd))
    (hgrow : ∀ (M : Ledger A) (a : A) (l₁ l₂ : List A)
      (hsplit : M.live = l₁ ++ l₂) (ha : a ∉ M.live),
      P M → P (M.insertLive a l₁ l₂ hsplit ha))
    (hshrink : ∀ (M : Ledger A) (a : A) (l₁ l₂ : List A)
      (hsplit : M.live = l₁ ++ a :: l₂) (hz : M.bal a = 0),
      P M → P (M.removeLive a l₁ l₂ hsplit hz)) :
    ∀ {K : Ledger A}, NeutralReach L K → P L → P K
  | _, .refl hlive hbal, hP =>
      hresp L _ hlive.symm (fun a => (hbal a).symm) hP
  | K, .step (M := N) s d v hs hd h hlive hsrc hdst hdec hinc, hP =>
      let hPN : P N

declarations.name: EthTotal.NeutralPath.consolidate_accOfPoint
declarations.signature:
def consolidate_accOfPoint {L₀ : Ledger A} (x : A)
    (decX : ∀ b : A, Decidable (b = x)) :
    ∀ (rest : List A) (M : Ledger A)
      (decs : ∀ c : A, c ∈ rest → ∀ b : A, Decidable (b = c)),
      M.live = x :: rest → NeutralPath L₀ M →
      NeutralPath L₀
        (Ledger.mk [x] (Distinct.cons notMemNil Distinct.nil)
          (fun b => @ite ℕ (b = x) (decX b) M.supply 0)
          (single_support_bal_liveOfPoint decX (List.Mem.head []) M.supply))
  | [], M, _decs, hlv, acc =>
      transport hlv
        (fun b =>
          match decX b with
          | isTrue hbx =>
              Eq.trans (congrArg M.bal hbx)
                (Eq.trans (congrArg (sumOver M.bal) hlv).symm
                  (if_pos hbx).symm)
          | isFalse hbx =>
              Eq.trans
                (Ledger.bal_eq_zero_of_not_live (L := M)
                  (fun hm =>
                    hbx (eqOfMemSingleton
                      (Eq.subst (motive := fun l => b ∈ l) hlv hm))))
                (if_neg hbx).symm)
        acc
  | y :: rest', M, decs, hlv, acc =>
      let decY : ∀ b : A, Decidable (b = y)

declarations.name: EthTotal.NeutralPath.rebuild_accOfPoint
declarations.signature:
def rebuild_accOfPoint {L₀ : Ledger A} (L' : Ledger A) (z : A)
    (decZ : ∀ b : A, Decidable (b = z)) :
    ∀ (q : List A) (s : List A) (M : Ledger A)
      (decs : ∀ c : A, c ∈ q → ∀ b : A, Decidable (b = c)),
      L'.live = List.reverseAux q s →
      z ∈ s →
      M.live = s →
      M.bal z = L'.bal z + sumOver L'.bal q →
      (∀ b : A, b ∈ s → b ≠ z → M.bal b = L'.bal b) →
      (∀ b : A, b ∉ s → M.bal b = 0) →
      NeutralPath L₀ M →
      NeutralPath L₀ L'
  | [], _s, M, _decs, hdec, _hzs, hlive, hz, hs, _hoff, acc =>
      transport (Eq.trans hlive hdec.symm)
        (fun b =>
          match decZ b with
          | isTrue hbz =>
              Eq.trans (congrArg M.bal hbz)
                (Eq.trans hz (congrArg L'.bal hbz.symm))
          | isFalse hbz =>
              match hMb : M.bal b with
              | _ + 1 =>
                  Eq.trans hMb.symm
                    (hs b
                      (Eq.subst (motive := fun l => b ∈ l) hlive
                        (M.bal_live b
                          (fun h0 =>
                            Nat.noConfusion (Eq.trans hMb.symm h0))))
                      hbz)
              | 0 =>
                  match hLb : L'.bal b with
                  | 0 => rfl
                  | _ + 1 =>
                      Eq.trans hMb.symm
                        (Eq.trans
                          (hs b
                            (Eq.subst (motive := fun l => b ∈ l) hdec
                              (L'.bal_live b
                                (fun h0 =>
                                  Nat.noConfusion (Eq.trans hLb.symm h0))))
                            hbz)
                          hLb))
        acc
  | b :: q', s, M, decs, hdec, hzs, hlive, hz, hs, hoff, acc =>
      let decB : ∀ c : A, Decidable (c = b)

declarations.name: EthTotal.NeutralPath.growCount_consolidate_acc
declarations.signature:
theorem growCount_consolidate_acc [DecidableEq A] {L₀ : Ledger A} :
    ∀ (rest : List A) (M : Ledger A) (x : A) (hlv : M.live = x :: rest)
      (acc : NeutralPath L₀ M),
      (consolidate_acc rest M x hlv acc).growCount = acc.growCount
  | [], _M, _x, _hlv, _acc => (counts_transport _ _ _).2.2.1

declarations.name: EthTotal.NeutralPath.shrinkCount_rebuild_acc
declarations.signature:
theorem shrinkCount_rebuild_acc [DecidableEq A] {L₀ : Ledger A}
    (L' : Ledger A) (z : A) :
    ∀ (q s : List A) (M : Ledger A)
      (hdec : L'.live = List.reverseAux q s) (hzs : z ∈ s)
      (hlive : M.live = s) (hz : M.bal z = L'.bal z + sumOver L'.bal q)
      (hs : ∀ b : A, b ∈ s → b ≠ z → M.bal b = L'.bal b)
      (hoff : ∀ b : A, b ∉ s → M.bal b = 0) (acc : NeutralPath L₀ M),
      (rebuild_acc L' z q s M hdec hzs hlive hz hs hoff acc).shrinkCount
        = acc.shrinkCount
  | [], _s, _M, _hdec, _hzs, _hlive, _hz, _hs, _hoff, _acc =>
      (counts_transport _ _ _).2.2.2
  | _b :: q', _s, _M, _hdec, _hzs, _hlive, _hz, _hs, _hoff, _acc =>
      shrinkCount_rebuild_acc L' z q' _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _

declarations.name: EthTotal.process_transaction_effect
declarations.signature:
theorem process_transaction_effect [DecidableEq A]
    (L₀ : Ledger A) (sender escrow coinbase : A)
    (hse : escrow ≠ sender) (hec : escrow ≠ coinbase)
    (hs₀ : sender ∈ L₀.live) (he₀ : escrow ∈ L₀.live)
    (P R T B : ℕ) (hsplit : R + (T + B) = P) (hP : P ≤ L₀.bal sender)
    (L₂ : Ledger A) (τe : Trace A)
    (hs₂ : sender ∈ L₂.live) (he₂ : escrow ∈ L₂.live) (hc₂ : coinbase ∈ L₂.live)
    (hesc : L₂.bal escrow = L₀.bal escrow + P)
    (hacce : L₂.supply + burned τe
      = ((L₀.setBal sender (L₀.bal sender - P) hs₀).setBal escrow
          ((L₀.setBal sender (L₀.bal sender - P) hs₀).bal escrow + P) he₀).supply
        + minted τe)
    (hconfe : SiteConfined ([] : List A) [escrow] τe) :
    ∃ (L' : Ledger A) (τ : Trace A),
      τ = τe ++ [Ev.burn escrow B]
      ∧ L'.supply + burned τ = L₀.supply + minted τ
      ∧ burned τ = burned τe + B
      ∧ minted τ = minted τe
      ∧ SiteConfined ([] : List A) [escrow] τ
      ∧ L'.supply ≤ L₀.supply
      ∧ L'.bal escrow = L₀.bal escrow
      ∧ L'.live = L₂.live

declarations.signature:
theorem process_transaction_destroy_effect [DecidableEq A]
    (L₀ : Ledger A) (sender escrow coinbase : A)
    (hse : escrow ≠ sender) (hec : escrow ≠ coinbase)
    (hs₀ : sender ∈ L₀.live) (he₀ : escrow ∈ L₀.live)
    (P R T B : ℕ) (hsplit : R + (T + B) = P) (hP : P ≤ L₀.bal sender)
    (L₂ : Ledger A) (τe : Trace A)
    (hs₂ : sender ∈ L₂.live) (he₂ : escrow ∈ L₂.live) (hc₂ : coinbase ∈ L₂.live)
    (hesc : L₂.bal escrow = L₀.bal escrow + P)
    (hacce : L₂.supply + burned τe
      = ((L₀.setBal sender (L₀.bal sender - P) hs₀).setBal escrow
          ((L₀.setBal sender (L₀.bal sender - P) hs₀).bal escrow + P) he₀).supply
        + minted τe)
    (hconfe : SiteConfined ([] : List A) [escrow] τe)
    (a : A) (ha₂ : a ∈ L₂.live) :
    ∃ (L'' : Ledger A) (τ' : Trace A) (D : ℕ),
      τ' = (τe ++ [Ev.burn escrow B]) ++ [Ev.burn a D]
      ∧ L''.supply + burned τ' = L₀.supply + minted τ'
      ∧ burned τ' = (burned τe + B) + D
      ∧ minted τ' = minted τe
      ∧ SiteConfined ([] : List A) [escrow, a] τ'
      ∧ L''.supply ≤ L₀.supply
      ∧ a ∉ L''.live

    (R T B : ℕ) (L₂E L₂e : Ledger A)

    (hs₂e : sender ∈ L₂e.live) (he₂e : escrow ∈ L₂e.live)
    (hc₂e : coinbase ∈ L₂e.live)
    (hexec : ∀ b : A, b ≠ escrow → L₂E.bal b = L₂e.bal b) :
    ∀ a : A, a ≠ escrow →
      (((L₂E.setBal sender (L₂E.bal sender + R) hs₂E).setBal coinbase
        ((L₂E.setBal sender (L₂E.bal sender + R) hs₂E).bal coinbase + T)
        hc₂E).bal a)
      = (((((L₂e.setBal escrow (L₂e.bal escrow - R) he₂e).setBal sender
            ((L₂e.setBal escrow (L₂e.bal escrow - R) he₂e).bal sender + R)
            hs₂e).setBal escrow
              ((((L₂e.setBal escrow (L₂e.bal escrow - R) he₂e).setBal sender
                ((L₂e.setBal escrow (L₂e.bal escrow - R) he₂e).bal sender + R)
                hs₂e).bal escrow) - T) he₂e).setBal coinbase
            (((((L₂e.setBal escrow (L₂e.bal escrow - R) he₂e).setBal sender
              ((L₂e.setBal escrow (L₂e.bal escrow - R) he₂e).bal sender + R)
              hs₂e).setBal escrow
                ((((L₂e.setBal escrow (L₂e.bal escrow - R) he₂e).setBal sender
                  ((L₂e.setBal escrow (L₂e.bal escrow - R) he₂e).bal sender + R)
                  hs₂e).bal escrow) - T) he₂e).bal coinbase) + T) hc₂e).setBal
          escrow
          ((((((L₂e.setBal escrow (L₂e.bal escrow - R) he₂e).setBal sender
            ((L₂e.setBal escrow (L₂e.bal escrow - R) he₂e).bal sender + R)
            hs₂e).setBal escrow
              ((((L₂e.setBal escrow (L₂e.bal escrow - R) he₂e).setBal sender
                ((L₂e.setBal escrow (L₂e.bal escrow - R) he₂e).bal sender + R)
                hs₂e).bal escrow) - T) he₂e).setBal coinbase
            (((((L₂e.setBal escrow (L₂e.bal escrow - R) he₂e).setBal sender
              ((L₂e.setBal escrow (L₂e.bal escrow - R) he₂e).bal sender + R)
              hs₂e).setBal escrow
                ((((L₂e.setBal escrow (L₂e.bal escrow - R) he₂e).setBal sender
                  ((L₂e.setBal escrow (L₂e.bal escrow - R) he₂e).bal sender + R)
                  hs₂e).bal escrow) - T) he₂e).bal coinbase) + T)
            hc₂e).bal escrow) - B) he₂e).bal a

declarations.name: EthTotal.Accounting.chain
declarations.signature:
def chain {Ls : ℕ → Ledger A}
    (fs : ∀ i : ℕ, Accounting (Ls i) (Ls (i + 1))) :
    ∀ n : ℕ, Accounting (Ls 0) (Ls n)
  | 0 => id (Ls 0)
  | n + 1 => (chain fs n).comp (fs n)

declarations.name: EthTotal.Accounting.chain_burn
declarations.signature:
theorem chain_burn {Ls : ℕ → Ledger A}
    (fs : ∀ i : ℕ, Accounting (Ls i) (Ls (i + 1))) :
    ∀ n : ℕ, (chain fs n).burn
      = sumOver (fun i => (fs i).burn) (List.range n)
  | 0 => rfl
  | n + 1 =>
      Eq.trans
        (congrArg (fun m => m + (fs n).burn) (chain_burn fs n))
        (Eq.trans
          (sumOver_append (fun i => (fs i).burn) (List.range n) [n]).symm
          (congrArg (sumOver (fun i => (fs i).burn)) (range_succ n).symm))

declarations.name: EthTotal.Accounting.chain_mint
declarations.signature:
theorem chain_mint {Ls : ℕ → Ledger A}
    (fs : ∀ i : ℕ, Accounting (Ls i) (Ls (i + 1))) :
    ∀ n : ℕ, (chain fs n).mint
      = sumOver (fun i => (fs i).mint) (List.range n)
  | 0 => rfl
  | n + 1 =>
      Eq.trans
        (congrArg (fun m => m + (fs n).mint) (chain_mint fs n))
        (Eq.trans
          (sumOver_append (fun i => (fs i).mint) (List.range n) [n]).symm
          (congrArg (sumOver (fun i => (fs i).mint)) (range_succ n).symm))

declarations.name: EthTotal.Accounting.chain_add
declarations.signature:
theorem chain_add {Ls : ℕ → Ledger A}
    (fs : ∀ i : ℕ, Accounting (Ls i) (Ls (i + 1))) (m : ℕ) :
    ∀ n : ℕ, chain fs (m + n)
      = (chain fs m).comp
          (chain (Ls := fun i => Ls (m + i)) (fun i => fs (m + i)) n)
  | 0 => (comp_id (chain fs m)).symm
  | n + 1 =>
      Eq.trans
        (congrArg (fun g => Accounting.comp g (fs (m + n))) (chain_add fs m n))
        (comp_assoc (chain fs m)
          (chain (Ls := fun i => Ls (m + i)) (fun i => fs (m + i)) n)
          (fs (m + n)))

declarations.signature:
theorem chain_add_symm {Ls : ℕ → Ledger A}
    (fs : ∀ i : ℕ, Accounting (Ls i) (Ls (i + 1))) (m n : ℕ) :
    (chain fs (m + n)).symm
      = (chain (Ls := fun i => Ls (m + i)) (fun i => fs (m + i)) n).symm.comp
          (chain fs m).symm

structure Canonical (L L' : Ledger A) where
  cert : Accounting L L'
  burn_min : ∀ g : Accounting L L', cert.burn ≤ g.burn
  mint_min : ∀ g : Accounting L L', cert.mint ≤ g.mint
  decomp : ∀ g : Accounting L L',
    cert.burn + (g.burn - cert.burn) = g.burn
    ∧ cert.mint + (g.burn - cert.burn) = g.mint
  mint_zero_iff : cert.mint = 0 ↔ L'.supply ≤ L.supply
  burn_zero_iff : cert.burn = 0 ↔ L.supply ≤ L'.supply
  cert_pure : cert.burn = 0 ∨ cert.mint = 0

declarations.signature:
structure Free (L L' : Ledger A) where
  gen : ℕ → Accounting L L'
  base : gen 0 = normal L L'
  faithful : ∀ k : ℕ, (gen k).burn - (normal L L').burn = k
  complete : ∀ f : Accounting L L', f = gen (f.burn - (normal L L').burn)
  dagger : ∀ k : ℕ, (gen k).symm = shift L' L k

  nonempty : Nonempty (Accounting L L')
  net_unique : ∀ f g : Accounting L L', f.burn + g.mint = g.burn + f.mint
  excess_shared : ∀ f : Accounting L L',
    (normal L L').mint + (f.burn - (normal L L').burn) = f.mint
  pure : (normal L L').burn = 0 ∨ (normal L L').mint = 0

declarations.name: EthTotal.Accounting.CanonicalRel
declarations.signature:
structure CanonicalRel (L L' : Ledger A) : Prop where
  total : L'.supply ≤ L.supply ∨ L.supply ≤ L'.supply
  antisymm : L'.supply ≤ L.supply → L.supply ≤ L'.supply → L'.supply = L.supply
  of_bal_le : (∀ a : A, L'.bal a ≤ L.bal a) → L'.supply ≤ L.supply
  of_bal_eq : (∀ a : A, L'.bal a = L.bal a) → L'.supply = L.supply
  lt_of_bal_lt : (∀ a : A, L'.bal a ≤ L.bal a) →
    ∀ a₀ : A, L'.bal a₀ < L.bal a₀ → L'.supply < L.supply
  exists_bal_lt : L'.supply < L.supply →
    ∃ a : A, a ∈ L.live ∧ L'.bal a < L.bal a
  bal_le_supply : ∀ a : A, L.bal a ≤ L.supply

declarations.name: EthTotal.Accounting.DaggerLaws
declarations.signature:
structure DaggerLaws (A : Type u) : Prop where
  hom_nonempty : ∀ L L' : Ledger A, Nonempty (Accounting L L')
  id_comp : ∀ (L L' : Ledger A) (f : Accounting L L'),
    (Accounting.id L).comp f = f
  comp_id : ∀ (L L' : Ledger A) (f : Accounting L L'),
    f.comp (Accounting.id L') = f
  comp_assoc : ∀ (L M N L' : Ledger A) (f : Accounting L M)
    (g : Accounting M N) (h : Accounting N L'),
    (f.comp g).comp h = f.comp (g.comp h)
  symm_symm : ∀ (L L' : Ledger A) (f : Accounting L L'), f.symm.symm = f
  symm_id : ∀ L : Ledger A, (Accounting.id L).symm = Accounting.id L
  symm_comp : ∀ (L M L' : Ledger A) (f : Accounting L M)
    (g : Accounting M L'), (f.comp g).symm = g.symm.comp f.symm
  net_unique : ∀ (L L' : Ledger A) (f g : Accounting L L'),
    f.burn + g.mint = g.burn + f.mint
  normal_symm : ∀ L L' : Ledger A, (normal L L').symm = normal L' L
  cert_unique : ∀ (L L' : Ledger A) (c c' : Canonical L L'), c.cert = c'.cert

theorem measure_chain {Ls : ℕ → Ledger A}
    (fs : ∀ i : ℕ, Recorded (Ls i) (Ls (i + 1))) :
    ∀ n : ℕ, (Recorded.chain fs n).measure
      = Accounting.chain (fun i => (fs i).measure) n
  | 0 => rfl
  | n + 1 =>

        (congrArg (fun g => Accounting.comp g (fs n).measure)
          (measure_chain fs n))

declarations.name: EthTotal.Recorded.DaggerLaws
declarations.signature:
structure DaggerLaws (A : Type u) : Prop where
  id_comp : ∀ (L L' : Ledger A) (f : Recorded L L'),
    (Recorded.id L).comp f = f
  comp_id : ∀ (L L' : Ledger A) (f : Recorded L L'),
    f.comp (Recorded.id L') = f
  comp_assoc : ∀ (L M N L' : Ledger A) (f : Recorded L M)
    (g : Recorded M N) (h : Recorded N L'),
    (f.comp g).comp h = f.comp (g.comp h)
  dagger_dagger : ∀ (L L' : Ledger A) (f : Recorded L L'), f.dagger.dagger = f
  dagger_id : ∀ L : Ledger A, (Recorded.id L).dagger = Recorded.id L
  dagger_comp : ∀ (L M L' : Ledger A) (f : Recorded L M) (g : Recorded M L'),
    (f.comp g).dagger = g.dagger.comp f.dagger
  no_unitary : ∀ (L L' : Ledger A) (f : Recorded L L'),
    f.comp f.dagger = Recorded.id L ↔ f.trace = ([] : Trace A)
  measure_id : ∀ L : Ledger A, (Recorded.id L).measure = Accounting.id L

    (f.comp g).measure = (f.measure).comp g.measure

    f.dagger.measure = (f.measure).symm

declarations.signature:
def chain {Ls : ℕ → Ledger A}
    (fs : ∀ i : ℕ, Recorded (Ls i) (Ls (i + 1))) :
    ∀ n : ℕ, Recorded (Ls 0) (Ls n)
  | 0 => Recorded.id (Ls 0)
  | n + 1 => (chain fs n).comp (fs n)

declarations.name: EthTotal.Recorded.chain_congr
declarations.signature:
theorem chain_congr {Ls : ℕ → Ledger A}
    (fs gs : ∀ i : ℕ, Recorded (Ls i) (Ls (i + 1))) :
    ∀ n : ℕ, (∀ i : ℕ, i < n → fs i = gs i) → chain fs n = chain gs n
  | 0, _ => rfl
  | n + 1, h =>
      Eq.trans
        (congrArg (fun g => Recorded.comp g (fs n))
          (chain_congr fs gs n (fun i hi => h i (Nat.le_succ_of_le hi))))
        (congrArg (fun e => Recorded.comp (chain gs n) e)
          (h n (Nat.le_refl (n + 1))))

declarations.name: EthTotal.Recorded.chain_add
declarations.signature:
theorem chain_add {Ls : ℕ → Ledger A}
    (fs : ∀ i : ℕ, Recorded (Ls i) (Ls (i + 1))) (m : ℕ) :
    ∀ n : ℕ, chain fs (m + n)
      = (chain fs m).comp
          (chain (Ls := fun i => Ls (m + i)) (fun i => fs (m + i)) n)
  | 0 => (comp_id (chain fs m)).symm
  | n + 1 =>
      Eq.trans
        (congrArg (fun g => Recorded.comp g (fs (m + n))) (chain_add fs m n))
        (comp_assoc (chain fs m)
          (chain (Ls := fun i => Ls (m + i)) (fun i => fs (m + i)) n)
          (fs (m + n)))

      = burned (chain fs m).trace

EthTotal.Recorded.mem_chain
declarations.signature:
theorem mem_chain {Ls : ℕ → Ledger A}
    (fs : ∀ i : ℕ, Recorded (Ls i) (Ls (i + 1))) {e : Ev A} :
    ∀ n : ℕ, e ∈ (chain fs n).trace → ∃ i : ℕ, i < n ∧ e ∈ (fs i).trace
  | 0, h => absurd h notMemNil
  | n + 1, h =>
      match memAppendElim (chain fs n).trace (fs n).trace h with
      | Or.inl hl =>
          match mem_chain fs n hl with
          | ⟨i, hi, hei⟩ => ⟨i, Nat.le_succ_of_le hi, hei⟩
      | Or.inr hr => ⟨n, Nat.le_refl (n + 1), hr⟩

declarations.name: EthTotal.Recorded.mem_chain_of_mem
declarations.signature:
theorem mem_chain_of_mem {Ls : ℕ → Ledger A}
    (fs : ∀ i : ℕ, Recorded (Ls i) (Ls (i + 1))) {e : Ev A} :
    ∀ (n i : ℕ), i < n → e ∈ (fs i).trace → e ∈ (chain fs n).trace
  | 0, _, hi, _ => absurd hi (Nat.not_succ_le_zero _)
  | n + 1, i, hi, he =>
      match Nat.lt_or_ge i n with
      | Or.inl hlt =>
          memAppendLeft (chain fs n).trace (fs n).trace
            (mem_chain_of_mem fs n i hlt he)
      | Or.inr hge =>
          memAppendRight (chain fs n).trace (fs n).trace
            (Eq.subst (motive := fun k => e ∈ (fs k).trace)
              (Nat.le_antisymm (Nat.le_of_succ_le_succ hi) hge) he)

declarations.name: EthTotal.Recorded.chain_mintCount
declarations.signature:
theorem chain_mintCount {Ls : ℕ → Ledger A}
    (fs : ∀ i : ℕ, Recorded (Ls i) (Ls (i + 1))) :
    ∀ n : ℕ, mintCount (chain fs n).trace
      = sumOver (fun i => mintCount (fs i).trace) (List.range n)
  | 0 => rfl
  | n + 1 =>
      Eq.trans (mintCount_append (chain fs n).trace (fs n).trace)
        (Eq.trans
          (congrArg (fun m => m + mintCount (fs n).trace)
            (chain_mintCount fs n))
          (Eq.trans
            (sumOver_append (fun i => mintCount (fs i).trace)
              (List.range n) [n]).symm
            (congrArg (sumOver (fun i => mintCount (fs i).trace))
              (range_succ n).symm)))

        ∧ L.supply < L'.supply)
      ∨ (Nonempty (ConfinedRecorded ([] : List A) B L L')
        ∧ ∀ f g : ConfinedRecorded ([] : List A) B L L',

declarations.signature:
def chain {M B : List A} {Ls : ℕ → Ledger A}
    (fs : ∀ i : ℕ, ConfinedRecorded M B (Ls i) (Ls (i + 1))) :
    ∀ n : ℕ, ConfinedRecorded M B (Ls 0) (Ls n)
  | 0 => id M B (Ls 0)
  | n + 1 => (chain fs n).comp (fs n)

declarations.name: EthTotal.ConfinedRecorded.forget_chain
declarations.signature:
theorem forget_chain {M B : List A} {Ls : ℕ → Ledger A}
    (fs : ∀ i : ℕ, ConfinedRecorded M B (Ls i) (Ls (i + 1))) :
    ∀ n : ℕ,
      forget (chain fs n) = Recorded.chain (fun i => forget (fs i)) n
  | 0 => rfl
  | n + 1 =>
      congrArg (fun g => Recorded.comp g (forget (fs n)))
        (forget_chain fs n)

declarations.name: EthTotal.ConfinedRecorded.relabel_chain
declarations.signature:
theorem relabel_chain {M M' B B' : List A} {Ls : ℕ → Ledger A}
    (hM : ∀ a : A, a ∈ M → a ∈ M') (hB : ∀ a : A, a ∈ B → a ∈ B')
    (fs : ∀ i : ℕ, ConfinedRecorded M B (Ls i) (Ls (i + 1))) :
    ∀ n : ℕ, relabel hM hB (chain fs n)
      = chain (fun i => relabel hM hB (fs i)) n
  | 0 => rfl
  | n + 1 =>
      congrArg (fun g => comp g (relabel hM hB (fs n)))
        (relabel_chain hM hB fs n)

EthTotal.ConfinedRecorded.chain_add
declarations.signature:
theorem chain_add {M B : List A} {Ls : ℕ → Ledger A}
    (fs : ∀ i : ℕ, ConfinedRecorded M B (Ls i) (Ls (i + 1))) (m : ℕ) :
    ∀ n : ℕ, chain fs (m + n)
      = (chain fs m).comp
          (chain (Ls := fun i => Ls (m + i)) (fun i => fs (m + i)) n)
  | 0 => (comp_id (chain fs m)).symm
  | n + 1 =>
      Eq.trans
        (congrArg (fun g => ConfinedRecorded.comp g (fs (m + n)))
          (chain_add fs m n))
        (comp_assoc (chain fs m)
          (chain (Ls := fun i => Ls (m + i)) (fun i => fs (m + i)) n)
          (fs (m + n)))

    (n : ℕ) (Ws : ℕ → Ledger A) (k : ℕ) (gs : ℕ → ℕ)
    (hjoin : (Ws 0).supply = (Ls n).supply)
    (hW : ∀ j : ℕ, (Ws (j + 1)).supply + 0 = (Ws j).supply + k * gs j)

      = (Ls 0).supply + k * sumOver gs (List.range m)

declarations.name: EthTotal.process_transaction_recorded
declarations.signature:
theorem process_transaction_recorded [DecidableEq A]
    (L₀ : Ledger A) (sender escrow coinbase : A)
    (hse : escrow ≠ sender) (hec : escrow ≠ coinbase)
    (hs₀ : sender ∈ L₀.live) (he₀ : escrow ∈ L₀.live)
    (P R T B : ℕ) (hsplit : R + (T + B) = P) (hP : P ≤ L₀.bal sender)
    (L₂ : Ledger A) (τe : Trace A)
    (hs₂ : sender ∈ L₂.live) (he₂ : escrow ∈ L₂.live) (hc₂ : coinbase ∈ L₂.live)
    (hesc : L₂.bal escrow = L₀.bal escrow + P)
    (hacce : L₂.supply + burned τe
      = ((L₀.setBal sender (L₀.bal sender - P) hs₀).setBal escrow
          ((L₀.setBal sender (L₀.bal sender - P) hs₀).bal escrow + P) he₀).supply
        + minted τe)
    (hconfe : SiteConfined ([] : List A) [escrow] τe) :
    ∃ (L' : Ledger A) (F : ConfinedRecorded ([] : List A) [escrow] L₀ L'),
      F.trace = τe ++ [Ev.burn escrow B]
      ∧ L'.supply ≤ L₀.supply
      ∧ L'.bal escrow = L₀.bal escrow
      ∧ L'.live = L₂.live

theorem process_transaction_destroy_recorded [DecidableEq A]
    (L₀ : Ledger A) (sender escrow coinbase : A)
    (hse : escrow ≠ sender) (hec : escrow ≠ coinbase)
    (hs₀ : sender ∈ L₀.live) (he₀ : escrow ∈ L₀.live)
    (P R T B : ℕ) (hsplit : R + (T + B) = P) (hP : P ≤ L₀.bal sender)
    (L₂ : Ledger A) (τe : Trace A)
    (hs₂ : sender ∈ L₂.live) (he₂ : escrow ∈ L₂.live) (hc₂ : coinbase ∈ L₂.live)
    (hesc : L₂.bal escrow = L₀.bal escrow + P)
    (hacce : L₂.supply + burned τe
      = ((L₀.setBal sender (L₀.bal sender - P) hs₀).setBal escrow
          ((L₀.setBal sender (L₀.bal sender - P) hs₀).bal escrow + P) he₀).supply
        + minted τe)
    (hconfe : SiteConfined ([] : List A) [escrow] τe)
    (a : A) (ha₂ : a ∈ L₂.live) :
    ∃ (L'' : Ledger A)
      (F : ConfinedRecorded ([] : List A) [escrow, a] L₀ L'') (D : ℕ),
      F.trace = (τe ++ [Ev.burn escrow B]) ++ [Ev.burn a D]
      ∧ L''.supply ≤ L₀.supply
      ∧ a ∉ L''.live
